Result: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER及真实世界机器人任务上，SAPrune剪除87.5%的视觉token，获得最高1.718倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。

Conclusion: SAPrune通过注意力可靠性驱动的自适应剪枝层选择与双路径保护规则，在免训练条件下显著提升VLA推理效率并维持任务性能。

Abstract: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

</details>


### [121] [Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05274)
*Runwei Guan,Rongsheng Hu,Shangshu Chen,Ningwei Ouyang,Shaofeng Liang,Heyi Lin,Jinjing Zhu,Yang Shi,Dongming Wu,Daizong Liu,Henghui Ding,Hui Xiong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对路边交通场景下多模态大模型的"说指不一致"问题，提出Enumerate-then-Answer范式与配套评测基准及强化学习策略，显著提升答案-定位一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路边交通推理要求每条自由文本主张都有视觉证据支撑。现有grounded MLLM常出现say-point mismatch，即文本答案与模型定位的边界框相矛盾。而传统评测将答案与框分开打分，无法惩罚此类失败。作者将这一失配归因于"先答后定位"（answer-then-ground）的分解方式——在任何目标被枚举前就已作出数值性主张。

Method: 1) 构建RoadSceneVQA-G基准：34.7K问答对，每个自由形式答案均关联见证其成立的框集合；2) 提出Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC)评测套件以量化说指一致性；3) 提出Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA)，反转生成顺序，使答案-证据一致性成为输出结构的固有属性；4) 提出Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO)强化学习阶段，以多次rollout的并集作为召回教师，无需真值框监督。

Result: EtA将say-point一致性从26.6%提升至93.7%，grounding F1从52.2%提升至73.0%；ECPO在无逐框监督下进一步将F1提升至75.6%。在gRefCOCO上，同一框架优于最强对比方法，表明其可迁移至交通场景之外。

Conclusion: 通过反转生成顺序将答案-证据一致性内化为输出结构属性，并以无框监督的强化学习进一步优化，可有效缓解grounded MLLM的说指不一致问题，且方法具备跨域泛化能力。项目代码已开源。

Abstract: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at \url{https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G}.

</details>


### [122] [Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05289)
*Xiaobiao Du,Beixi Hao,Zhen Fang,Tianqing Zhu,Richard Hartley,Xin Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Mobile-4DGS 是一个面向移动端的高保真实时静态与动态 3D 高斯泼溅统一轻量框架，通过外观压缩、基元剪枝、紧凑显式 4D 表示与深度序复用，显著降低存储与渲染开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 在新视角合成上表现优异，但在资源受限的移动设备上部署静态与动态高斯表示仍面临三大障碍：存储开销大、基元冗余、逐帧计算代价高。

Method: 1) 外观建模：提出蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器（Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator），将高阶辐射残差压缩进一阶球谐（SH）；并设计属性条件 SH 增强模块，其预测偏移在推理前预烘焙。2) 基元优化：提出基于多视角 Alpha 的稠密化与剪枝策略，在保持多视角一致性的同时抑制冗余基元。3) 动态建模：构建紧凑显式 4D 表示，包含二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑与二值静动态划分，实现无需运行时形变网络的连续时间建模。4) 渲染加速：基于该划分提出深度序证书（Depth-Order Certificate），选择性复用已提交的深度顺序，减少回放期间的重新投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。

Result: 在静态与动态场景上的大量实验表明，Mobile-4DGS 在保持有竞争力视觉质量的同时大幅降低存储与渲染开销，实现了移动设备上的实时 3D 与 4D 高斯泼溅。

Conclusion: 该工作为移动端统一支持静态与动态高斯渲染提供了可行方案，兼顾紧凑性、实时性与视觉质量，代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.

</details>


### [123] [BossouChimpanzee: Long-term Chimpanzee Video Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05293)
*Daniel Schofield,Susana Carvalho,Vladimir Iashin,Andrew Zisserman,Max Bain,Arsha Nagrani,David Ng,Claudia Sousa,Boniface Zogbila,Jules Doré,Dora Biro,Misato Hayashi,Tetsuro Matsuzawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍BossouChimpanzee视频数据集：记录了几内亚Bossou野外实验站野生黑猩猩长达30年（1988-2018）、超1200小时的连续视频，并先行发布约74小时的BossouChimpanzee70h快照，涵盖23个已识别个体，任务聚焦黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该研究的动因在于：野外黑猩猩的长期视听数据稀缺，既限制了对黑猩猩认知与行为的纵向研究，也缺少用于训练和评测机器学习模型的真实野外（in the wild）视听基准，因此需要整理并公开这一长期视频档案。

Method: 方法上，作者基于合作野外工作与调研积累，梳理该实验范式与视频档案的历史及科学贡献，给出主数据集的关键统计与结构说明；在完整视频资源发布前，先构建并发布约74小时的初始快照BossouChimpanzee70h，面向黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别任务。

Result: 结果是形成并公开了一个跨30年、超1200小时的连续视频数据集，其中初始快照约74小时，覆盖23个已识别个体，可用于个体识别与动作识别的基准测试。

Conclusion: 结论认为，该数据集既是动物行为学与认知与行为研究的宝贵资源，也为在野外视听数据上训练与评测机器学习模型提供了丰富的基准，后续将发布完整视频资源。

Abstract: We describe the BossouChimpanzee video dataset, a unique long-term visual record of wild chimpanzees at an outdoor laboratory for field experiments in Bossou, Guinea, spanning three decades (1988-2018) and comprising over 1,200 hours of continuous video recordings collected through collaborative fieldwork and research. In this paper, we outline the history and scientific contributions of the experimental paradigm and video archive, provide key statistics and details on the structure of the main video dataset, and release an initial ~74h snapshot, BossouChimpanzee70h, covering 23 identified individuals focused on chimpanzee individual and action recognition, ahead of the full video resource. This dataset represents a valuable resource for cognitive and behavioural research in ethology and a rich benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on audiovisual data from the wild.

</details>


### [124] [Revisiting Ground-Truth Synthesis from High-Speed Video: Exact Validity Conditions and an Audited Consumer Capture Corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05298)
*Abdullah Al Shafi,Sumaiya Rahim Suma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出运动去模糊数据集常用的"平均N帧并以中心帧为标签"的合成方式存在两个隐患：偶数窗口会导致标签系统性偏移，不等曝光时长会造成监督信号的卷积污染，并通过51段手机视频的审计验证了该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动去模糊数据集通常通过平均N个连续高帧率帧、并以中心帧作为标签来合成。作者希望验证这种标注方式是否在所有拍摄时序下都无偏，以及实际设备采集数据是否满足该前提条件。

Method: 从理论上分析窗口奇偶性与各帧采样时长相等性对标签偏差的影响；对51段标称240 fps的智能手机视频剪辑进行审计，检查其容器时序表中的真实帧率；并通过受控实验比较奇偶性选择与时序不规则性对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响，同时比较模糊标签与插值标签的可修复性。

Result: 理论证明仅在窗口为奇数且各帧采样时长相等时标签才无偏；偶数窗口会使标签偏移固定比例的模糊长度。不等时长的平均错位为零，无法从数据集统计中察觉，但在无法从模糊中读出偏移时会造成监督信号的卷积污染。审计发现51段标称240 fps的剪辑中有19段实际接近176 fps。受控实验中，奇偶性选择对线性去模糊滤波器拟合的损害远大于时序不规则性；插值标签可借助真实帧时间修复，而模糊标签不能。

Conclusion: 现有运动去模糊数据集的标签合成存在被忽视的系统性偏差，且实际采集设备的帧率常与标称值不符。作者提供了一个无需解码即可检查这两个条件的工具，并将公开这些剪辑及其时序表。

Abstract: Motion-deblurring datasets are commonly synthesised by averaging $N$ consecutive high-frame-rate frames and labelling the result with the central frame. We show that this label is unbiased for every capture timing only when the window is odd and the frames' sample durations are equal. An even window shifts every label by a fixed fraction of the blur length, even under perfect timing. Unequal durations are subtler: their mean misalignment is zero, so dataset statistics cannot reveal them, yet when the offset cannot be read from the blur they convolve the supervision rather than adding noise to it. Auditing 51 smartphone clips recorded at a nominal 240 fps, we find 19 captured near 176 fps, a behaviour recorded only in the container's timing tables. In a controlled test the parity choice costs a fitted linear deblurring filter far more than these timing irregularities do, and interpolation labels, unlike blur labels, can be repaired with the true frame times. We provide a tool that checks both conditions without decoding, and will release the clips and their timing tables.

</details>


### [125] [Kinematics-Centric Continuous Sign Language Retrieval with Gloss-Guided Boundary-Aware Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05306)
*Chang Liu,Ke Han,Davide Talon,Elisa Ricci,Nicu Sebe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出以3D SMPL-X运动为核心的"运动学中心"框架用于手语-文本对齐，通过gloss引导的局部对齐和视觉蒸馏策略，在CSL-Daily上取得SOTA双向检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手语-文本对齐方法主要依赖外观密集的RGB表示，将运动语义与视觉变化纠缠在一起，导致运动-语言grounding模糊。作者希望摆脱对外观信号的依赖，在结构化的运动学空间中重新建模该任务。

Method: （1）采用3D SMPL-X运动作为主表示，在统一的运动空间中显式建模手语的运动学动态；（2）提出gloss引导的局部对齐机制，利用gloss时间跨度作为弱监督，将连续运动分解为连贯片段，建立细粒度运动-文本对应；（3）设计视觉蒸馏策略，训练时RGB信号作为特权监督提供互补上下文，推理时完全移除。

Result: 在标准基准上，方法在CSL-Daily上实现了SOTA的双向检索性能，在PHOENIX-2014T上取得有竞争力的结果。

Conclusion: 结果表明，运动学表示与显式局部grounding对提升手语-文本对齐效果显著，为文本驱动的手语理解提供了新思路。

Abstract: Sign language-text alignment remains a fundamental challenge for text-driven sign language understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on appearance-heavy RGB representations, which entangle motion semantics with visual variations and lead to ambiguous motion-language grounding. In this paper, we reformulate sign language-text alignment in a structured kinematic space and propose a kinematics-centric framework that adopts 3D SMPL-X motion as the primary representation. By explicitly modeling the kinematic dynamics of signing in a unified motion space, our approach reduces reliance on appearance signals and yields more semantically consistent representations. To capture the compositional nature of sign language, we introduce a gloss-guided local alignment mechanism that leverages gloss temporal spans as weak supervision to decompose continuous motion into coherent segments and establish fine-grained motion-text correspondences, thereby reducing ambiguity in localizing word-level semantics in continuous signing. Furthermore, we develop a visual distillation strategy, where RGB signals serve as privileged supervision during training to provide complementary contextual cues, while being completely removed at inference time. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art bidirectional retrieval performance on CSL-Daily and competitive results on PHOENIX-2014T. These results highlight the effectiveness of kinematic representations and explicit local grounding for sign language-text alignment.

</details>


### [126] [Shadow Feature Refinement Network: Progressive Feature Refinement based on Knowledge Distillation for Effective Shadow Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05325)
*Donghyun Han,Byoung-Dai Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SFR-Net，结合监督学习、特征细化损失与知识蒸馏，并引入后处理算法恢复自然色彩，在ISTD+和SRD上取得竞争性阴影去除效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阴影的尺寸与颜色受光照条件影响而变化，导致阴影去除仍是深度学习中的持续性难题。

Method: 提出阴影特征细化网络（SFR-Net），采用监督学习、特征细化损失与知识蒸馏提升阴影去除性能；并引入专用后处理算法，恢复生成的无阴影图像的自然色彩一致性。

Result: 在ISTD+上整图RMSE为3.4627、SSIM为0.9382；在SRD上RMSE为4.3781、SSIM为0.9341，在阴影与非阴影区域均表现竞争性，并展现跨多样条件的强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该方法在阴影与非阴影区域均具竞争性表现，为稳健且感知自然的阴影去除提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: In the field of deep learning, has seen significant advancements; however, shadow removal remains a persistent challenge owing to the variable sizes and colors of shadows influenced by lighting conditions. This study proposes a novel shadow feature refinement network (SFR-Net), which leverages supervised learning, feature refinement loss, and knowledge distillation to enhance shadow removal performance. A dedicated post-processing algorithm is further introduced to restore natural color consistency in the generated shadow-free images. We evaluated our method on two public datasets: the adjusted image shadow triplet dataset (ISTD+) and the shadow removal dataset (SRD), which demonstrate strong generalization capabilities under diverse conditions. On ISTD+, our model achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.4627 and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.9382 across the entire image. On SRD, it recorded an RMSE of 4.3781 and an SSIM of 0.9341. These comprehensive results show that our approach performs competitively across both shadow and non-shadow regions while setting a promising direction for robust and perceptually natural shadow removal. Code is available at https://github.com/DongHyun99/SFRNet.

</details>


### [127] [Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05326)
*Olakunle S. Abawonse,Fatou Fall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出黎曼形状空间框架，用128个地标表示OASIS-1队列中矢状面胼胝体轮廓，通过测地回归定位年龄相关形变，发现后部区域（压部41.4%、峡部23.8%）主导老化形变，且该轨迹在阿尔茨海默病中被破坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 胼胝体是脑老化的标志性白质结构，但既有研究多采用标量汇总（如面积、厚度）来量化，丢弃了其边界几何信息。作者希望保留轮廓的完整几何形状，以更敏感地刻画年龄相关的形态变化及其空间分布。

Method: 将每个中矢状面胼胝体轮廓表示为128个地标并嵌入Kendall形状空间，去除平移、旋转和尺度。在形状空间上推导含精确黎曼梯度的多元测地回归，用拟合的年龄速度场将年龄相关形变定位到五个解剖子区域，并在切空间训练分类器。

Result: 在认知正常队列（n=252）中，测地回归优于欧氏线性基准（R²=0.1355 vs. 0.1216）。区域能量呈后部优势：压部占年龄相关形状变化的41.4%，峡部占23.8%，合计约65%（尽管仅占约35%的地标）。有符号投影验证排序（压部r=0.570；峡部r=0.473）。相反，阿尔茨海默病组（n=88）中年龄仅解释不到0.5%的形状方差。仅用二维轮廓的切空间分类器达到年龄组AUC=0.791，超过近期体积基准（0.67）。

Conclusion: 保留边界几何的黎曼形状空间分析比标量方法更有效地刻画胼胝体老化，揭示后部子区域主导的健康老化轨迹，并表明阿尔茨海默病打断了该轨迹；二维轮廓本身即包含可用于年龄分组的强判别信息。

Abstract: The corpus callosum (CC) is a major white-matter structure and a well-established marker of brain aging, but most studies quantify it using scalar summaries that discard its boundary geometry. We present a Riemannian shape-space framework for analyzing age-related morphological change in the midsagittal CC, applied to the OASIS-1 cohort. Each contour is represented by $128$ landmarks and embedded into Kendall shape space, where translation, rotation, and scale are removed. We derive a multivariate geodesic regression with exact Riemannian gradients and use the fitted age-velocity field to localize age-related deformation to five anatomical sub-regions. In the cognitively normal cohort ($n = 252$), geodesic regression outperforms the Euclidean linear benchmark ($R^2 = 0.1355$ vs.\ $0.1216$). Regional energy is posterior-dominant: the Splenium carries $41.4\%$ and the Isthmus $23.8\%$ of total age-related shape change, together accounting for $\sim 65\%$ despite comprising only $\sim 35\%$ of landmarks. Signed projections confirm the ordering (Splenium $r = 0.570$; Isthmus $r = 0.473$). In contrast, age explains less than $0.5\%$ of shape variance in Alzheimer's disease ($n = 88$), indicating that the disease disrupts the healthy aging trajectory. A tangent-space classifier achieves an age-group AUC of $0.791$ from the 2D contour alone, exceeding a recent volumetric benchmark ($0.67$).

</details>


### [128] [WILLIE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Wound Classification, Segmentation, and Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05341)
*Gopi Trinadh Maddikunta,Shannan Hamlin,Hsin-Mei Chen,Kimaya Barnes,Peizhu Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一框架WILLIE及基准，将伤口分类、分割与定位三任务在共同协议下联合建模，最佳模型单次前向即达91.88%分类准确率、91.41% Dice、96.23% AP@0.5，并发现分割衍生定位优于专用检测基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 慢性伤口管理影响美国超820万患者，临床与经济负担沉重。临床伤口评估实际包含三个耦合任务：识别伤口类型、勾画伤口边界、定位伤口区域以进行测量与监测。然而现有机器学习方法通常用独立模型分别处理分类、分割与定位，忽略了任务间的临床耦合性，且缺乏统一的评估协议。

Method: 提出WILLIE——面向伤口分类、分割与定位的统一框架与基准，支持在多任务伤口分析下进行系统评估。将三个公开伤口数据集协调统一为共享基准，在三种缩放配置下比较统一模型，并与10个单任务基线进行对比。

Result: 最佳模型实现91.88%分类准确率、91.41% Dice和96.23% AP@0.5，且仅需单次前向传播即可输出全部三种结果。此外，分割衍生的定位在该基准上优于专用检测基线，表明对于空间上连贯的伤口目标，基于边界框的定位可能并非必要。

Conclusion: 医疗影像中有效的多任务学习不仅依赖共享表征，还取决于任务形式化、任务兼容性与基准设计。研究结果提示，对空间连贯目标可重新审视检测式定位的必要性。

Abstract: Chronic wound management affects over 8.2 million patients in the United States and imposes substantial clinical and economic burden. Clinical wound assessment commonly involves three coupled tasks: identifying wound type, delineating wound boundaries, and localizing the wound region for measurement and monitoring. Despite this clinical coupling, existing machine learning approaches typically address wound classification, segmentation, and localization using separate models. We present WILLIE, a unified framework and benchmark for wound classification, segmentation and localization that enables systematic evaluation of multi-task wound analysis under a common protocol. WILLIE harmonizes three public wound datasets into a shared benchmark and compares unified models across three scaling configurations against 10 single-task baselines. The best model achieves 91.88% classification accuracy, 91.41% Dice, and 96.23% AP@0.5 while producing all three outputs in a single forward pass. Beyond aggregate performance, our results show that segmentation-derived localization outperforms dedicated detection baselines in this benchmark, suggesting that box-based localization may be unnecessary for spatially coherent wound targets. Our findings highlight that effective multi-task learning in healthcare imaging depends not only on shared representations, but also on task formulation, compatibility, and benchmark design.

</details>


### [129] [IRSTD-Agent: Agentic Infrared Small Target Detection via Zoom-Guided Interaction Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05342)
*Jiawen Xi,Yu Zhang,Tianyi Zhao,Zhu Liu,Maoxun Yuan,Xingxing Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出IRSTD-Agent，一个基于MLLM的智能体框架，通过动态视觉搜索实现红外小目标检测，利用五种视觉工具与Zoom引导的交互学习，在原分辨率图像上逐步定位目标，在两个数据集上优于现有视觉语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 红外小目标检测在海上监测与空中侦察中具有重要意义。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）具备视觉理解潜力，但现有基于MLLM的方法难以精确定位红外小目标。

Method: 提出IRSTD-Agent智能体框架，使MLLM自适应决定检查图像的位置与尺度，逐步收集细粒度视觉证据。设计五种互补视觉工具：PROPOSAL（候选发现）、ZOOM（自适应观察）、DETECT（目标定位）、DROP（假设剔除）、REFINE（目标范围细化），协同完成原分辨率图像上的搜索。并引入Zoom引导的交互学习，利用标注衍生的交互轨迹监督工具选择及其参数。

Result: 在WideIRSTD-Full与IRSTD-1k数据集上的大量实验表明，IRSTD-Agent优于所评估的视觉语言模型，并提升了MLLM在红外小目标检测任务中的精确定位能力。

Conclusion: IRSTD-Agent通过智能体式动态视觉搜索与交互学习，有效增强了MLLM对红外小目标的精确定位能力，为红外小目标检测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Infrared small-target detection plays an important role in maritime monitoring and aerial surveillance. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer promising capabilities for visual understanding, existing MLLM-based approaches struggle to precisely localize infrared small targets. In this paper, we propose IRSTD-Agent, an agentic framework for infrared small target detection through dynamic visual search. The framework enables an MLLM to adaptively determine where and at what scale to inspect an image and progressively gather fine-grained visual evidence for precise target localization. Five complementary visual tools (PROPOSAL, ZOOM, DETECT, DROP and REFINE) support object candidate discovery, adaptive observation, target localization, hypothesis rejection, and target extent refinement, together enabling a coordinated search process over original-resolution images. To teach the MLLMs to conduct this search, we introduce Zoom-guided Interaction Learning, which uses annotation-derived interaction trajectories to supervise tool selection and the corresponding arguments. Through extensive experiments on WideIRSTD-Full and IRSTD-1k datasets, we demonstrate that IRSTD-Agent outperforms the evaluated vision-language models and enhances the precise localization capabilities of MLLMs in IRSTD tasks.

</details>


### [130] [Learning Conditional Source Distribution via Flow Reversal for Temporal Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05349)
*Kuan-Hsun Tu,Hsuan-Chi Liu,Jia-Wei Liao,Chien-Sheng Chiang,Tsung-Wei Ke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CNP-Flow，通过流反转学习条件源分布的流匹配框架，在视频预测、插值和机器人运动规划中提升生成质量并减少函数评估次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准条件流匹配（FM）仅通过向量场引入条件，源样本仍从标准高斯采样，条件信息未被充分编码于源分布，限制了生成质量与采样效率。

Method: CNP-Flow用条件噪声预测器（CNP）为每个时间条件生成各向同性高斯源；CNP由流反转获得的源样本监督，即通过预训练FM模型将观测目标反向映射。采用三阶段流程：预训练FM、训练CNP、用学习到的源分布微调FM，并保持FM骨干结构不变。

Result: 在视频预测、视频插值和7自由度Franka机器人运动规划任务中，CNP-Flow持续提升生成质量，并在更少函数评估次数下达到基线性能。

Conclusion: 通过流反转构建条件源分布可在不改动FM骨干的前提下增强条件生成，兼顾质量与采样效率。

Abstract: We introduce CNP-Flow, a flow matching framework for temporal generation that learns conditional source distributions through flow reversal. Whereas standard conditional flow matching (FM) incorporates conditioning through the vector field and draws source samples from a standard Gaussian, CNP-Flow uses a conditional noise predictor (CNP) to produce an isotropic Gaussian source for each temporal condition. The CNP is supervised by source samples obtained through flow reversal, which maps observed targets backward through a pretrained FM model. A three-stage pipeline pretrains the FM model, trains the CNP, and fine-tunes the FM model using the learned source distribution, while preserving the FM backbone architecture. Across video prediction, video interpolation, and 7-DoF Franka robot motion planning, CNP-Flow consistently improves generation quality. It also matches baseline performance with fewer function evaluations. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cnpflow

</details>


### [131] [CleanMDM: Clean Motion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Motion Cleanup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05411)
*Zhe Li,Shicheng Wang,Bowen Cai,Huan Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CleanMDM：将动作清理统一为掩码条件生成，支持多模态即插即用条件，实现自动与可控清理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作捕捉数据普遍存在缺失段、抖动、漂移和接触伪影，传统上依赖动画师手动识别并修正关键帧再插值，成本高且效率低；已有生成式自动清理方法多为黑盒去噪器，可控性差，难以保留可靠片段或满足用户特定意图。

Method: 提出统一多模态动作清理框架CleanMDM，把清理建模为带即插即用条件的掩码条件生成，单一模型支持噪声3D动作、稀疏2D关键帧、稀疏3D关键帧与文本的任意组合；引入潜在动作质量判别器（LMQD）以更贴合运动学分布，减少滑步、抖动与穿插伪影；在测试时采用网格感知接触投影进行优化，提升接触与物理一致性。

Result: 在多个数据集上，CleanMDM持续优于已有清理与生成基线；低成本条件（文本和2D关键帧）在多模态清理场景中带来可靠的可控性提升。

Conclusion: 受动画工作流启发，CleanMDM以掩码条件生成统一自动与可控动作清理，既能无需额外标注自动清理，也能在多模态引导下可控清理，并通过LMQD与网格感知接触投影进一步改善真实感与物理一致性。

Abstract: Motion capture data is rarely directly usable, as they typically exhibit missing segments, jitter, drift and contact artifacts. Traditionally, corrupted motions are cleaned by animators through the manual identification of keyframes from noisy motion, subsequent keyframe correction, and interpolation between corrected keyframes to reconstruct coherent motion. While the rise of generative motion models has made automatic cleanup feasible, most approaches operate as black box denoisers with limited controllability, making it difficult to preserve reliable segments or enforce specific user intents. Inspired by animation workflows, we present CleanMDM, a unified multimodal motion cleanup framework that formulates cleanup as masked conditional generation with plug-and-play conditions. This single model supports arbitrary combinations of noisy 3D motion, sparse 2D keyframes, sparse 3D keyframes, and text. This design enables both automatic cleanup without additional user annotation and controllable cleanup under multimodal guidance. To further improve motion realism, we incorporate the Latent Motion Quality Discriminator (LMQD) to better match kinematic distributions and reduce skating, jitter, and interpenetration artifacts, and we apply Mesh-Aware Contact Projection as a test-time optimization step to enhance contact and physical consistency. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that CleanMDM consistently outperforms prior cleanup and generation baselines, and that low cost conditions (text and 2D keyframes) provide reliable controllability gains in multimodal cleanup scenarios.

</details>


### [132] [A Strong Baseline for Evaluating Vision Encoders in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05413)
*Yilin Yang,Jun-Tao Tang,Kengyi Wang,Siyuan Su,Gaoyong Luo,Mingda Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文重新审视视觉编码器的跨模态评估，指出现有方法在实验设计与方法构建上的局限，提出免训练、基于跨模态最近邻检索的RAVEL指标，在实验中显著超越既有方法，达到当前最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估视觉编码器需要能可靠预测其在多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中下游表现的指标。尽管已有研究表明跨模态指标更能反映这种性能，实践中仍以单模态指标为主；同时先前跨模态方法在实验设计和方法构建上存在重要局限。

Method: 通过大规模实验重新审视视觉编码器的跨模态评估，指出先前方法在实验设计与方法构建上的缺陷并加以修正，进而提出RAVEL——一种免训练的跨模态最近邻检索方法。

Result: RAVEL虽方法简单，但在所有实验中均取得当前最佳性能，且大幅领先先前方法。

Conclusion: 在严谨、全面的评估设置下，简单的跨模态指标即可为MLLM视觉编码器评估提供强有力依据。

Abstract: Evaluating vision encoders requires metrics that reliably predict their downstream performance in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Although recent studies have shown that cross-modal metrics can better capture such performance, unimodal metrics remain the dominant choice in practice. In this work, we revisit cross-modal evaluation of vision encoders through large-scale experiments. We identify important limitations in both the experimental design and methodological formulation of prior approaches. After addressing these limitations and introducing simple improvements, we propose RAVEL, a training-free method based on cross-modal nearest-neighbor retrieval. Despite its simplicity, RAVEL achieves state-of-the-art performance across our experiments, outperforming prior methods by a substantial margin. Our results demonstrate that simple cross-modal metrics, when evaluated under a careful and comprehensive setup, can provide a strong basis for evaluating vision encoders for MLLMs.

</details>


### [133] [Prism: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Native 2K Joint Video-Audio Generation Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05416)
*Shuyuan Tu,Qi Tian,Yinming Huang,Yue Wu,Xintong Han,Kaihang Pan,Weijie Kong,Jiangfeng Xiong,Jian-Wei Zhang,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Prism，一种用于 2K 分辨率联合视频-音频生成模型原生训练的**动态稀疏注意力框架**，通过时空宏区划分与自适应块形状分配，在训练加速 2.5× 的同时超越全注意力的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 高分辨率原生联合视频-音频生成可学到更丰富视觉细节与更锐利的运动动态；2. 但全注意力计算开销随分辨率二次增长，且注意力被越来越多冗余 token 稀释，削弱有效内容的学习信号并破坏预训练先验；3. 现有稀疏注意力方法要么面向免训练加速，要么忽略了联合视频-音频数据的特有结构——跨模态交互本质集中在发声区域附近。

Method: 1. 将 token 序列组织为**时空宏区（spatiotemporal macro-zones）**，使注意力结构适配局部内容；2. 对每个区，通过两个信号估计局部信息结构：视频特征沿通道维的方差（刻画视觉内容的方向性变化）与音频到视频交叉注意力特征范数（刻画音频对每个视觉区域的影响强度）；3. 基于这些信号为每个区**动态分配定制块形状**，在视觉内容快速变化和音视频耦合强的轴上采用更细的分块，保证块内 token 语义一致，使块级特征同时捕获视觉内容与联合音视频交互模式；4. 采用**混合块选择策略**为每个 query 动态确定稀疏度。

Result: 相比全注意力实现 **2.5× 训练加速**，同时在生成质量上超过全注意力基线。

Conclusion: Prism 表明：针对联合视频-音频数据固有结构（声音产生区域的集中跨模态交互）设计的动态稀疏注意力，可在 2K 原生训练中同时收获效率与质量双重收益，为高分辨率多模态生成训练提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Natively training joint video-audio generation models at higher resolutions empowers them to learn richer visual details and sharper motion dynamics. However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. Existing sparse attention methods either target training-free acceleration or overlook the unique structure of joint video-audio data, where cross-modal interactions are inherently concentrated around sound-producing regions. To address this, we propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K. In particular, Prism organizes the token sequence into spatiotemporal macro-zones, enabling the attention structure to adapt to local content. For each zone, it estimates local information structure via video feature variance along the channel and feature norms from the audio-to-video cross-attention, jointly capturing how visual content varies directionally and how strongly audio influences each visual region. Based on these signals, Prism dynamically assigns a tailored block shape to each zone, applying finer partitioning along axes of rapid visual content variation and strong audio-visual coupling. This encourages tokens within each block to remain semantically coherent, allowing block-level features to capture both visual content and joint video-audio interaction patterns. Prism further adopts a hybrid block selection strategy to dynamically determine per-query sparsity. Experiments show that Prism achieves 2.5$\times$ training speedup compared to full attention, while surpassing it in generation quality.

</details>


### [134] [Render to Reason: Novel-View Semantic Prediction Improves Spatial Understanding in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05417)
*Yuqun Wu,Yao Xiao,Chuhang Zou,Shenlong Wang,Derek Hoiem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现：将预训练3D模型的几何特征注入视觉语言模型（VLM）并在标准空间问答上微调，对高层多跳空间推理任务提升甚微；其归因于训练信号问题——标准空间问答可仅凭视觉特征与语言先验作答，导致几何通路梯度弱、无法与视觉特征有效整合。为此提出"新视角语义渲染"作为辅助训练任务，强制几何与视觉两条通路协同，在三个基准上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期工作尝试用预训练3D模型的几何特征增强VLM以提升空间推理能力，但作者发现简单融合几何特征并在标准空间QA上训练，对高层多跳任务仅有边际收益。作者将这一差距归因于训练信号问题：标准空间QA大多可依赖视觉特征与语言先验回答，几何分支获得的梯度信号微弱，难以与视觉特征真正融合。因此需要一个"必须依赖几何才能完成"的训练信号来驱动两通路整合。

Method: 提出"新视角语义渲染"（novel-view semantic rendering）作为辅助训练任务：要求模型预测一个未观测视角的语义布局，其灵感来自人类在空间推理中能够对陌生视角进行心理模拟。该任务迫使模型联合使用两条通路——几何提供依赖位姿的可见性（pose-dependent visibility），视觉提供语义内容（semantic content），从而为几何分支提供强监督信号。方法上即在几何增强基线的训练流程中额外加入该辅助任务，实现几何与视觉特征的联合训练。

Result: 相比几何增强基线，辅助任务在全部三个基准上取得一致提升：VSI-Bench最高+1.6，ReVSI +2.2，自建数据集3D-Point-QA +2.9。完整模型在VSI-Bench与ReVSI上超过此前的开源方法。

Conclusion: 几何增强VLM效果受限的根因在于训练信号不足，而非几何特征本身无效。通过引入以几何为必要条件的辅助任务（新视角语义渲染），可有效驱动几何与视觉通路的联合表征学习，显著提升多跳空间推理，并超越现有开源方法。项目主页：https://yuqunw.github.io/Render2Reason/。

Abstract: Recent works augment Vision-Language Models with geometry features from pretrained 3D models, expecting that the geometric signal will boost spatial reasoning. However, we find that simply fusing geometry features and training on standard spatial QA yields only marginal improvements on high-level multi-hop tasks. We attribute this gap to a training-signal problem: standard spatial QA can be largely answered from visual features and language priors, so the geometry pathway receives weak gradients and fails to integrate with the visual features. To provide a training signal that requires geometry, we propose \textbf{novel-view semantic rendering} as an auxiliary training task that requires the model to predict the semantic layout of an unobserved viewpoint, inspired by humans' ability to mentally simulate novel viewpoints during spatial reasoning. This task encourages joint use of both pathways: geometry provides pose-dependent visibility, while vision provides semantic content. Our auxiliary task yields consistent improvements over the geometry-augmented baseline across all three benchmarks (up to +1.6 on VSI-Bench, +2.2 on ReVSI, +2.9 on our 3D-Point-QA dataset) and our full model surpasses prior open-source methods on VSI-Bench and on ReVSI. Project page: https://yuqunw.github.io/Render2Reason/.

</details>


### [135] [Unmentioned Checklist Findings Change How Reinforcement Learning Appears to Improve Chest Radiograph Report Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05425)
*Ali Vosoughi,Akhil Kasturi,Chenliang Xu,Axel Wismueller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究用强化学习训练视觉-语言模型，在不看待测句子的情况下从胸片生成12项发现的检查清单，再由独立检查模型判定句子。规则检查与独立医学检查的判别增益分别为12.6%和11.8%，但仅规则检查满足预设误报标准；训练格式切换使训练检查器增益升高、独立检查器降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放射报告自动核查常依赖AI生成的检查清单，但清单可能遗漏某些发现，从而影响核查的可靠性。作者希望避免模型在核查时"看到"待测句子而产生信息泄漏，并量化不同检查方式的实际判别能力。

Method: 采用强化学习训练一个视觉-语言模型，仅从胸片图像生成包含12项发现的检查清单，不输入待测句子；另设独立的检查模型，依据该清单对句子进行判断。在留出患者上，用未参与训练的规则式检查器和独立医学检查器以Youden指数量化判别增益，并比较固定发现顺序、未提及发现记为"absent"的训练格式与常规格式的差异。

Result: 在留出患者上，规则式检查和独立医学检查器的Youden指数增益分别为12.6%和11.8%，仅规则式检查达到预设的误报标准。切换至训练格式后，训练检查器的测得增益升高而后者的增益降低，该预设比较为6.2%（95%区间2.0%–10.5%），事后在留出患者上为7.7%。在8个检查模型中，对未提及发现的标签一致阴性陈述的接受率从1.0%到97.0%不等。

Conclusion: 基于清单的自动核查在避免信息泄漏的前提下可带来一定的判别增益，但增益大小高度依赖检查器类型与清单格式，且模型间对未提及发现的处理差异极大；此外标签来自报告导出而非放射科医生裁定，结果需谨慎解读。

Abstract: Automated checks of radiology reports may rely on AI-generated checklists that leave findings unmentioned. We used reinforcement learning to train a vision-language model to fill in a 12-finding checklist from a chest radiograph without seeing the sentence under test; a separate checking model judged the sentence from the checklist. On held-out patients, a rule-based check and an independent medical checker, neither used in training, measured discrimination gains (Youden index) of 12.6% and 11.8%; only the rule-based check met the prespecified false-alarm criterion. Switching to the training format, which fixes finding order and enters unmentioned findings as absent, raised the training checker's measured gain and lowered the independent checker's, a prespecified comparison that yielded 6.2% (95% interval 2.0% to 10.5%) and, post hoc on held-out patients, 7.7%. Across 8 checking models, acceptance of a label-consistent negative statement about an unmentioned finding ranged from 1.0% to 97.0%. Labels were report-derived, not radiologist-adjudicated.

</details>


### [136] [DynaMesh: Dynamic 3D Texture Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05529)
*Raj Hansini,Guan Chen,Rana Hanocka,Itai Lang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynaMesh 是一种 3D 网格动态纹理生成方法，输入无纹理形状与效果文本提示，输出几何不变、纹理随时间演化的单一网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态 3D 生成侧重几何/位置变化的运动，纹理生成则把外观当作固定表面属性，均未处理在 3D 物体上传播的视觉特效。直接以视频模型加逐帧 image-to-3D 的路线会因后者无时间概念而导致闪烁、细节丢失、每帧网格不一致。

Method: 以网格渲染图和提示词条件化视频模型得到参考视频；在冻结的 image-to-3D 生成器上引入两项改动：将每帧条件在时间窗口内混合，并为每个形状拟合低秩适配器（LoRA）以恢复细节。整个序列仅编码一次网格，故几何恒定，输出为几何固定的单一网格加逐帧纹理。

Result: 在多种物体与效果上，DynaMesh 显著优于近期 video-to-4D 与纹理化方法，并能将时序特效泛化到训练未见过的不同形状。

Conclusion: DynaMesh 通过时间窗口条件混合与逐形状低秩适配，在保持几何恒定的前提下实现 3D 网格上的动态纹理特效生成，并具备跨形状泛化能力。

Abstract: We present DynaMesh, a dynamic texture generation method for 3D meshes. Given a textureless shape and a text prompt describing an effect, our method produces an appearance that evolves while the object's geometry remains unchanged. Previous works on dynamic 3D content generation have focused on motion, where an object's geometry and position change while keeping its appearance the same. Methods on texture generation sit on the other side of the problem, painting appearance onto a shape as a fixed surface property and not as an evolving process. Neither addresses a visual effect that propagates on a 3D object. A natural route consists of two generators: a video model that shows the effect from a single view, and an image-to-3D generator that lifts each frame to 3D. However, the latter has no notion of time, so running it per video frame produces a sequence that flickers, loses effect details, and yields a different mesh at every video frame. Our method addresses these failures by conditioning a video model on a render of the mesh and the prompt to obtain a reference video, then running a frozen image-to-3D generator on the video with two changes. The conditioning of each frame is blended over a temporal window, and low-rank adapters are fit per shape to restore the lost details. The mesh is encoded once for the whole sequence, so geometry is constant by construction, and the output is a single mesh with a texture per frame. Applied to various objects and effects, DynaMesh substantially improves over recent video-to-4D and texturing methods, and can generalize its temporal effect to different shapes never seen during training. Our project page is at https://threedle.github.io/dynamesh/.

</details>


### [137] [Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05531)
*Yimou Wu,Jiaxin Guo,Yun-hui Liu,Zheng Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VPGGT框架，通过先验残差连接(PRC)缓解先验稀释，并用Metric Global Attention恢复物理尺度，提升含噪声位姿下的几何感知精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身系统需要超越单图像的几何感知。现有前馈3D模型虽引入位姿、内参、深度等几何先验，但面对含噪位姿、需保持先验准确性以及恢复物理尺度等问题，仅简单接受这些输入是不够的。

Method: 基于VGGT框架，扩展OmniVGGT实现先验感知的具身感知。从真值轨迹构造传感器驱动的位姿扰动用于训练；提出无参数的先验残差连接(PRC)缓解"先验稀释"（预测精度低于所给位姿先验）；提出度量全局注意力(Metric Global Attention)，以位姿和深度尺度为条件，预测共享的度量缩放因子。扰动仅针对相机位姿，内参与深度不做额外加噪。

Result: 在四个数据集上，当所有视角均提供相机先验时，PRC在精确与受损位姿两种情况下，相较匹配的训练基线均提升了平移方向准确率和联合位姿AUC。

Conclusion: 在细化阶段显式访问先验，是特征级条件化之外的有益补充，支持先验感知的具身几何感知路线。

Abstract: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.

</details>


### [138] [Monocular markerless biomechanics for clinically interpretable gait assessment in spinal cord injury](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05552)
*Shreyasvi Natraj,Mathieu Ruepp,Yanke Li,Robert Riener,Inge Eriks-Hoogland,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究发布SCAI SCI Gait数据集（239名脊髓损伤成人，视频+动作捕捉+测力台同步），提出单目无标记方法：将参数化人体网格拟合于单个矢状面视频，通过虚拟标记驱动按人体测量缩放OpenSim模型；无标记下肢运动学与动捕高度一致，预测地面反作用力接近测力台测量；图分析显示波形成分与功能独立性条件相关，速度分层聚类揭示相同步速下的不同机械策略，表明单目视频可用于脊髓损伤患者的临床生物力学评估与数据驱动表型划分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维步态分析对脊髓损伤康复具有指导价值，但依赖标记点动作捕捉与测力台，设备门槛高，绝大多数临床机构无法开展。单目无标记流程此前仅在少数健康成人队列中得到验证，尚未在神经系统疾病队列中建立，因此需要构建面向脊髓损伤人群的数据集与方法验证。

Method: 构建SCAI SCI Gait数据集，纳入239名脊髓损伤成人，采集同步视频、动作捕捉与测力台数据；将参数化人体网格拟合到单个矢状面视角视频，由虚拟标记驱动按人体测量尺寸缩放的OpenSim模型，从而估计下肢运动学并据此预测地面反作用力；随后采用条件依赖图分析与马尔可夫毯分析波形成分与功能独立性的关联，并进行速度分层聚类。

Result: 无标记下肢运动学与动作捕捉结果达到当前最佳一致性（r = 0.68–0.90，p < 0.001，RMSE = 4.18–6.49度）；基于运动学预测的地面反作用力与测力台测量吻合良好（r = 0.85–0.87，p < 0.001，RMSE = 2.13–2.19 N/kg）。条件依赖图结合马尔可夫毯显示波形成分与功能独立性存在条件关联；速度分层聚类揭示步速相近的个体间存在不同的机械策略。

Conclusion: 单目视频可作为可扩展的临床生物力学评估手段，实现具有临床意义的运动学与动力学测量，并支持脊髓损伤患者的数据驱动表型划分，为在缺乏动作捕捉与测力台的临床环境中推广步态分析提供依据。

Abstract: Three-dimensional gait analysis guides rehabilitation after spinal cord injury but depends on marker-based motion capture and force plates, which few clinics have. Monocular markerless pipelines have been established in fewer healthy adult cohorts but not in neurological cohorts. We present the SCAI SCI Gait dataset, comprising 239 adult individuals with spinal cord injury with synchronized video, motion capture, and force-plate measurements, we fitted a parametric body mesh to a single sagittal-view video, driving an anthropometrically scaled OpenSim model via virtual markers. Markerless lower-body kinematics showed state-of-the-art agreement with motion-capture measurements (r = 0.68-0.90, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 4.18-6.49 degrees), and accurate kinematics-based predicted ground-reaction forces closely matched those measured by force plates (r = 0.85-0.87, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 2.13-2.19 Newton per kg). Furthermore, conditional-dependence graph analysis with Markov blankets revealed that waveform components were conditionally associated with functional independence, and speed-stratified clustering revealed distinct mechanical strategies among individuals walking at similar speeds. These findings establish the use of monocular video as a scalable approach for clinically meaningful biomechanical assessment and data-driven phenotyping in patients with spinal cord injury. Github: https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/SCAI-SCI-Gait

</details>


### [139] [Generating the Wild: Individual-Consistent Image-to-Video Generation for Wildlife](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05587)
*Yuzhuo Li,Di Zhao,Xinyu Zhang,Daniel Wilson,Yun Sing Koh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出高频引导的图像到视频生成框架 WildIcon，通过频率感知身份编码与轻量身份适配，在保持基础模型运动可控性的同时提升野生动物个体一致性，并构建 WildlifeVid 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野生动物个体识别面临数据稀缺问题：同一动物在不同姿态、视角、运动下的观测样本难以获取。图像到视频（I2V）生成可从单张参考图像合成额外观测以缓解该限制，但现有 I2V 模型侧重全局布局、语义与运动，难以保留区分个体的细粒度局部外观线索，如毛发纹理、条纹边界、斑点分布与轮廓过渡。作者观察到这些身份关键线索与高频信息密切相关。

Method: WildIcon 是一个高频引导的 I2V 框架：引入频率感知身份编码分支，从参考图像中提取个体特异的高频线索；结合隔离的前景信息生成身份 token，并将其作为身份条件注入 cross-attention 模块。方法基于冻结的骨干网络并施加轻量身份适配，从而在保留参考图像中细粒度身份线索的同时，维持基础 I2V 模型的运动可控性与语义保真度。此外构建 WildlifeVid 数据集，包含高质量、时序连贯的视频片段与个体级身份标签，以支持训练与评测。

Result: 在 I2V 生成与下游动物重识别（ReID）任务上的实验表明，WildIcon 相比现有基线具有更强的个体一致性；其经过滤的输出可作为下游 ReID 的有效候选训练增强数据。

Conclusion: 高频信息是野生动物个体身份一致性的关键载体，显式建模高频身份线索并配合轻量适配，可在不牺牲基础模型生成能力的前提下显著提升 I2V 的个体一致性，并为数据稀缺场景下的下游 ReID 提供数据增强支持。

Abstract: Individual-level wildlife identification often suffers from data scarcity, as varying observations of the same animal under diverse poses, viewpoints, and motions are rarely available. Image-to-video (I2V) generation offers a promising way to mitigate this limitation by synthesizing additional observations from a single reference image. However, existing I2V models mainly emphasize global layout, semantics, and motion, and therefore often fail to preserve fine-grained local appearance cues that distinguish one wildlife individual from another, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions. We observe that these identity-critical cues are closely related to high-frequency information. To address this challenge, we propose WildIcon, a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for wildlife individual consistency. Specifically, WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that extracts individual-specific high-frequency cues from the reference image. Combined with isolated foreground information, the resulting identity tokens are then injected into cross-attention blocks as identity conditioning. Building on a frozen backbone with lightweight identity adaptation, WildIcon preserves fine-grained identity cues visible in the reference image while retaining the motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the base I2V model. In addition, to support the training and evaluation of wildlife individual-consistent I2V, we construct WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset with high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual-level identity labels. Experiments on I2V generation and downstream animal re-identification (ReID) show that WildIcon achieves stronger individual consistency than existing baselines, and that its filtered outputs can serve as useful candidate training augmentations for downstream ReID.

</details>


### [140] [EchoDino: A pediatric foundation model for transferable echocardiographic analysis across the lifespan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05603)
*Sheng Cheng,Donnchadh M. O'Sullivan,Daniel J. Penny,Craig G. Rusin,Minh B. Nguyen,Devika Subramanian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EchoDino是一个基于DINOv3框架、在370万帧/170万段未标注儿科超声心动图视频上自监督预训练的基础模型，冻结编码器即可在跨年龄段九个数据集上全面超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声心动图解读需同时整合全局解剖、局部结构与动态运动信息，而现有机器学习模型多为单一任务定制，且依赖昂贵的标注数据；儿科场景下数据稀缺、解剖随年龄变化，这一瓶颈尤为突出。

Method: 将DINOv3框架适配到370万帧、来自170万段未标注儿科超声心动图视频上，进行自监督预训练得到EchoDino；提出运动偏置熵最大化采样（MEMS），为视频级分析挑选信息量最大的帧；使用时冻结编码器作为通用表征提取器。

Result: 在九个儿科与成人数据集上优于强基线：视图分类准确率0.609→0.889；结构性心脏病检测AUC 0.811→0.872；年龄估计误差3.857→1.389年；取得最佳分割精度并降低射血分数误差。

Conclusion: EchoDino证明可从无标注儿科数据泛化到成人超声心动图，为覆盖全生命周期的通用心脏图像分析提供了基础模型，缓解了标注稀缺与跨年龄段迁移的难题。

Abstract: Echocardiography is the most widely used cardiac imaging modality, yet interpretation demands integrating visual evidence across global anatomy, localized structures and dynamic cardiac motion. Machine-learning models have automated individual tasks, but they are typically built for a single purpose and depend on expensively labeled datasets - a barrier particularly acute in pediatric care, where data are scarce and anatomy changes with age. Here we present EchoDino, a self-supervised foundation model for echocardiography, created by adapting the DINOv3 framework to 3.7 million frames from 1.7 million unlabeled pediatric echocardiography videos. With its encoder frozen, EchoDino produces representations that capture global context, local anatomy, and dense spatial detail. We introduce Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) to select the most informative frames for video-level analysis. Across nine pediatric and adult datasets, EchoDino outperformed strong baseline models, raising view-classification accuracy from 0.609 to 0.889 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for structural-heart-disease detection from 0.811 to 0.872, while also cutting age-estimation error from 3.857 to 1.389 years, achieving the best segmentation accuracy and lowering ejection-fraction errors. By generalizing from label-free pediatric data to adult echocardiography, EchoDino offers a versatile foundation for cardiac image analysis across the lifespan.

</details>


### [141] [Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05608)
*Team Kandinsky,Julia Agafonova,Bulat Akhmatov,Mikhail Aksyutin,Grigorii Alekseenko,Anastasia Aliaskina,Olga Androsova,Vladimir Arkhipkin,Anna Averchenkova,Alexander Belykh,Serafima Bocharova,Sofiya Bogakovskaya,Anton Bukashkin,Mark Bulygin,Kirill Buzygin,Irina Cheremnykh,Kirill Chernyshev,Mikhail Chernyshov,Vladimir Chernyy,David Chikovani,Georgy Daniltsev,Denis Dimitrov,Anna Dmitrienko,Vladimir Dokholyan,Sergey Emelyanov,Dmitry Ermilov,Georgii Fedorov,Polina Gavrilova,Nikolai Gerasimenko,Aleksandr Gordeev,Andrey Inozemtsev,Andrei Ivaniuta,Alexander Ivanov,Mikhail Karaev,Anastasiia Kargapoltseva,Ivan Kirillov,Nikita Kiselev,Valeria Kobenko,Yury Kolabushin,Denis Koposov,Anatoly Korobov,Vladimir Korviakov,Kirill Kozlov,Denis Krzhivokolskiy,Konstantin Kuklev,Alexander Kunitsyn,Sergey Kuzin,Vladislav Lakhtionov,Alexey Letunovskiy,Maxim Litvinov,Alexander Lyulkov,Georgy Makarov,Kirill Malakhov,Egor Malykh,Mikhail Mamaev,Dmitrii Mikhailov,Polina Mikhailova,Ivan Mikheev,Elizaveta Muromtseva,Nikolai Nazarkin,Tatiana Nikulina,Lev Novitskiy,Stanislav Onuchin,Nikita Osterov,Denis Parkhomenko,Anatoliy Parpara,Vladimir Polovnikov,Konstantin Reznikov,Azat Saginbaev,Nikita Samsonov,Alexander Sentsov,Nikita Shaimov,Artem Sherstyuk,Andrey Shutkin,Egor Silvestrov,Bulat Suleimanov,Matvey Suprunov,Sergey Taranov,Irina Tolstykh,Tatiana Trofimuk,Ilya Trushkin,Aleksandra Tsybina,Olga Varlashina,Viacheslav Vasilev,Ilya Vasiliev,Eugeny Vilisov,Sergey Yakubson,Konstantin Zakharov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 系列（Lite 3B / Pro 29B）基础扩散模型，实现文本/图像到音视频同步生成，5 秒 44kHz 音频并含唇形同步，内置超分至 Full-HD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推动多媒体生成的开源研究与部署，并解决视频与音频在时间与语义上难以同步对齐的问题，在保持单模态保真度的前提下实现统一的音视频联合生成。

Method: 在 Kandinsky 5.0 视频生成能力基础上，采用双流 CrossDiT 架构，以双向交叉注意力连接预训练视频流与新训练音频流；连续预训练策略先在大规模音频语料上从头训练音频流，再在成对音视频数据上联合训练；随后进行监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练与蒸馏。

Result: 支持 T2AV 与 I2AV 两种模式，生成 5 秒、44kHz 同步音频（含唇形同步），并通过内置超分达到 1920×1080；人工并排评测中 Pro 明显优于 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与领先音视频生成模型保持竞争力，尤其在语音质量方面。

Conclusion: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 通过双流 CrossDiT 与分阶段训练实现了高质量同步音视频生成；代码、模型权重与 diffusers 集成以 MIT 许可发布，以促进开源研究与部署。

Abstract: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920$\times$1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

</details>


### [142] [StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05664)
*Anh Dao,Quan-Dung Pham,Le Danh Vinh,The Anh Nguyen,Nguyen Viet Tri Pham,Yiyu Chen,Pham Tuyen Le,Van-Truong Nguyen,Quan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StageVLN通过训练时的特权空间与轨迹引导塑造导航表征，推理时移除全部辅助组件，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上以4B骨干取得竞争性性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN策略虽受益于大型视觉语言模型的语义先验，但标准动作监督并未显式约束中间表征保留场景几何、相对朝向或全局导航进度；而在推理阶段引入深度估计器、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型虽能提供此类结构信息，却带来额外计算、内存开销与架构依赖。

Method: 提出StageVLN训练框架：冻结的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层级空间引导；相对朝向（relative-heading）与专家路径进度（expert-route progress）目标提供互补的轨迹状态监督。所有辅助组件仅在训练阶段使用，部署时移除，保持原始推理通路不变。

Result: 在R2R-CE验证未见集上，以4B参数骨干实现56.3% SR与51.4% SPL，且推理时无需额外几何编码器；在RxR-CE上实现54.3% SR，未使用额外导航训练数据，推理时亦无几何编码器。

Conclusion: 通过训练期特权引导注入空间与轨迹结构、推理期保持轻量原始通路，StageVLN在不增加部署开销的前提下有效提升了VLN策略的导航性能。

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

</details>


### [143] [Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05707)
*Zhicheng Ding,Xinyu Chu,Qing Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DFM-KD，一种面向Transformer视觉目标跟踪的关系型知识蒸馏框架，通过迁移样本间特征差异而非逐点绝对激活来对齐特征空间关系结构，从而提升学生模型的鲁棒性与跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶感知对跟踪系统有严格的延迟与功耗约束，Transformer跟踪器虽精度领先，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署在实时、资源受限平台。传统特征蒸馏仅最小化教师与学生的逐点差异，未充分迁移特征空间的关系结构。

Method: DFM-KD：一种针对Transformer跟踪器的关系型蒸馏框架。不同于逐点（如MSE）对齐，它以样本间特征差异为蒸馏对象，迁移教师对跨样本外观变化与一致性的建模方式，使学生学习batch内的视觉变化结构动态，而非强行拟合绝对激活。

Result: 大量实验表明，DFM-KD在跟踪精度与成功率上均持续优于传统特征级蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 通过关系型特征差异蒸馏，学生模型获得更强的特征鲁棒性与更优跟踪性能，为资源受限下的Transformer跟踪器部署提供了有效压缩与迁移途径。

Abstract: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.

</details>


### [144] [Rotated, but How Far? Diagnosing and Improving Object-Rotation Reasoning in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05715)
*Zhaochen Wang,Yujun Cai,Huangbo Zou,Hower Yang,Naipeng Dong,Miao Xu,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出细粒度物体旋转推理基准OR-Bench，发现VLMs存在"规范角塌缩"现象，并通过RotationCue解码器复用模型自身表示改善旋转推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）能检测物体在跨视角下发生了旋转，却无法可靠判断旋转幅度。既有评测缺乏细粒度的旋转推理基准，且对该能力缺陷的成因缺乏机制性分析。

Method: 1）构建OR-Bench基准，涵盖旋转检测、旋转幅度估计与多视角旋转推理三类共八项任务；2）评测12个VLMs；3）通过表征探测（representation probing）分析旋转信息可恢复性，并对比线性探针与模型生成答案；4）提出RotationCue——一个轻量解码器，从VLM冻结表征中恢复粗粒度旋转信息，并作为中间文本上下文反馈给模型。

Result: 最强模型在旋转检测上接近100%准确率，但粗粒度幅度估计接近随机水平；要求精确角度时，91.8–100%的预测集中在0°、90°、180°，即"规范角塌缩"，且无视觉输入时依然存在。表征探测显示粗粒度旋转信息仍大量可恢复，线性探针优于模型自身生成答案。RotationCue在三个VLM上提升了全部模型–任务组合，宏平均准确率提高7.9–12.6个百分点，同时保持通用能力。

Conclusion: VLMs的旋转推理失败并非完全源于信息缺失，而是未能充分利用已编码的旋转信息；将模型自身表征中的粗粒度旋转线索以文本形式回馈，可有效缓解规范角塌缩并提升细粒度旋转推理性能。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can detect that an object has rotated across views, but cannot reliably tell by how much. We introduce OR-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark for object-rotation reasoning with eight tasks covering rotation detection, rotation magnitude estimation, and multi-view rotation reasoning. Across 12 VLMs, the gap is stark: the strongest models approach 100% accuracy on detection, yet even coarse magnitude estimation is near chance. When asked for exact angles, models place 91.8--100% of their predictions on just $0^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $180^\circ$, a failure we term canonical-angle collapse. This collapse persists even without visual input. Representation probing shows that missing information is only part of the explanation. Although rotation information becomes less recoverable at finer granularity, substantial coarse-grained information remains, and a simple linear probe outperforms the models' generated answers. This suggests that VLMs underuse rotation information they already encode. We therefore propose RotationCue, a lightweight decoder that recovers coarse rotation information from the VLM's own frozen representations and feeds it back to the model as intermediate textual context. Across three VLMs, RotationCue improves every model--task combination on OR-Bench, raising macro-average accuracy by 7.9--12.6 points while preserving general capabilities.

</details>


### [145] [T-JEPA: A Temporal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Learning Better Remote Sensing Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05731)
*Bowen Peng,Li Liu,Yongxiang Liu,Weijie Li,Jie Zhou,Zhen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出T-JEPA，一种时间联合嵌入预测架构，利用地球观测序列中稀疏、非均匀的时间采样作为监督信号，学习以时间间隔为条件的潜在状态转移，在静态与时间任务上取得领先的迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遥感基础模型主要依赖预定义的成对关系或整体重建上下文来利用时序观测，未能充分利用地球观测序列中固有的稀疏、非均匀时间采样所蕴含的监督信号。

Method: T-JEPA由共享单帧编码器处理每个观测，时序预测器从掩码源潜在表示与实际经过时间估计完整目标潜在场；通过跨多个时间间隔的预测约束将观测状态组织为结构化潜在轨迹；采用非对称元数据注入缓解捷径学习；直接多时间尺度监督优于递归展开中间状态；并行引入掩码像素重建以保留空间细节。

Result: 在匹配预训练数据与吞吐量条件下，T-JEPA在静态任务与时间任务上均取得领先的迁移性能；分析表明其表示具有依赖时间间隔的转移可预测性与连贯的潜在动态，同时保持跨周期一致性、表示多样性和语义判别性。

Conclusion: T-JEPA通过时间间隔条件的潜在转移预测，有效挖掘了地球观测数据的时序监督信号，学习到结构化的潜在动态表示，为遥感基础模型的自监督预训练提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Earth observation (EO) data provide rich temporal supervision, yet existing remote sensing foundation models mainly exploit sequential observations through imposing predefined pairwise relations or aggregating holistic reconstruction context. We seek to further exploit the sparse and nonuniform temporal sampling inherent in EO sequences as supervisory signals. To this end, we propose T-JEPA, a temporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns time-gap-conditioned latent transitions. A shared single-frame encoder processes each observation, while a temporal predictor estimates the complete target latent field from a masked source latent representation and the actual elapsed time. Across multiple temporal intervals, these predictive constraints organize observed states into structured latent trajectories. Asymmetric metadata injection mitigates shortcut learning, and direct supervision across multiple temporal scales proves more effective than recursively rolling out intermediate states. In parallel, masked pixel reconstruction provides complementary supervision for preserving spatial details. Under matched pre-training data and throughput, T-JEPA achieves leading transfer performance on both static and temporal tasks. Analyses further reveal that T-JEPA learns representations with time-gap-dependent transition predictability and coherent latent dynamics, while maintaining strong cross-period consistency, representation diversity, and semantic discriminability.

</details>


### [146] [HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05739)
*Zhuokun Chen,Feng Chen,Xi Lin,Xiyu Wu,Jiahao He,Jianfei Cai,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练混合线性注意力框架HLA-WM，通过几何引导的粗粒度检索与细粒度递归线性状态计算，缓解Gated DeltaNet的长程遗忘，在长时视频世界模型中提升场景一致性并大幅降低历史状态内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程视频世界模型需持久记忆以维持场景一致性。Softmax注意力依赖不断增长的KV缓存保留全部生成历史，内存开销大；递归线性注意力将历史压缩为固定大小状态，内存成本低。但作者发现Gated DeltaNet（GDN）存在严重的长程遗忘：远处但相关的场景信息会被后续状态更新逐渐衰减。

Method: 提出HLA-WM，一种免训练的混合线性注意力框架：利用GDN的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块（chunk-wise）转移摘要；用相机几何检索与当前场景相关的历史分块（粗粒度几何引导检索）；将其重组为查询特定的递归状态（细粒度递归线性状态计算）。

Result: 在60秒SANA-WM-Bench上，无需额外训练即提升基础自回归生成器全部六项重访一致性与相机控制指标，包括0.74 dB的PSNR增益和28.5%的旋转误差降低；在下游精修后仍保持提升。泛化到MBench-A：在547个样本、全部四个子集和所有推理模式下一致提升三项重访一致性指标。60秒上下文下，历史状态内存相对全KV缓存降低12倍，推理吞吐最多仅下降1.6%。

Conclusion: 可选择性寻址的递归记忆能改善长程场景召回，同时保留GDN的效率优势，证明粗粒度几何检索与细粒度线性状态计算的混合设计是有效且高效的方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

</details>


### [147] [Robust Local Optimization Done Right](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05743)
*James Pritts,Kevin Köser*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统解耦了RANSAC假设选择与局部优化(LO)，分析稳健损失形状、内点尺度误设与优化策略对本质矩阵、基础矩阵和单应估计的影响，并提出剖面边缘评分与联合半二次优化相结合的RANSAC框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RANSAC的评分与局部优化对稳健性的要求不同，因此需要将假设选择与精化分离；但内点尺度误设、损失形状与优化策略如何分别影响选择与精化尚不明确，且“评分与精化目标应一致”的既有认知值得检验。

Method: 提出剖面边缘评分(profile-marginal score)，边缘化干扰的内点尺度并选取内点划分，据此估计LO损失宽度；对比分析不同稳健损失形状、内点尺度误设及多种优化策略（依赖当前残差重加权、宽吸引域方法、联合半二次优化）在本质矩阵、基础矩阵与单应估计中的表现。

Result: LO对内点尺度设过大的情况具有稳健性，但尺度设过小会损害选择本身；精化需要来自种子当前拒绝的对应点的梯度；仅靠吸引域大小不足以评估RANSAC LO；联合半二次优化在各类模型中最一致；与剖面边缘评分匹配且使其单调不降的优化器并未取得最佳精度。最终方法在内点尺度正确时将PhotoTourism上本质矩阵位姿误差中位数从2.23度降至1.58度，尺度严重误设(128倍过大)时从38度降至6.2度。

Conclusion: 评分与精化目标相匹配并非达到最优精度的必要条件，挑战了既有准则；分离假设选择与精化、并采用剖面边缘评分结合联合半二次优化，可显著提升RANSAC在尺度误设下的鲁棒性与精度。

Abstract: RANSAC scoring and local optimization (LO) impose different robustness requirements, motivating the separation of hypothesis selection from refinement. We systematically isolate the effects of robust-loss shape, incorrectly specified inlier scales, and optimization strategy on essential matrix, fundamental matrix, and homography estimation. A profile-marginal score marginalizes the nuisance inlier scale and selects an inlier partition, from which we estimate the scale that sets the LO loss width; this makes LO robust to an inlier scale specified too large, whereas one specified too small degrades selection itself. Refinement needs gradient from correspondences the seed currently rejects: optimizers that reweight from current residuals stay pinned to their seed, whereas methods with broad basins recover strongly perturbed seeds yet degrade accurate score-selected hypotheses, so basin size alone is insufficient to assess RANSAC LO. Joint half-quadratic optimization balances the two and is the most consistent strategy across model classes. An optimizer matched to the profile-marginal score, which never decreases it, does not reach the best accuracy, challenging the prescription that scoring and refinement objectives should match. Composed from these findings, our RANSAC reduces the median essential-matrix pose error of a state-of-the-art RANSAC on PhotoTourism from 2.23 degrees to 1.58 degrees with a correctly specified inlier scale and from 38 degrees to 6.2 degrees when it is grossly misspecified (128x too large).

</details>


### [148] [A new design of a fall detection system integrating landmark identification and deep learning techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05749)
*Tri Nhut Do,Thi Thuy Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种融合关键点识别与深度学习的跌倒检测系统，利用MediaPipe进行空间识别以区分日常动作与真实跌倒，实验显示实时检测率达95%，训练精度在第40轮趋于稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升跌倒检测的准确性与可靠性，减少误报，实现对真实跌倒的及时响应，从而增强老年人的安全性与独立性，服务于养老护理与智能健康监测场景。

Method: 将关键点识别与深度学习预测算法相结合；采用MediaPipe等先进计算机视觉技术进行空间识别，区分常规动作与真实跌倒，从而降低误报率。

Result: 训练过程中准确率稳步上升并在第40个周期趋于稳定，误差率在初始周期显著下降；实时实验中，8至50岁的男女参与者测试取得95%的跌倒检测率，验证了系统在多种场景下的通用性。

Conclusion: 该系统在跌倒检测中表现出较高的有效性与鲁棒性，在养老护理和智能健康监测环境具有广阔的应用前景。

Abstract: This article introduces an innovative system that integrates landmark identification with deep learning to enhance fall detection accuracy and reliability. By utilizing advanced computer vision techniques, such as Media Pipe for spatial recognition, the system effectively differentiates between routine movements and actual falls. The integration of landmarks with a deep learning prediction algorithm minimizes false alarms, ensuring timely responses to genuine falls. Comprehensive experimentation underscores the system's versatility across various scenarios, emphasizing its potential to improve safety and independence for older adults. The training process demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy, stabilizing by the 40th cycle, while error rates decline significantly during the initial cycles. Real-time experiments, involving both male and female participants aged 8 to 50, recorded a remarkable 95% detection rate of falls, demonstrating the system's effectiveness and promising future applications in elder care and smart health monitoring environments.

</details>


### [149] [Vision-enabled detection of safety helmet compliance in construction zones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05756)
*Tri Nhut Do*,Ba Loc Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于YOLOv8的视觉实时安全帽佩戴检测系统，用于施工现场头部伤害风险防控，验证集mAP@0.5精度超过97%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 施工管理中工人安全是首要任务，安全帽佩戴的依从性监管需要自动化手段；传统人工巡查难以实时、全面覆盖，故需借助计算机视觉与深度学习实现实时检测，降低头部伤害风险。

Method: 采用YOLO（you only look once）框架，结合先进计算机视觉技术与机器学习算法；利用部署在战略性位置的高分辨率摄像头视频流，基于深度学习方法识别未佩戴安全帽的人员。

Result: 训练与验证结果显示，对佩戴与未佩戴安全帽两类个体的检测精度在mAP@0.5上超过97%；实验表明系统在不同光照条件和多样工人运动下具有优异的检测准确性与鲁棒性；训练过程中损失持续下降、指标持续提升。

Conclusion: YOLOv8模型在提升识别性能方面有效；研究意义超出单纯的法规合规，为职业安全管理创新应用提供方向，凸显技术在保护生命中的作用，并为智慧工地环境的未来发展奠定基础。

Abstract: In the rapidly evolving field of construction management, worker safety remains a top priority. This paper introduces an innovative vision-based system for real-time detection of helmet compliance, specifically designed for construction sites, utilizing advanced computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms within the YOLO (you only look once) framework. Our system leverages high-resolution video feeds from strategically positioned cameras to monitor adherence to safety regulations regarding helmet usage. By employing deep learning methodologies, the system effectively identifies individuals not wearing helmets, thereby significantly mitigating the risk of head injuries among workers. Our training and validation results revealed an impressive precision exceeding 97% at mAP@0.5 for both helmeted and non-helmeted individuals. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate exceptional detection accuracy, demonstrating the system's resilience under varying lighting conditions and diverse worker movements. The consistent decrease in loss and improvement in metrics throughout training validates the effectiveness of the YOLOv8 model in enhancing recognition performance. The implications of this research extend beyond mere regulatory compliance, opening avenues for innovative applications in occupational safety management. This study highlights the critical role of technology in protecting lives and lays the groundwork for future advancements in smart construction environments.

</details>


### [150] [A Three-Dimensional Reverse-Projection Method for Sparse Point Cloud Completion and Its Application to High-Speed Train Nose Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05758)
*Xiaozhen Ma,Zhao Tang,Hanbin Lai,Ruiqi Chen,Jin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对含玻璃窗环境LiDAR扫描中的孔洞与稀疏采样问题，提出一套点云获取—滤波—补全—曲面重建流程，在高铁车头缩比模型上完成验证，实现玻璃窗区域缺失点云的填补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 含玻璃窗环境的LiDAR扫描会产生孔洞（玻璃窗区域缺失）和稀疏采样，这是三维重建中尚未解决的问题；同时高铁车头几何的非接触数字化建模存在实际需求。

Method: 流程为：FAST-LIVO2通过多传感器里程计与建图提供初始点云；用移动最小二乘（MLS）平滑观测；提出基于三轴投影的细分与插值，并结合反向孔洞边界识别（三轴反向补全），从每个孔洞周围的观测插值缺失区域；随后用贪婪投影三角化、泊松曲面重建和基于Marching Cubes的流程由补全点云生成网格。

Result: 在高铁车头比例缩比展示模型实验中，所提方法能够填补玻璃窗周围的缺失点云区域；在本研究的评价设置下，贪婪投影三角化相比另外两种重建流程具有更低的几何距离误差。

Conclusion: 该流程支持车头几何的非接触数字化建模，为含玻璃窗物体的重建提供了实用方法。

Abstract: Holes in LiDAR scans of environments with glass windows remain an unresolved problem in three-dimensional reconstruction. This study presents a pipeline for point cloud acquisition, filtering, completion, and surface reconstruction to address sparse sampling and missing window regions in scans of a high-speed train nose. FAST-LIVO2 provides the initial point cloud through multisensor odometry and mapping, and moving least squares (MLS) smooths the observations. We then introduce three-axis projection-based subdivision and interpolation with reverse hole boundary identification, referred to as three-axis reverse completion. The method interpolates missing regions from observations around each hole. Greedy projection triangulation, Poisson surface reconstruction, and a Marching Cubes-based pipeline generate meshes from the completed point cloud. Experiments on a proportionally scaled display model of a high-speed train nose show that the proposed method fills missing point cloud regions around the glass windows. Under the evaluation setting used in this study, greedy projection triangulation yields lower geometric distance errors than the other two reconstruction pipelines. The pipeline supports non-contact digital modeling of train nose geometry and provides a practical approach to reconstructing objects with glass windows.

</details>


### [151] [Controllable Road Marking Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05771)
*Zhiyu,Cai,Yufan Zhang,Ruichen Tan,Zengxiang Lei,Satish Ukkusuri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"可控道路标线生成"任务与条件BEV生成管线，从可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线和文本描述生成缺失的中心区域标线布局，在Argoverse 2与Waymo上显著超越适配的SOTA掩码精修基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车道与道路标线对车辆导航和多智能体协同至关重要，但大规模制作仍依赖人工流程，限制了定量分析与场景测试。因此需要可自动、可控地生成道路标线布局的方法。

Method: 构建基于确定性、元数据派生提示的基准，输出车道分隔线、道路分隔线和人行横道三类通道。条件鸟瞰图（BEV）管线包含三部分：(i) 文本条件潜空间rectified-flow DiT，配合拓扑感知辅助损失训练；(ii) 高斯模糊训练目标以稳定细、稀疏标线的学习；(iii) 免训练后处理Structured Gaussian Render（SGR），通过提取折线、拟合三次Bézier曲线并重渲染为各向异性超高斯基元来恢复锐利的标线几何。

Result: 在4,597个Argoverse 2测试tile上，Buffered F1达80.8、clDice达50.2，而适配的SOTA掩码精修基线仅为38.8和24.6；在Waymo数据集上取得88.0 Buffered F1与66.2 clDice。消融实验表明拓扑感知监督与SGR带来互补的连通性增益。文本编辑实验显示更强引导提升编辑成功率，但同时增加对非目标结构的改动。

Conclusion: 该框架是可仿真道路标线变化、自动化地图补全和早期基础设施设计探索的推进性一步。

Abstract: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings. We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.

</details>


### [152] [InteractionBench: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Streaming Video Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05775)
*Enxin Song,Suhao Yu,Yifei Xu,Barbara Su,Weili Xu,Wenhao Chai,Yao Tang,Jie Deng,Haiyang Xu,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 InteractionBench，一个评估视频助手“该说时说、该静默时静默”决策能力的基准，涵盖查询响应、事件触发与持续更新，共 1060 次交互、812 个视频。结果显示及时说话会牺牲静默合规性，现有系统均难以兼顾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频助手需要在指令要求响应时发声、否则保持静默，但现有评估缺乏对完整系统（模型+记忆+响应控制器）在“发声时机与静默”这一决策上的系统性衡量，离线指标也无法预测在线行为。

Method: 构建 InteractionBench 基准，包含 69 条负样本流与 53 个测试套件（将可计数事件与易混淆的近似未命中配对），在视频时钟上对内容准确性、时机准确性和静默合规性评分。

Result: Polled Qwen3-VL-8B 时机准确率 77.8% 但静默合规仅 10.9%；原生实时交互系统静默合规 29.2%、时机准确率 66.8%，却在 89.9% 的负样本流上发声；无开源权重系统通过三分之一近似未命中套件；随机删除回复只是以时机换静默。

Conclusion: 离线分数无法捕捉这些失败并误判在线行为；增加克制代价高昂，原生系统控制器自身贡献甚微，智能体系统需约 30 秒每次轮询才能实现，凸显了视频助手“适时发声与静默”权衡的挑战。

Abstract: A video assistant must speak when its instruction warrants a response and stay silent otherwise. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates this decision for the complete system of model, memory, and response controller. InteractionBench covers query responses, event triggers, and ongoing updates in 1,060 interactions over 812 videos, with 69 negative streams and 53 suites that pair counted events with look-alike near misses. It scores content accuracy, timing accuracy, and silence compliance on the video clock. Timely speech costs silence across systems. Polled Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 77.8 timing accuracy but 10.9 silence compliance. A native real-time interaction system reaches 29.2 silence compliance at 66.8 timing accuracy, yet emits on 89.9% of negative streams. No open-weight system clears a third of the near-miss suites. Fewer replies help only when chosen, as random deletion merely trades timing for silence. Offline scores miss these failures and mispredict online behavior. Adding restraint is costly, as the native system's controller adds little by itself and agentic systems add it only at about 30 s per poll.Project page: https://www.enxinsong.com/projects/interactionbench/ Code: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/InteractionBench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InteractionBench/InteractionBench

</details>


### [153] [A Spatiotemporal Semantic Importance-Guided Unified Compression and Editing Framework for AI-Generated Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05779)
*Xihua Sheng,Dong Liu,Chang Wen Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向AI生成视频的统一压缩与编辑框架，以冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三项时空语义重要性引导技术，分别解决传输什么、传输多少以及如何利用传输的边信息，从而实现语义保持的高效压缩与基于提示的编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成视频在数量、时长和分辨率上快速增长，带来存储与传输压力。与自然视频不同，AI生成视频是学习到的生成分布中的样本，其语义结构决定内容一致性，而大量局部纹理与随机细节可被合理再生。因此压缩不应追求逐像素重建特定生成样本，而应保留语义重要的时空信息。同时，用户存在基于提示编辑生成视频、同时保持原有时空语义的实际需求。这些观察促使作者构建统一的压缩与编辑框架。

Method: 框架引入冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三项时空语义重要性引导技术：1）创新选择方法，利用时空语义重要性投影潜空间差异，使被选中的创新优先保留语义不变量而非可替换的生成变化；2）帧自适应比特分配方法，估计潜帧的非均匀语义需求，为需要更强语义保持的帧分配更多创新；3）统一重建与编辑方法，连续调整所传输边信息的影响强度，使同一压缩表示既能为忠实重建提供强引导，也可作为结构保持的提示驱动编辑的灵活语义锚点。

Result: 摘要未给出具体定量实验结果。文中指出该框架可使同一压缩表示同时支持忠实重建与结构保持的提示驱动编辑，并通过语义重要性引导提升压缩效率与语义保持能力。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将冻结视频生成器作为生成先验，并以时空语义重要性统一指导压缩与编辑，可兼顾AI生成视频的高效传输与语义保持的提示编辑需求。

Abstract: AI-generated videos are rapidly increasing in volume, duration, and resolution, creating growing demands for efficient storage and transmission. Unlike natural videos captured from the physical world, AI-generated videos are samples from a learned generative distribution, where semantic structures are critical to content consistency, while many local textures and stochastic details can be plausibly regenerated. This distinction suggests that compression should preserve semantically important spatiotemporal information rather than reconstruct every pixel of a particular generative sample. Beyond reconstruction, AI-generated videos also create a practical need for prompt-based editing, where users expect to modify generated content while preserving its original spatiotemporal semantics. Motivated by these observations, we propose a unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos that incorporates a frozen video generator as a reusable generative prior. Within this framework, we design three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques that respectively address what to transmit, how much to transmit, and how to use the transmitted side information. First, an innovation selection method projects the latent discrepancy using spatiotemporal semantic importance, so that the selected innovations prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method estimates the nonuniform semantic demands of latent frames and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, a unified reconstruction and editing method continuously adjusts the influence of the transmitted side information, enabling the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for faithful reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for structure-preserving prompt-driven editing.

</details>


### [154] [FairRSFM: A Biome-Aware Benchmark and Debiasing Framework for Remote Sensing Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05790)
*Md Aminur Hossain,Omkumar Vaghasiya,Rajeev Ranjan Dwivedi,Vinod Kurmi,Biplab Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FairRSFM生物群系感知基准，揭示遥感基础模型聚合指标掩盖的生态区域性能差异，并提供可复用的诊断与缓解协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感基础模型通常使用聚合指标评估，会掩盖跨生态区域的系统性性能差异，缺乏针对生态群组鲁棒性的评估手段。

Method: 将14个陆地生物群系类别的地理参考样本映射为6个生态宏组，在统一冻结骨干评估协议下，覆盖m-EuroSAT、m-BigEarthNet、m-SA-Crop-Type和MMEarth20K（Dynamic World标签图）四个下游数据集，并在Prithvi-EO-2.0、SatMAE、DOFA三种模型与三个随机种子上评测；同时引入BOLP、DBR和GroupDRO三种缓解基线。
