Result: 聚合性能在各架构与任务上一致地掩盖了生物群系相关差异。例如Prithvi-EO-2.0在m-EuroSAT上整体macro-F1达90.98%，但平均最差组分数仅83.72%；m-SA-Crop-Type从整体mIoU 27.30%降至Xeric and Mineralogical组的18.47%。缓解方法效果依赖模型与任务，如BOLP在不更新骨干的情况下将Prithvi-EO-2.0在m-BigEarthNet上的worst-group F1@opt从46.12%提升至50.27%。

Conclusion: FairRSFM为诊断和缓解遥感基础模型的生态鲁棒性差距提供了可复用协议，代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) are commonly evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide systematic performance disparities across ecological regions. We introduce FairRSFM, a biome-aware benchmark for evaluating ecological group robustness in RSFMs. FairRSFM maps georeferenced samples from 14 terrestrial biome classes into six ecologically meaningful macro-groups and evaluates models under a unified frozen-backbone evaluation protocol. The benchmark covers four downstream datasets: m-EuroSAT, m-BigEarthNet, m-SA-Crop-Type, and MMEarth20K with Dynamic World label maps. Using Prithvi-EO-2.0, SatMAE, and DOFA across three random seeds, we show that aggregate performance consistently masks biome-dependent disparities across architectures and tasks. For example, Prithvi-EO-2.0 reaches 90.98% overall macro-F1 on m-EuroSAT but a mean worst-group score of only 83.72%, while m-SA-Crop-Type drops from 27.30% overall mIoU to 18.47% in the Xeric and Mineralogical group. We further evaluate Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing (BOLP), Dynamic Biome Reweighting (DBR), and GroupDRO as complementary mitigation baselines. Their effectiveness is model- and task-dependent; for example, BOLP improves Prithvi-EO-2.0 worst-group F1@opt on m-BigEarthNet from 46.12% to 50.27% without updating the RSFM backbone. FairRSFM provides a reusable protocol for diagnosing and mitigating ecological robustness gaps in remote sensing foundation models. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/aminurhossain/FairRSFM.

</details>


### [155] [Gauss-Map Variation for Image Denoising: Geometric Analysis and an Anderson--Accelerated Majorization--Minimization Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05801)
*Haibin Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GMV图像去噪模型，度量缩放图像图切平面投影的空间变化，具备边缘与角点保持能力，并设计Anderson加速MM算法求解，理论上证明收敛到临界点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像去噪正则化在保持边缘和角点（尤其是角点对比度）方面存在不足，需要一种能刻画图像图几何结构变化的正则项，以更好地保留边界特征。

Method: 1) 提出Gauss-map variation (GMV)模型，度量缩放图像图切平面投影的空间变化，并给出基于Gauss map的等价正则表示；2) 利用管状坐标(tubular coordinates)与Frenet标架等微分几何工具，分析其在一般C^2及分段C^2边界上的行为；3) 引入由单位法向量场与标量幅值场组成的双线性分解；4) 设计Anderson加速的majorization-minimization (MM)算法，法向量子问题具显式逐点MM更新，并结合Anderson加速。

Result: 理论上，正则项分析给出边缘与角点对比度保持性质；对L^1与L^2数据保真项，证明迭代的充分下降性与有界性，并证明序列收敛到惩罚模型的临界点。数值实验（合成与自然图像）表明模型具有边界保持能力，在去除高斯噪声与脉冲噪声方面表现有竞争力。

Conclusion: GMV模型通过图切平面投影的几何变化度量实现边缘与角点保持，配合Anderson加速MM算法获得良好去噪性能，且具备收敛性理论保证。

Abstract: We propose a Gauss-map variation (GMV) model for image denoising that measures the spatial variation of the tangent-plane projectors of the scaled image graph. We establish an equivalent representation of the regularizer in terms of the corresponding Gauss map and, using differential geometric tools including tubular coordinates and the Frenet frame, analyze its behavior across general $C^2$ and piecewise $C^2$ boundaries. The resulting estimates provide edge- and corner-contrast preservation properties. To solve the proposed model, we introduce a bilinear decomposition involving a unit normal field and a scalar magnitude field and develop an Anderson-accelerated majorization--minimization algorithm. The normal field subproblem admits an explicit pointwise majorization--minimization update, which is combined with an Anderson acceleration. For both $L^1$ and $L^2$ data fidelity terms, we establish sufficient decrease and boundedness of the iterates and prove that the generated sequence converges to a critical point of the penalized model. Numerical experiments on synthetic and natural images demonstrate the boundary preserving capability of the proposed model and its competitive performance in removing Gaussian and impulsive noise.

</details>


### [156] [Level-of-Token Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05816)
*Kiyohiro Nakayama,Brian Chao,Jan Ackermann,Hansheng Chen,Federico Tombari,Leonidas Guibas,Lior Yariv,Gordon Wetzstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoT Diffusion 提出可变尺寸与形状的"Level-of-Token"多分辨率 token 布局，通过 patch 级非对称流参数化与多分辨率 token 嵌入，将预训练扩散 Transformer 适配到该布局，在保持预训练生成先验的同时实现布局自适应的高效图像与视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像与视频扩散模型对每个区域分配相同计算量，但实际场景中各区域所需细节程度不同。细节的空间分布往往在生成前即可预知，因此可以据此在低细节区域降低计算量，实现自适应且高效的生成。

Method: 提出 Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion 框架，将先验知识转化为显式的多分辨率 token 布局（LoT 布局）。Token 表示不同尺寸与形状的矩形 patch，在需要细节处分配更细 token、其余区域分配更粗 token。为适配预训练扩散 Transformer，提出 patch 级非对称流（asymmetric flow）参数化与多分辨率 token 嵌入，使每个去噪步仍保持全分辨率流预测，但仅处理缩减后的 token 序列，从而保留预训练生成先验。

Result: 在图像与视频生成任务中，LoT 在语义掩码、边界框、纹理方差、景深线索以及智能体规划等多种布局来源下均获得有利的质量-效率权衡，加速比取决于布局的 token 预算。

Conclusion: LoT Diffusion 通过显式多分辨率 token 布局实现布局自适应生成，在保持预训练生成先验的同时显著提升生成效率，为自适应扩散生成提供了一种通用且灵活的框架。

Abstract: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion, a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout (Level-of-Token layout) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality-efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout's token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/.

</details>


### [157] [Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05861)
*Yongxin Ning,Runliang Niu,Qianli Xing,Zhiyi Duan,Qingzu He,Pan Wang,Qi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Infinite-Dreamer，一种基于像素级图像编辑世界模型的免仿真数据合成方法，将 GUI 状态转移建模为图像编辑任务，用合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 Infinite-Actor，在多个 GUI 智能体基准上稳定超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练高能力、可泛化的 GUI 智能体依赖大规模高保真视觉-动作轨迹，但这类数据难以获取：人工演示无法扩展，现有 GUI 世界模型依赖文本描述或 HTML 渲染，丢失了图标、布局风格等关键像素级视觉细节。

Method: 将 GUI 状态转移概念化为图像编辑任务，用视觉-语言模型（VLM）把动作引起的 UI 变化描述为结构化 delta-text，再微调图像编辑骨干网络以实现可控的真实截图转移合成；利用该模型生成单帧视觉鲁棒性数据和多步想象轨迹，并仅用合成数据微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 Infinite-Actor。

Result: 在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld 和 AndroidControl-Curated 基准上，Infinite-Actor 在各规模上均持续优于 Qwen3-VL 基线：Infinite-Actor-8B 在 AndroidWorld 上 Pass@1 提升 +4.45，MobileWorld 的 Pass@3 成功率接近翻倍；Infinite-Actor-2B 的 Pass@1 提升 +9.05。

Conclusion: 通过以像素级图像编辑世界模型进行免仿真数据合成，可有效弥补现有 GUI 世界模型丢失视觉细节的缺陷，仅用合成数据即可显著提升 GUI 智能体的性能与泛化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating complex digital workflows across diverse applications. However, training highly capable and generalizable agents fundamentally relies on massive, high-fidelity visual-action trajectories, which are notoriously difficult to acquire. While human demonstrations are unscalable, existing GUI world models rely on text descriptions or HTML rendering, discarding crucial pixel-level visual details like icons and layout styles. To address this issue, we introduce Infinite-Dreamer, a simulation-free data synthesis method powered by a pixel-level Image Editing World Model. By conceptualizing GUI transitions as image editing tasks, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to describe action-induced UI changes as structured delta-text. We then fine-tune an image editing backbone to controllably synthesize realistic screenshot transitions. We utilize this model to generate both single-frame visual robustness data and multi-step imaginary trajectories. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we fine-tune the Qwen3-VL baseline solely on the synthesized data to obtain Infinite-Actor, and evaluate it on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated benchmarks. Infinite-Actor consistently outperforms the Qwen3-VL baselines across scales: Infinite-Actor-8B improves AndroidWorld Pass@1 by +4.45 and nearly doubles the MobileWorld Pass@3 success rate, while Infinite-Actor-2B improves Pass@1 by +9.05. Code is available at https://github.com/swaydy-n/Infinite-Dreamer.

</details>


### [158] [Weave Mamba Fusion: Global Cross-Scale Interaction for Lightweight Face Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05865)
*Dohun Kim,Jinmyung Jung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Weave Mamba Fusion(WMF)交错融合相邻金字塔尺度,构建WeaveBiFPN与WeaveFace检测器,在WIDER FACE上以0.34M参数、1.16 GFLOPs达到91.41% mAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征金字塔方法(FPN到BiFPN)通过多尺度特征融合在人脸检测上表现优异,但在小尺度、遮挡、极端姿态等无约束条件下仍难检测,因为这需要局部融合无法建模的全局跨尺度依赖。Mamba等状态空间模型以线性复杂度提供全局上下文,是潜在方向,但其扫描需将两个金字塔尺度合并为单一特征图,而合并方式决定跨尺度结构是否保留:求和会在扫描前塌缩两尺度使扫描无跨尺度结构可利用,拼接虽保留两尺度但代价高。

Method: 提出Weave Mamba Fusion(WMF),按列交错两个相邻金字塔尺度,使水平双向SS2D扫描的每一步从一个尺度移动到另一个尺度;通过部分通道处理与无参de-weaving,实现高效跨尺度交互并保留特征结构。将该模块集成到每个融合节点得到WeaveBiFPN,作为WeaveFace检测器的neck。

Result: 在WIDER FACE上,WeaveFace以仅0.34M参数和1.16 GFLOPs达到91.41%平均AP,优于0.5M参数以下的现有检测器;在Hard子集上增益最大,达到87.14% AP。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过交错式Mamba扫描实现高效的跨尺度融合,WeaveFace在极低参数量与计算量下取得领先性能,尤其在困难子集上提升显著,验证了保留跨尺度结构的扫描融合策略的有效性。

Abstract: Feature pyramid methods, from FPN to BiFPN, have achieved strong performance in face detection by fusing multi-scale features. However, detecting faces under unconstrained conditions, such as small scale, occlusion, and extreme pose, remains difficult, as it requires global cross-scale dependencies that local fusion cannot model. State space models such as Mamba provide global context with linear complexity by scanning features as a sequence, and therefore offer a promising direction for this problem. Nevertheless, such a scan needs the two pyramid scales combined into a single feature map, and the way they are combined determines whether cross-scale structure is preserved. Summation collapses the two scales before the scan, so the scan has no cross-scale structure to exploit, while concatenation keeps both scales but at far higher cost. To address this, we propose \textbf{Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)}, which interleaves two adjacent pyramid scales column by column so that each step of a horizontal bidirectional SS2D scan moves from one scale to the other. With partial-channel processing and parameter-free de-weaving, WMF enables efficient cross-scale interaction while preserving feature structure. Integrating WMF into every fusion node yields \textbf{WeaveBiFPN}, the neck of our \textbf{WeaveFace} detector. On WIDER FACE, WeaveFace achieves 91.41\% mean AP with only 0.34M parameters and 1.16 GFLOPs, outperforming prior detectors under 0.5M parameters. Its largest gains are on the Hard subset, where it reaches 87.14\% AP. The code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/dohun-mat/WeaveMambaFusion}.

</details>


### [159] [Certification of Real Images through Calibrated Content Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05870)
*Sarim Hashmi,Abdelrahman Elsayed,Mohammed Talha Alam,Samuele Poppi,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现深度伪造检测器准确率随生成器迭代而下降（99.5%→76%），且对抗扰动可将其降至2%以下。作者指出根本问题在于"真实性不可判定"，转而提出一种可校准的"合理性否认"检测范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有deepfake检测器在面对新生成器和对抗扰动时可靠性急剧下降。作者认为这源于一个根本性歧义：生成器可以通过记忆等方式精确复现真实内容，因此仅凭内容本身无法确定其真实来源标签，检测范式本身存在原理性缺陷。

Method: 评估20个检测器对4年内10个生成器的表现；提出新的检测范式：输出"真实性是否可被合理否认"的校准预测——若任一已知生成器能忠实重建内容，则建立合理否认；同时通过校准限制已知生成器内容被错误认证的比例。

Result: (i) 检测器可校准至错误认证率≤1%，此时多数基线召回率近零（最强基线准确率93%）；(ii) 在评估的有界扰动攻击空间内，对攻击样本采用更严格阈值可维持该界限，抵御自适应对手，但无法覆盖任意对抗变换；(iii) 事后可验证性正在衰减：3000张Reddit图像中，2022生成器有1116张无法复现，2024生成器仅55-79张无法复现。

Conclusion: 内容来源判别本质上不可靠，应转向评估"合成来源可信度"与"真实性可否认性"的校准检测范式。该范式在保证低误认证率的同时，揭示了事后验证能力随生成器进步而快速退化的趋势。

Abstract: Generative models can synthesize high-quality inauthentic multimedia content that is already being misused at scale. We evaluate twenty deepfake detectors against ten generators released in the last four years and find accuracy decreasing over time, from near-perfect 99.5% to 76%. Adversarial perturbations further reduce every baseline detector to below 2% accuracy, effectively inverting the detector's assigned label. We argue that this unreliability reflects a fundamental ambiguity: generators can reproduce authentic content exactly (e.g., through memorization), so content alone cannot reveal the true provenance label.For this reason, content produced by a generator must admit a faithful reconstruction by that same generator, and finding such a reconstruction makes synthetic provenance plausible and authenticity plausibly deniable.We therefore propose and evaluate a detection paradigm that outputs a calibrated prediction of whether authenticity is plausibly deniable: a faithful reconstruction by any known generator establishes plausible deniability, while calibration bounds how often content from known generators fails to be reproduced. Our evaluation shows that (i) our detector can be calibrated so that at most 1% of generated content is wrongly certified, an operating point at which most baseline detectors reach near-zero recall, including the strongest with 93% accuracy; (ii) calibrating a stricter security threshold on attacked samples preserves this bound against adaptive adversaries within the evaluated bounded-perturbation attack space, whose perturbations break every baseline, but does not cover arbitrary adversarial transformations; and (iii) post-hoc verifiability is eroding, as 1,116 of 3,000 Reddit images resist reproduction by a 2022 generator, but only 55 to 79 resist reproduction by 2024 generators.

</details>


### [160] [fMRI-TAMCL: Text-Anchored Supervised Multimodal Contrastive Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05880)
*Juliana Mantebea Danso,Enoch Opanin Gyamfi,Mylene C. Q. Farias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 fMRI-TAMCL，一种文本锚定的多模态对比学习框架，融合 rs-fMRI 图像、稀疏功能连接与生成式受试者专属文本，在五个数据集上以 78.6%–86.4% 的准确率超越 29 个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静息态 fMRI 在脑疾病分类中很重要，但具有高度多模态性和明显的多站点异质性。现有方法融合图像、基于 BOLD 的功能连接和表型数据。与其他医学影像数据集不同，rs-fMRI 数据集通常不包含文本模态，因此文本需由表型数据或 BOLD 激活生成；而现有文本生成方法依赖对受试者、站点、设备和实验方案的固定假设，导致跨数据集泛化能力差。

Method: fMRI-TAMCL 框架包含：Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation（受试者自适应阈值推导）模块生成 BOLD 激活文本；Feature-Value Serialization（特征值序列化）模块生成表型文本。将三种模态统一编码为聚类图，投影到共享的单位超球面空间，通过成对、以文本为锚的监督对比学习进行对齐，并使用注意力机制进行融合。

Result: 在五个数据集上验证了泛化能力，优于 29 个基线方法，下游分类准确率达 78.6%–86.4%。

Conclusion: 通过以文本为锚的多模态对比学习，可将缺乏原生文本模态的 rs-fMRI 数据转化为可对齐的三模态表示，从而在存在多站点异质性的条件下实现更强的跨数据集泛化，并取得稳定的脑疾病分类性能。

Abstract: Resting-state fMRI is important in the classification of brain disorders, but highly multimodal and exhibits strong multisite heterogeneity. Existing methods fuse images, BOLD-based functional connectivity, and phenotypic data modalities. Unlike other medical imaging datasets, rs-fMRI datasets rarely include a text modality, so they are generated from phenotypic data or BOLD activations. These text generation methods rely on fixed assumptions for subjects, sites, devices, and protocols, leading to poor generalization across datasets. We propose fMRI-TAMCL, a text-anchored multimodal contrastive learning framework that integrates fMRI images, sparse FC, and generated subject-specific text. Its Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation module generates BOLD activation text, while Feature-Value Serialization module generates phenotypic text. All three modalities are encoded as clustered graphs, projected onto a shared unit hypersphere space, aligned using pairwise, text-anchored supervised contrastive learning, and fused with attention. fMRI-TAMCL proves its generalization capability across five datasets outperforming 29 baselines with 78.6%-86.4% accuracy in downstream classification.

</details>


### [161] [Spatial Supervision Without Attribution Optimization: Improving Post-Hoc Class Activation Maps via Box-Guided Evidence Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05891)
*Wenhao Liang,Liangwei Nathan Zheng,Lin Yue,Wei Emma Zhang,Mingyu Guo,Weitong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BGER通过在最终特征图上加轻量门控并施加框/掩码监督，分类经门控特征进行，而Grad-CAM在门控前的表示上独立计算，从而在不优化归因图的前提下提升CAM空间定位质量，但增益机制与幅度随架构和评测设置而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规训练并不约束CAM的空间合理性，导致分类器预测依据的可解释性弱。作者探究能否用低成本的空间监督改善分类器自身预测类的Grad-CAM，同时不直接优化归因图。

Method: 提出Box-Guided Evidence Routing（BGER）：在最终特征图上训练一个轻量门控模块，使用边界框或掩码监督，分类通过门控后的特征进行；Grad-CAM在门控前的表示上单独计算，因此被评测的归因图不进入训练目标。使用BCE路由损失，并设置对照实验：分类绕过门控、门控梯度截断、直接监督CAM等。

Result: BCE路由损失下，MaxBoxAccV2在CUB-200-2011上从0.584提升至0.715，Stanford Dogs上从0.757提升至0.832，精度相当。对照显示ResNet-50的增益主要来自空间监督对骨干网络的重塑而非路由本身：绕过门控时大部分提升仍在，门控梯度截断对ResNet-50结果几乎无影响；同样截断在两个DenseNet-121胸片设置中保留大部分增益，但在Swin-T上使表观增益消失；直接监督CAM带来更强定位但精度代价更大。

Conclusion: 空间监督可以改善独立评测的事后CAM，但其作用机制与收益大小依赖具体架构和评测设置，提示CAM可解释性改进并非普适，需要结合模型结构进行验证。

Abstract: Post-hoc class activation maps (CAMs) are a standard tool for inspecting the evidence behind an image classifier's predictions, yet nothing in ordinary training encourages these maps to be spatially appropriate. We study whether inexpensive spatial supervision can improve a classifier's own predicted-class Grad-CAM without ever optimizing an attribution map. Box-Guided Evidence Routing (BGER) trains a lightweight gate on the final feature map under box or mask supervision and routes classification through the gated features, while Grad-CAM is computed separately at the pre-gate representation, so the evaluated map never enters the training objective. With a BCE routing loss, BGER raises MaxBoxAccV2 from $0.584$ to $0.715$ on CUB-200-2011 and from $0.757$ to $0.832$ on Stanford Dogs at comparable accuracy. Matched controls attribute most of the ResNet-50 gain to the spatial supervision reshaping the backbone rather than to routing itself: when classification bypasses the gate, most of the improvement remains, and detaching gradients through the gate leaves the ResNet-50 result nearly unchanged. The same detachment preserves most of the gain in two DenseNet-121 chest X-ray settings but removes the apparent gain on Swin-T, and directly supervising the CAM reaches stronger localization at a larger accuracy cost. Overall, spatial supervision can improve separately evaluated post-hoc CAMs, but both the mechanism and the size of the benefit depend on the architecture and the evaluation setting.

</details>


### [162] [TasteRoute: Personalized Routing for Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05896)
*Zhi Rui Tam,Chao-Chung Wu,Sin-Han Yang,Peyton Ku,Brendan Kuang,Tzu-Ting Hsieh,Min-Fang Hsu,Fang-Ling Tsai,Yun-Nung Chen,Wei-Chiu Ma,Chieh-Yen Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出个性化视频生成路由器 TasteRoute，联合输入请求、用户偏好与生成预算选择模型，在偏好路由上媲美基线且降低生成成本，并发布 TasteRoute-3k 数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型能力与成本差异大，需高效路由请求；且人类标注者偏好分歧严重（共识 oracle 与个人最爱仅 34-55% 一致），说明需个性化路由。

Method: 构建 TasteRoute 路由器，依据输入请求、用户偏好与可用生成预算，联合决策选择生成模型；覆盖文生视频与图生视频场景。

Result: 在偏好路由上与强简单基线相当，同时降低平均生成成本；预算上限越高，成本节省越明显。

Conclusion: 个性化、成本感知的视频路由可行；发布 TasteRoute-3k 数据集（多模型视频比较、质量判断、偏好排序、用户画像信号）以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Rapid progress in video generation has led to a plethora of models that differ substantially in capability and generation cost. This raises a natural question: can each request be efficiently routed to an appropriate model? We find that even when the consensus of the other annotators is used as an oracle, it agrees with each annotator's own favorite only 34-55% of the time. Motivated by this observation, we introduce TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator jointly based on the input request, user preferences, and available generation budget. Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, TasteRoute is competitive with strong simple baselines on preference routing while reducing average generation cost. The cost saving increases under higher budget caps. Finally, we release TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset containing multi-model video comparisons, quality judgments, preference rankings, and user-profile signals to facilitate future research on personalized and cost-aware video routing.

</details>


### [163] [Fitting Vision Adapters at Frontier Scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05897)
*Jaehoon Lee,Harry Partridge,Mudith Jayasekara,Charles O'Neill,Max Kirkby,Michael Psenka*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在冻结视觉编码器与语言模型权重的前提下，仅训练一个50M参数的投影器，将Kimi K2.6的视觉编码器接入GLM 5.2/5.3纯语言模型，并给出大规模训练该适配器的可复现方案，研究视觉能力的规模缩放规律及可注入与受限能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型参数规模急剧扩大，而"冻结编码器+小投影器"这一经典多模态方案能否、以及能赋予大模型何种视觉能力尚不清晰，需重新审视其能力边界与缩放行为。

Method: 从Kimi K2.6的视觉编码器到无原生视觉能力的GLM 5.2与5.3之间训练一个50M参数的投影器，保持语言模型与视觉编码器权重冻结，并提出大规模训练该适配器的可复现方法。

Result: 在MMMU-Pro与BLINK上评估整体性能及各项具体视觉任务表现，考察（a）仅随语言模型侧扩大时多模态视觉能力的缩放规律，以及（b）哪些视觉能力可被规模化注入纯语言模型、哪些仍受限。

Conclusion: 通过小投影器可为规模化纯语言模型注入部分视觉能力，但其能力谱系存在结构性限制，为多模态适配的缩放研究提供了可复现基线。

Abstract: Training a small projector between a frozen vision encoder and language model is an established approach to multimodal learning. As the parameter count of language models scales dramatically, we revisit which vision capabilities this approach can add while keeping their pretrained weights fixed. Here we train a 50M parameter projector from the vision encoder of Kimi K2.6 to GLM 5.2 and 5.3, both models without native vision capabilities, and further present a reproducible recipe for training these adapters at scale. We study the following: (a) how vision capabilities of multimodal models scale as purely the language model side scales, and (b) what specific vision capabilities are able to be imbued into a pure language model at scale, and which ones remain limited. We evaluate on MMMU-Pro and BLINK, examining both overall performance and results on individual visual tasks.

</details>


### [164] [LoDEOT: Low-Dimensional and Efficient Offset Tokens for Building Footprint Extraction from Off-Nadir Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05899)
*Kai Li,Zigan Zhou,Zhenyang Li,Hui Shan,Zhe Chen,Yupeng Deng,Zhihao Xi,Yu Meng,Yifan Peng,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LoDEOT，用五维偏移token替代高维实例token进行屋顶到足迹偏移(RFO)预测，在五个建筑数据集上验证有效性，BONAI上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实例级RFO预测是斜视影像提取建筑足迹的核心。现有query-based流程使用高维实例token预测二维符号RFO，作者探究能否改用紧凑的偏移token来预测RFO。

Method: 在局部针孔投影与垂直拉伸假设下，理想RFO映射存在五参数充分描述子（内在形状、复合幅值、相对几何）。该分解为五维偏移token提供结构先验，其通道通过端到端训练学习任务相关隐表示。据此提出LoDEOT：检测与分割仍用高维实例token，但将实例token、浓度门控屋顶和box-mask证据映射为五维偏移token，后接独立二维读出。利用已知去噪query目标索引，将各监督解码层的估计与同一干净实例RFO对齐，使连续预测成为扰动query条件下的目标对齐恢复。

Result: 在五个真实建筑数据集上验证有效性。BONAI上，LoDEOT获得最佳屋顶检测bAP和bAP50，在所有被评估端到端方法中五项偏移校正足迹指标均领先，FAP50为54.58、mEPE为5.23像素；FAP50比端到端基线高7.56-16.85个百分点。

Conclusion: 五维偏移token足以支持准确的RFO预测，LoDEOT为从斜视影像提取建筑足迹提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Instance-level roof-to-footprint offset (RFO) prediction is central to extracting building footprints from off-nadir imagery. Query-based pipelines commonly use high-dimensional instance tokens to predict signed two-dimensional RFOs. We investigate whether RFO prediction can instead use a compact offset token. Under local pinhole projection and vertical-extrusion assumptions, the idealized RFO map admits a five-parameter sufficient descriptor comprising intrinsic shape, composite amplitude, and relative geometry. This factorization provides a structural prior for a five-dimensional offset token, whose channels learn task-relevant latent representations through end-to-end training. Based on this design, we propose LoDEOT, which retains high-dimensional instance tokens for detection and segmentation but maps instance-token, concentration-gated roof, and box-mask evidence to a five-dimensional offset token followed by an independent two-dimensional readout. Known denoising-query target indices further align each supervised decoder-layer estimate with the same clean instance RFO, organizing successive predictions as target-aligned recovery under perturbed query conditions. Experiments on five real-world building datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LoDEOT for building footprint extraction. Experiments on real-world building datasets demonstrate that a five-dimensional offset token can support accurate RFO prediction. On BONAI, LoDEOT achieves the best roof-detection bAP and bAP50 and leads all five offset-corrected footprint metrics among the evaluated end-to-end methods, with FAP50 of 54.58 and mEPE of 5.23 pixels. Its FAP50 exceeds those of the evaluated end-to-end baselines by 7.56-16.85 percentage points.

</details>


### [165] [End-to-End Autonomous Recursive Arborescence Deformable Flow and Non-Linear Hemodynamics for Patient-Specific Coronary Centerline Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05900)
*Zeyu Jia,Xin Ming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个端到端框架，将连续几何树状结构生成与非线性血流动力学解耦，用于从体医学影像中提取患者特异性血管树并评估缺血。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统体素分割常切断细小分叉，启发式欧氏最小生成树会引入非解剖性捷径；同时线性Poiseuille流忽略狭窄处的二次动能耗散，导致缺血被低估。因此需要更准确、拓扑保证的血管树提取与非线性血流评估方法。

Method: 框架包含四个模块：1) 自主3D开口标志定位头，采用双窦查询通道与球面门控精化，消除中心线种子依赖；2) 空间锚定可变形步进流架构，通过三线性采样查询连续3D特征金字塔，并以锚点边界约束顺序生成轨迹；3) 自顶向下递归树状状态机，利用Tree-NMS检测分叉峰并参数化前驱父指针，保证单连通无环树拓扑且步终止可微；4) 迭代Picard非线性Kirchhoff求解器，结合Young-Tsai/Gould二次耗散，实现机器精度质量守恒。

Result: 开口定位队列平均误差7.63 mm（LCA 7.43 mm，RCA 7.83 mm；71.4% ≤8.0 mm）。在14例开发患者标准化在体狭窄应力测试（Q_0=4.0 mL/s）中，线性Poiseuille流在14/14例中将75%直径病变误判为非缺血（FFR>0.80）；非线性求解器捕捉到功能性缺血（FFR=0.5864，病变压差32.89 mmHg，p=6.10e-5），侧支分流为3.66倍。质量守恒残差5.82e-11 mL/s。测试集防火墙隔离得以维持。

Conclusion: 该框架通过解耦几何树生成与非线性血流动力学，实现拓扑可靠的血管树提取，并显著提升狭窄相关功能性缺血的识别能力，优于线性Poiseuille模型。

Abstract: Extracting patient-specific vascular trees from volumetric medical images is fundamental to computational angiography and non-invasive hemodynamic assessment. Conventional voxel segmentation models often sever delicate bifurcations, while heuristic Euclidean Minimum Spanning Trees introduce non-anatomical shortcuts. Moreover, linear Poiseuille flow neglects quadratic kinetic dissipation across arterial narrowings, underestimating ischemia. We formulate an end-to-end framework decoupling continuous geometric arborescence generation from non-linear hemodynamics. First, an autonomous 3D Ostium Landmark Localization Head with dual-sinus query channels and spherical-gated refinement eliminates centerline seeding dependency, achieving cohort mean localization error of 7.63 mm (7.43 mm LCA, 7.83 mm RCA; 71.4% <= 8.0 mm) from raw contrast context. Second, a Spatially-Grounded Deformable Step Flow Architecture queries continuous 3D feature pyramids via trilinear sampling, sequentially generating trajectories with anchor boundary enforcement (X(0) = P_start). Third, a Top-Down Recursive Arborescence State Machine detects bifurcation peaks via Tree-NMS and parameterizes predecessor parent pointers (p_k < k), guaranteeing single connected acyclic tree topology (beta_0 = 1, beta_1 = 0) with differentiable step termination. Fourth, an iterative Picard non-linear Kirchhoff solver with Young-Tsai / Gould quadratic dissipation enforces machine-precision mass conservation (residual 5.82e-11 mL/s). Across 14 development patients under standardized in-silico stenosis stress testing (Q_0 = 4.0 mL/s), linear Poiseuille flow misclassifies 75% diameter lesions as non-ischemic (FFR > 0.80) in 14/14 cases, whereas our non-linear solver captures functional ischemia (FFR = 0.5864, lesion disparity 32.89 mmHg, p = 6.10e-5) with 3.66x collateral shunting. Test set firewall isolation was maintained.

</details>


### [166] [Safe Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05908)
*Eungyeol Han,Jong-Seok Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种"生成中(in-generation)"安全框架，通过监控去噪轨迹并检测中间表征中的NSFW信号，结合强化学习实现从NSFW提示生成安全图像的可控引导，在标准与对抗评测集上优于现有方法且保持感知质量与提示保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型仍能生成NSFW内容，而当前安全机制多局限于生成前过滤（如提示级文本分类器）或图像完全合成后的后处理审核；对抗攻击可作用于更广的空间，这种能力覆盖的不对称凸显了在生成过程中介入的安全机制的必要性。

Method: 提出生成中安全框架：监控扩散去噪轨迹，从中间表征中检测正在浮现的NSFW信号，并将生成中检测与可控引导相结合，采用强化学习使模型能够从NSFW提示生成安全图像，从而在NSFW信号在生成已开始后才显现时也能缓解不安全轨迹。

Result: 在标准评测集与对抗评测集上均持续优于现有安全图像生成方法，同时保持了感知质量与提示保真度。

Conclusion: 生成过程中的实时监测与可控引导是更有效且更鲁棒的T2I安全防护范式，能够弥补生成前与生成后防护在对抗场景下的不足，兼顾安全性与生成质量。

Abstract: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models achieve remarkable visual image generation performance, but they can still generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents, including violent or explicit images. Existing safety checker mechanisms are largely confined to pre-generation filtering (e.g. prompt-level text classifiers) or post-hoc moderation applied after an image is completely synthesized. However, adversarial attack methods operate over a much broader space. This imbalance highlights the need for a safety mechanism that intervenes during the generation process. We propose an in-generation safety framework that monitors the denoising trajectory and detects emerging NSFW signals from intermediate representations. Rather than merely detecting NSFW generations, our method applies reinforcement learning to generate safe images from NSFW prompts. By coupling in-generation detection with controllable steering, our approach mitigates unsafe trajectories even when NSFW signals emerge after generation has already begun. Experiments results show that our method consistently outperforms existing safe image generation methods across both standard and adversarial evaluation sets, while preserving perceptual quality and prompt fidelity. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [167] [AstraSR: Real-World Thermal Super-Resolution with GPT-6 Astra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05910)
*Mengyuan Li,Changhong Fu,Jun Zhang,Ziyu Lu,Yuhang Zhang,Haobo Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AstraSR，利用GPT-6 Astra生成高分辨率参考，实现真实场景热成像超分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界热成像超分辨率受限于传感器分辨率低，且难以获得对应的高分辨率观测用于直接监督。传统方法将带退化的真实热图像当作HR参考、再施加预设退化生成合成LR输入，导致合成LR与真实LR之间存在域差距，且监督信号中残留采集退化。

Method: 以GPT-6 Astra这一前沿多模态生成模型为引导构建数据集：用采集到的LR热图像作为条件，生成HR参考，构成图像对；提出直接生成式监督策略，从真实热输入与GPT生成HR参考的配对中学习；使用像素损失、梯度损失和感知损失联合监督，迁移强度模式、结构边界与视觉细节。

Result: 与七种现有最先进的真实世界SR方法进行定性比较，AstraSR在热成像场景中呈现连续的物体轮廓、清晰的结构边界和平滑的强度过渡。

Conclusion: AstraSR在热成像清晰度和结构一致性上均优于现有真实世界SR方法，验证了以GPT生成参考进行直接生成式监督的有效性。

Abstract: Real-world thermal super-resolution (SR) is constrained by limited sensor resolution and the difficulty of obtaining corresponding high-resolution (HR) observations for direct model supervision. Conventional SR methods typically construct training pairs by treating captured thermal images with real-world degradations as HR references and applying predefined degradation to generate synthetic low-resolution (LR) inputs. Such a construction not only introduces a domain gap between synthetic and captured LR observations but also retains acquisition degradations in the supervision. To address this issue, we propose AstraSR, a real-world thermal SR method guided by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier multimodal generative model endowed with emergent and transformative visual capabilities. Specifically, we construct a dataset of image pairs by using captured LR thermal images to condition GPT-based HR reference. We develop a direct generative supervision strategy that learns from captured thermal inputs paired with GPT-generated HR references. Pixel, gradient, and perceptual losses jointly supervise the transfer of intensity patterns, structural boundaries, and visual details from the generated references. Qualitative comparisons with seven existing state-of-the-art real-world SR methods show continuous object contours, distinct structural boundaries, and smooth intensity transitions in the thermal scenes. These results demonstrate that AstraSR outperforms existing real-world SR methods in both thermal clarity and structural coherence.

</details>


### [168] [Every View Counts: View-Consistent Panoptic Quality for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05911)
*Youngmin Lee,Byungha Ko,Guhnoo Yun,Dong Hwan Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VC-PQ 指标，将 PQ 从单图扩展到多视图集合，使视图一致性成为多视图全景分割评估的一部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈 3D 模型的多视图全景分割预测沿用了逐场景优化的场景级 PQ（PQ^scene），并在渲染的留出视图上评估。但 PQ^scene 将所有视图拼接为单图，遗漏或 ID 变化的惩罚仅与其面积成比例，无法体现视图一致性。

Method: 提出 VC-PQ：将 PQ 从单图像扩展到输入视图集合，对实例可见的每个视图等权计数，并惩罚预测与真值可见视图不一致的情况。给出 VC-PQ 的分解，将失分归因于掩码精度、视图一致性和匹配阈值；引入一个额外参数以恢复平铺的面积加权以便比较。在 ScanNet++ 与 ScanNetv2 上以固定评估协议对比 VC-PQ 与 PQ^scene，并对真值做受控扰动实验。

Result: 分解结果揭示各方法分别在哪里失分；受控扰动表明 VC-PQ 对实例被遗漏或 ID 变化的视图数量敏感，而 PQ^scene 对其面积敏感。

Conclusion: 目标是使视图一致性成为多视图全景分割评估的组成部分，建议 VC-PQ 与 PQ^scene 一并报告。

Abstract: Multi-view panoptic segmentation assigns a semantic class and a scene-level instance ID to every pixel of an unordered set of images, and recent feed-forward 3D models predict these labels for the input views in a single forward pass. Their predictions, however, have been evaluated with the scene-level PQ (PQ^scene) borrowed from per-scene optimization methods, typically on rendered held-out views. PQ^scene tiles all views of a scene into a single image, so that a missed appearance or a change of ID lowers the score of the matched pair only in proportion to its area. We propose View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ), which extends PQ from a single image to a set of input views, counts equally every view in which an instance is visible, and penalizes a prediction that is not visible in the same views as its ground truth. A decomposition of VC-PQ attributes the score a method loses to mask accuracy, view consistency, and the matching threshold. A single additional parameter recovers the area weighting of tiling for comparison. Under a fixed evaluation protocol on ScanNet++ and ScanNetv2, recent feed-forward methods are evaluated with VC-PQ and PQ^scene, and the decomposition shows where each of them loses its score. Controlled perturbations of the ground truth show that VC-PQ responds to the number of views in which an instance is missed or changes ID, whereas PQ^scene responds to their area. The aim of this work is to make view consistency part of the evaluation of multi-view panoptic segmentation, with VC-PQ reported alongside PQ^scene.

</details>


### [169] [Prompt and Refinement: Asymmetric Mutual Learning for Infrared Small Target Detection with Noisy Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05918)
*Yimin Fu,Songbo Wang,Lizhuo Liu,Baicheng Pan,Zhunga Liu,Michael K. Ng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PAR（Prompt and Refinement），一种面向红外小目标检测（ISTD）的标签噪声鲁棒非对称互学习范式。PAR由预训练SAM与从零训练的ISTD专用检测器组成，通过同伴教学（peer-teaching）协同学习，并借助局部对比度正则实现互惠标注修正；同时引入证据不确定性估计优化策略。在三个ISTD数据集的多噪声场景下均取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的红外小目标检测方法依赖大规模且具有精确像素级标注的数据集，但这类标注对专家知识依赖强，且红外小目标本身判别性弱，使实际应用中难以满足要求，训练时不可避免地存在噪声标签，进而将目标感知学习引向虚假模式。

Method: 提出非对称互学习范式PAR：1）由预训练SAM与从零训练的ISTD专用检测器构成两个非对称同伴模型，通过同伴教学方案协同学习；2）结合局部对比度正则，将两模型的预测互相作为对方监督掩码的修正线索，利用互补归纳偏置的交互避免标注修正退化为单模型的自确认循环，实现标注向目标内在特征的渐进式精化；3）将检测器预测作为修正性掩码提示，促进视觉基础模型的任务特定适配；4）在优化过程中引入证据不确定性估计策略以缓解噪声标签的负面影响。

Result: 在三个ISTD数据集上、多种噪声标签场景下的广泛实验表明，PAR持续取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: PAR通过非对称互学习、掩码提示与不确定性估计的协同设计，有效提升了红外小目标检测在噪声标签条件下的鲁棒性与精度，验证了利用互补归纳偏置进行标注精化的有效性。

Abstract: Existing data-driven infrared small target detection (ISTD) methods typically require large-scale datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations for model training. However, such labor-intensive requirements are difficult to satisfy in real-world applications due to the heavy reliance on expert knowledge and the inherently weak distinctiveness of infrared small targets. Consequently, the presence of noisy labels during model training is inevitable, which can severely mislead the learning of target perception toward spurious patterns. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt and Refinement (PAR), a label-noise-robust asymmetric mutual learning paradigm for ISTD. Specifically, PAR comprises a pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM) and an ISTD-specific detector trained from scratch, which learn collaboratively through a peer-teaching scheme. Coupled with local contrast regularity, the predictions of the two asymmetric peer models are mutually exploited as rectification cues for the supervisory masks of their counterparts. The interaction between complementary inductive biases effectively prevents the label correction process from degenerating into the self-confirmation loop of a single model, enabling progressive refinement of the annotations toward intrinsic target characteristics. In addition, the detector predictions are utilized as corrective mask prompts to facilitate task-specific adaptation of the vision foundation model. Moreover, an evidential uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced into the optimization process to further alleviate the adverse effects of noisy labels. Extensive experiments under diverse noisy label scenarios on three ISTD datasets demonstrate that PAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [170] [UltraDub: Towards Authentic Dubbing by Unifying Visually-Steered Flow Learning and Trajectory Guidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05932)
*Gaoxiang Cong,Liang Li,Jianwei Wen,Zhedong Zhang,Zheng-Jun Zha,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UltraDub是一个视频配音框架，将视觉同时用作连续运动线索与结构节奏，实现语音克隆的语义准确与唇形同步平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语音克隆需同时满足可懂性、说话人一致性与唇形同步。但多模态顺序条件易破坏已建立的时间与说话人线索；推理引导不平衡时，提升语义准确会牺牲唇形同步。

Method: 提出UltraDub框架，含两部分：1) 运动引导双上下文检索(MDR)模块，通过共享唇动查询残差持续重校准语言与说话人风格检索，用独立的时间条件门控调节贡献；2) 节奏锚定轨迹引导(RTG)，免训练机制，在纯视觉预测中点评估分层多模态修正，增强语义条件同时保持时间对齐。并构建多场景基准DiverseDub。

Result: 在四个数据集上取得当前最优性能。

Conclusion: 视觉既可作为连续运动用于多模态上下文聚合，又可作为结构节奏用于轨迹校正，从而统一提升视频配音的语义与同步质量。

Abstract: Visual voice cloning requires intelligible, speaker-consistent speech synchronized with visible articulation. However, sequential multimodal conditioning can disrupt previously established temporal and speaker cues, while imbalanced inference guidance can improve linguistic accuracy at the expense of lip synchronization. In this paper, we propose UltraDub, a Unifying Visually-Steered Flow learning and trajectory Guidance Dubbing framework that leverages vision in two ways: as continuous motion for multimodal context aggregation, and as structural rhythm for trajectory rectification. Specifically, we introduce the Motion-guided Dual-context Retrieving (MDR) module, which continually recalibrates linguistic and speaker-style retrieval through shared lip-motion query residuals, utilizing independent time-conditioned gates to regulate their contributions. Furthermore, we propose Rhythm-anchored Trajectory Guidance (RTG), a training-free mechanism that evaluates hierarchical multimodal corrections at a visual-only predictive midpoint, safely strengthening semantic conditioning while better preserving temporal alignment. Finally, we construct DiverseDub, a multi-scenario benchmark to evaluate video dubbing in the wild. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraDub achieves state-of-the-art performance across four datasets.

</details>


### [171] [ReMem: Streaming Video Understanding With Long Context Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05940)
*Li Yiheng,He Xu,Wang Shaobo,Shao Ling,Lu Shijian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练适配技术 ReMem，通过流式上下文记忆与检索视觉记忆两个组件，使视觉语言模型能够处理任意长度流式视频并提升长上下文信息保留能力，在流式与通用长视频理解基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要面向离线场景，难以应对要求低延迟响应的在线流式视频。已有记忆与令牌压缩策略在适配过程中，随着输入流长度增加会逐渐丢失长上下文信息。

Method: ReMem 为免训练适配方法，从两个视角利用记忆，包含两个核心组件：流式上下文记忆（SCM）以查询无关的注意力机制持续压缩历史上下文；检索视觉记忆（RVM）从记忆中检索最显著、与查询相关的上下文，用于增强视觉语言模型的输入。

Result: 在多种广泛使用的基准上，涵盖流式视频理解与通用长视频理解任务，ReMem 均取得SOTA性能。

Conclusion: ReMem 无需训练即可让视觉语言模型处理任意长度流式视频，并有效缓解长上下文信息丢失问题，验证了双视角记忆机制的有效性。

Abstract: Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of video understanding tasks, current Vision Language Models (VLMs) are predominantly designed for offline scenarios and struggle to handle online streaming videos that demand low latency response. Several studies have explored memory and token compression strategies in an attempt to adapt offline VLMs for streaming video understanding tasks. However, through our probing experiment, we identify that most existing works tend to progressively lose long context information as length of input stream increases. To address this, we propose ReMem, a novel training-free adaptation technique that enables VLMs to process streaming videos of arbitrary lengths while improving their long context information retention capability. ReMem exploits memory from two perspectives, implemented as two core components. The Streaming Context Memory (SCM) continuously compresses historical context with query-independent attention. The Retrieved Vision Memory (RVM) then retrieves the most salient, query-relevant context from memory to augment the VLM's input. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed ReMem achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a variety of widely used benchmarks, spanning both streaming video and general long video understanding tasks.

</details>


### [172] [JLD: Perceptual Distance Through A Jacobian Lens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05967)
*Shreshth Saini,Balu Adsumilli,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Jacobian Lens Distance（JLD），一种从冻结视觉编码器中导出感知几何的图像距离度量，在多个标准数据库上取得SOTA，并对分辨率变化具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像压缩、复原和生成都依赖衡量两幅图像在人眼感知上差异的度量。像素误差忽视人眼视觉特性，而最准确的感知距离通常拟合于人类主观评分，因而被绑定到固定数据和分辨率。例如图像分辨率加倍时，DISTS 与 TID2013 上人类评分的相关性从 0.815 降至 0.717。因此需要一种不依赖人类标签、且对分辨率变化鲁棒的感知距离。

Method: 提出 JLD，从冻结视觉编码器而非人类标签中导出感知几何。它结合早期 patch 特征的局部性与后期编码器表示所捕获的感知敏感性：利用编码器 Jacobian 识别早期特征空间中对编码器输出影响最大的方向，得到一个固定度量张量 $E[J^\top J]$，称为 Jacobian lens。该 lens 仅用 100 张无标注图像拟合一次，耗时约 35 秒。局部上该构造在像素空间定义了一个拉回度量（pullback metric），使 JLD 具有清晰的几何解释。此外提出 JLD-fast，以及将 JLD 自然扩展到视频。

Result: 在四个标准感知数据库上，JLD 取得 SOTA 性能，持续优于 LPIPS、DISTS、PieAPP 和 DreamSim。对分辨率变化鲁棒：TID2013 上分辨率加倍时，其 lens 项相关性几乎不变，仅从 0.850 降至 0.845。JLD-fast 比 LPIPS-VGG 快 $4\times$，平均相关性达 0.911。扩展到视频后，在 Waterloo IVC 4K 上相关性达 0.786，而 VMAF 为 0.611。

Conclusion: JLD 通过从冻结编码器的 Jacobian 导出固定度量张量，构建了不依赖人类标签、具有几何可解释性且对分辨率鲁棒的感知距离，在图像与视频感知质量评估中均表现优异。

Abstract: Image compression, restoration, and generation all require a way to measure how different two images look to a person. Pixel error ignores how people see, while the most accurate perceptual distances are typically fitted to human judgments, tying them to a fixed data and resolution. For example, when image resolution is doubled, the correlation of DISTS with human scores on TID2013 drops from 0.815 to 0.717. We introduce the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), which derives its perceptual geometry from a frozen vision encoder rather than from human labels. JLD combines the locality of early patch features with the perceptual sensitivity captured by later encoder representations. Specifically, we use the encoder Jacobian to identify directions in the early feature space that most strongly affect the encoder output, producing a fixed metric tensor, $E[J^\top J]$, which we call the Jacobian lens. The lens is fitted only once from 100 unlabeled images, taking about 35 seconds. Locally, this construction defines a pullback metric in pixel space, giving JLD a clear geometric interpretation that can be directly analyzed on real images. Across four standard perceptual databases, JLD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms LPIPS, DISTS, PieAPP, and DreamSim. JLD is also robust to changes in image resolution, on TID2013, its lens-term correlation remains nearly unchanged when the resolution is doubled, decreasing only from 0.850 to 0.845. We further introduce JLD-fast, which is $4\times$ faster than LPIPS-VGG while achieving a mean correlation of 0.911. Finally, JLD naturally extends to video, reaching a correlation of 0.786 on Waterloo IVC 4K compared with 0.611 for VMAF.

</details>


### [173] [Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06018)
*Eryk Kołodziejczyk,Alberto Presta,Karol Szurkowski,Michal Byra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究STVG模型在无关查询与缺失文本输入下的行为，发现当前模型即使查询与视频无关或被完全移除仍能产生看似合理的时空预测，并指出数据集规整性可能助长这种“查询不敏感”行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有STVG模型均假设每个查询都与输入视频相关，这一假设可能掩盖模型对查询相关性的真实判别能力，作者希望挑战该假设并揭示被忽视的局限。

Method: 在无关查询和缺失文本输入两种设定下，对当前最先进的STVG模型进行实验测试，并进一步分析HCSTVG-v2与VidSTG数据集，识别其中可能导致查询不敏感行为的规整性。

Result: 实验表明，即便查询与视频无关或文本被完全移除，现有模型仍能输出貌似合理的时空预测；数据集分析显示HCSTVG-v2和VidSTG存在可能诱发此类行为的规律性。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了STVG领域一个尚未充分探索的局限，呼吁引入能够显式评估查询相关性的“负样本感知”评测协议与模型架构。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.

</details>


### [174] [Label-Free Coreset Selection with Foundation Models for Efficient Annotation in Computational Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05987)
*Tuo Yin,Jennifer Dhont*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GCcore，一种无需标签、无需超参数的coreset选择方法，通过病理基础模型嵌入+贪心最大化嵌入空间全局覆盖来挑选标注样本，在10个任务上超越14个基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算病理学中深度学习算法的开发与验证依赖专家标注数据，而病理学家严重短缺，标注成本高昂。现有coreset选择方法依赖在自然图像基准上调优的超参数，无法迁移到组织病理学且临床使用不便。

Method: GCcore是无标签的coreset选择方法：用任意病理基础模型对数据集每张图像进行嵌入，然后贪心选择能共同最大化嵌入空间全局覆盖的样本。该方法对任意coreset大小都提供全局覆盖的下界保证，且完全无超参数、确定性。

Result: 在涵盖全切片图像分类、图块分类和组织分割的10个任务与数据集上，GCcore优于包括最先进方法在内的14个基线，在6个任务上排名第一，9个任务进入前三；同时显示现有方法的排名会因超参数设置而变动多达五个位次。

Conclusion: GCcore有效减少了病理标注成本，无需超参数调优且具备理论保证，代码已公开。

Abstract: Computational pathology has the potential to improve clinical outcomes through a demonstrated increase in diagnostic and prognostic accuracy. However, the development and validation of deep learning algorithms still require annotated data, a costly procedure involving expert pathologists who already face critical workforce shortages. Existing coreset selection methods to optimize annotation efforts currently all rely on hyperparameters tuned on natural-image benchmarks that do not transfer to histopathology and are cumbersome to use in clinical practice. In this study, we present GCcore, a novel label-free coreset selection method that embeds every image of a dataset with any pathology foundation model and greedily selects the samples that collectively maximize the global coverage of the embedding space. The proposed method provides a lower-bound guarantee on the global coverage of the returned coreset for any coreset size, while being completely hyperparameter-free and deterministic. We demonstrate GCcore's superior performance over 14 baselines including state-of-the-art methods across 10 tasks and datasets spanning whole slide image classification, tile classification, and tissue segmentation, where it ranks first on six and within the top three on nine, while also demonstrating how existing methods can shift by up to five rank positions depending on their hyperparameter settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/OncoAI-ULBHUB/GCcore.

</details>


### [175] [ROT: Rotating Hidden States towards Contextual Vectors for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06056)
*Yijing Du,Xiangcheng Zhan,Shuo Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ROT，一种分层、免训练的框架，通过在中间层检测语义偏差并对隐状态施加保范旋转以回归多模态上下文平面，配合表征平滑，显著缓解 LVLM 的物体幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）普遍存在物体幻觉问题。现有免训练干预手段主要操纵注意力权重，只能间接影响到达最终预测层的深层语义，因此效果受限。作者希望直接作用于自注意力与残差相加后的隐状态向量，从更根本的表征层面进行干预。

Method: 实证分析发现：幻觉 token 并非单纯过度依赖语言先验，而是在中间层表现出异常的上下文偏差，即与文本上下文和视觉上下文的相似度都显著偏低。基于此提出 ROT：1）在中间层动态检测语义偏差；2）对隐状态施加保范旋转（norm-preserving rotation），将其引导回由上下文张成的局部多模态上下文平面；3）在后续层引入表征平滑机制，稳定校准后的表征轨迹。

Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，ROT 在各种模型架构与参数规模下均能一致地降低幻觉，为有据生成提供了一种高效、几何驱动的解决方案。

Conclusion: ROT 从隐状态几何角度切入，以分层、免训练的方式直接校准中间层表征，在保持范数的前提下纠正语义偏差，是一种通用、高效且可跨架构迁移的幻觉缓解方案。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucination. Existing training-free interventions primarily manipulate attention weights, which indirectly affect the deep semantics reaching the final predictive layers. In this work, we shift our focus to the hidden state vectors extracted after self-attention and residual addition. Empirical analysis reveals that hallucinated tokens do not simply over-rely on linguistic priors; instead, they exhibit an anomalous contextual deviation, showing significantly lower similarities to both textual and visual contexts in intermediate layers. Motivated by this, we propose ROT, a layer-specific, training-free framework. ROT dynamically detects semantic deviation in the middle layers and applies a norm-preserving rotation to steer the hidden states back toward the local multimodal context plane spanned by the contexts. For subsequent layers, a representational smoothing mechanism is introduced to stabilize the calibrated trajectory. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ROT consistently reduces hallucinations across various model architectures and scales, offering an efficient, geometry-driven solution for grounded generation.

</details>


### [176] [From Transformation to Target State: Rethinking Query Representation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05993)
*Yihe Zhao,Songhe Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究零样本组合图像检索（CIR）中的表示不对称问题，提出将零样本CIR重构为"目标状态重建再检索"的新范式，并实例化为免训练框架ASAP-CIR，在CIRCO上取得最明显增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIR任务存在一种罕见的表示不对称：修改文本描述的是从参考状态出发的"转变过程"（动态语义），而检索候选图像呈现的是"完成后的目标状态"（静态语义）。直接用面向转换的语言去查询预训练的视觉-语言空间，会造成表示错配，从而使零样本方法性能受限。作者希望审视并解决这一错配。

Method: 作者将零样本CIR重新表述为"先重建目标状态、再进行检索"的两阶段问题，并据此提出免训练框架ASAP-CIR：使用冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）重建一个静态的目标表示，该表示由多份整体性描述与一组可变数量的、按重要性加权的原子语义组合而成，兼顾目标整体身份与细粒度视觉约束。检索阶段则融合整体状态对齐、原子约束落地与校准后的目标状态证据聚合。此外还设计了受控的纯文本诊断实验加以验证。

Result: 受控纯文本诊断实验表明，目标侧静态查询式表述比动态组合查询式表述检索更可靠，尤其在需要抑制或转换源状态语义时更为明显。在FashionIQ、CIRR和CIRCO上的实验刻画了该表示原则的有效性与局限，其中在多目标的CIRCO基准上增益最为显著。

Conclusion: 组合意图在检索前如何被表示，本身就是一个具有实质影响的设计选择，其重要性独立于检索骨干网络的选择。该工作将"意图表示"与"检索骨干"解耦，为零样本CIR提供了新的分析视角与实用框架。

Abstract: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a desired target image from a query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. This task exhibits an unusual representational asymmetry: the modification text specifies a transition from the reference state, whereas retrieval candidates depict completed target states. This creates a representation mismatch for zero-shot methods that query pretrained vision-language spaces directly with transformation-oriented language. We study this mismatch and reformulate zero-shot composed image retrieval as target-state reconstruction followed by retrieval. We instantiate this formulation with ASAP-CIR, a training-free framework that reconstructs a static target representation using a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). The representation combines multiple holistic descriptions with a variable set of importance-weighted atomic semantics, thereby preserving both overall target identity and fine-grained visual constraints. Retrieval then integrates holistic state alignment, atomic constraint grounding, and calibrated target-state evidence aggregation. A controlled text-only diagnostic shows that target-side static query formulations achieve more reliable retrieval than dynamic composed query formulations, particularly when source-state semantics must be suppressed or transformed. Experiments on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO further characterize the effectiveness and limitations of this representation principle, with the clearest gains on the multi-target CIRCO benchmark. These results show that how composed intent is represented before retrieval is a consequential design choice, distinct from the choice of retrieval backbone itself.

</details>


### [177] [Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06147)
*Seungmin Oh,Seunghun Kang,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练的测试时校正框架TTC，将VLM-TTA重构为候选验证问题，通过最小化假设插入引起的子空间散度偏移来纠正预测，在15个数据集和5种TTA设置下兼顾精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）零样本迁移能力强，但在推理时对目标域偏移脆弱。现有VLM-TTA方法多采用"预测侧自适应"范式，依赖测试样本调整logits、原型、缓存、先验或特征统计量，常带来额外计算开销。作者希望跳出预测调整思路，寻求一种更高效、无需迭代优化的适应方式。

Method: 将VLM-TTA重新定义为候选验证而非预测调整，提出Test-Time Correction（TTC），遵循"假设—重构—校正"原则。给定测试特征及其top-k候选标签，将每个候选标签视为一个假设，在记忆库中对应的潜在子空间中重构该特征，并度量由此产生的散度偏移：该偏移量化假设插入后候选子空间及其与其他候选关系的改变程度。正确候选引起的偏移小，错误候选扰动更强。TTC据此选择聚合散度偏移最小的候选来校正预测。整个机制无需训练、无迭代优化。

Result: 在5种TTA设置与15个基准数据集上（包括零样本分类、域泛化、少样本分类、base-to-novel泛化、跨数据集评估）测试，TTC在精度上持续优于当前最先进的VLM-TTA方法，同时相对内存最低的无训练基线实现最高2倍加速、CPU内存降低超3倍、GPU内存降低最高1.4倍。

Conclusion: TTC以候选验证替代预测调整，提供了一种训练无关、无迭代优化的VLM测试时适应方案，在多种TTA场景下取得精度与效率的良好权衡，验证了假设重构与散度偏移度量作为校正信号的可行性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability but remain vulnerable to target-domain shifts at inference time. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical remedy, yet most existing VLM-TTA methods follow a prediction-side adaptation paradigm. They use test samples to adjust logits, prototypes, caches, priors, or feature statistics, often incurring additional computational overhead. In this paper, we take a different perspective and reframe VLM-TTA as candidate verification rather than prediction adjustment. We propose Test-Time Correction (TTC), a hypothesis-based correction framework guided by a simple principle: hypothesize, reconstruct, correct. Given a test feature and its top-k candidate labels, TTC treats each candidate label as a hypothesis, reconstructs the feature within the corresponding latent subspace stored in a memory bank, and measures the resulting divergence shift. This shift quantifies how much the candidate subspace and its relations to other candidates change after the hypothetical insertion of the test feature. A correct candidate hypothesis induces only a small shift, whereas an incorrect one perturbs the subspace more strongly. TTC therefore corrects the prediction by selecting the candidate with the minimum aggregated divergence shift. This training-free candidate-verification mechanism avoids iterative optimization and provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across five TTA settings and 15 benchmark datasets, including zero-shot classification, domain generalization, few-shot classification, base-to-novel generalization, and cross-dataset evaluation, TTC consistently improves accuracy over state-of-the-art VLM-TTA methods while achieving up to 2x speedup, over 3x lower CPU memory usage, and up to 1.4x lower GPU memory usage than the lowest-memory training-free baseline.

</details>


### [178] [Patch-based Querying Identifies Structures of Interest in Electron Microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06020)
*Niels Vyncke,Nicolas Nadisic,Yvan Saeys,Aleksandra Pižurica*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于自监督局部图像描述子的块级检索框架，用于在体积电子显微镜数据集中定位自相似结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: vEM可生成纳米级三维数据，但下游分析严重依赖人工预处理与标注，形成了数据规模与人工分析能力之间的瓶颈。

Method: 对局部图像描述子进行自监督学习，构建高效、可靠的块级（patch-based）检索框架；用户提供少量某类细胞结构的人工标注，方法据此在整个EM体积中检索相似结构，并支持交互式细化查询。

Result: 在真实生物组织vEM图像上的实验表明，该框架能可靠识别相关细胞结构，可跨不同细胞器与不同采集模态泛化，并显著缩小下游分析的搜索空间。

Conclusion: 自监督局部描述子检索可在极少标注下高效定位vEM中的目标结构，为缓解人工标注负担、加速下游分析提供可行方案。

Abstract: Volume electron microscopy (vEM) has emerged as an essential sensing technique in biomedical research, allowing the three-dimensional imaging of biological cells and tissues at nanometer-scale resolution. The ability to generate extensive datasets has reached the limitations of downstream analysis processes, which depend significantly on the intervention of human experts for preprocessing and annotation. We propose an efficient and reliable patch-based retrieval framework based on self-supervised learning of local image descriptors to locate self-similar structures in vEM datasets. Given a few manual annotations of a given cellular structure, our method can retrieve similar structures across the EM volume. Our framework is interactive, allowing the human expert to refine the search queries and retrieve relevant image patches quickly and using little labeled data. Experiments on real-world vEM images of biological tissues demonstrate that our framework can reliably identify relevant cellular structures, generalize across different organelles and acquisition modalities, and substantially reduce the search space for downstream analysis.

</details>


### [179] [Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06021)
*Shuo Chen,Fengming Huang,Yu Yao,Mingming Gong,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ARRO，将"仅修改指令指定属性、其他保持不变的"最小改动原则作为优化目标，用强化学习替代潜空间 L1 正则来提升指令图像编辑的输出局部性，在 FLUX.1 Kontext-dev 上提升 EditScore 并减少误改像素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令图像编辑应只改变指令指定的属性并保留其余内容，但现有方法常常产生非预期改动。作者把这一"最小改动"原则显式当作优化目标。潜空间 L1 正则在现代非线性生成器中只是输出局部性的劣质代理，且往往需要难以规模化获取的监督信号，因此需要新的优化手段。

Method: 将编辑结果优化建模为强化学习问题。使用一个代理式视觉-语言奖励模型（agentic VLM reward model）对源图、指令和编辑图进行审查，识别两类失败：请求的改动未实现、以及非预期的改动。通过组级评分表（group-level rubric）合并并核验这些问题，从而在无需逐条指令人工标注的情况下，为多个候选编辑提供一致的奖励信号。

Result: 在 FLUX.1 Kontext-dev 上，ARRO 将平均 EditScore 从 5.21 提升到 5.88（覆盖 MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench、Emu-Edit）。在 600 个评测样例上，相比基础编辑器将偏离目标的像素改动减少 8.4%。奖励与 SFT 对照组、盲测人工评估以及在 OmniGen2 上的迁移实验提供了互补证据。

Conclusion: 以强化学习直接优化编辑结果、并借助代理式视觉-语言奖励模型提供免人工标注的一致奖励，是提升指令图像编辑输出局部性的有效途径，可推广到其他生成器（如 OmniGen2）。

Abstract: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO

</details>


### [180] [Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06035)
*Jiamin Xu,Dongheng Wei,Jiarong Zhao,Qi Wang,James Tompkin,Weiwei Xu,Gang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出结合静态光照与闪光灯数据（各视角独立、fl​ash 开关自由）的室内逆渲染框架，基于 2DGS 重建并以 GS 锚定的漫反射场驱动材质分解，在漫反射色、反照率、粗糙度及重光照上优于六个基线，PSNR 提升 4.17 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一静态光照下的几何、材质与光照恢复高度病态；主动光照方案虽能降低歧义，却需要暗室或专用硬件，限制了日常场景的实用性。因此作者希望利用普通室内拍摄中天然可得的静态光与闪光灯组合，在不依赖特殊设备的前提下缓解逆渲染歧义。

Method: 从随意拍摄的独立视角采集 flash on/off 图像，以 2DGS 重建为框架。核心是 GS 锚定的漫反射场：在光栅化 2DGS 深度处查询哈希编码 MLP，因其仅依赖世界坐标，故在 3D 中视角一致，避免闪光残差被跨视角 alpha 混合漂移吸收，从而真正驱动材质分解。闪光残差约束反照率与 BRDF，静态光照则通过延迟着色渲染，捕捉闪光遗漏的掠射角高光，并同样监督材质分解。

Result: 在五个合成与三个真实室内场景上，方法在漫反射颜色、反照率与粗糙度材质参数上优于六个近期基线；重光照任务中 PSNR 比次优基线提升 4.17 dB。

Conclusion: 通过协同静态与闪光光照、并借助 2DGS 锚定的视角一致漫反射场，可在无专用硬件条件下显著改善室内逆渲染与重光照质量，验证了联合光照线索对材质分解的有效性。

Abstract: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.

</details>


### [181] [Representation Disentanglement for Fair Chest X-Ray Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06041)
*Yujie Sun,Ruizhe Li,Xiaowu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种单编码器框架，结合双层去相关与原型引导的跨群体对比学习，以减少胸部X光诊断中的族裔/性别/年龄等人口统计偏差，并提出新指标DRAR量化疾病表征中人口统计结构的削减程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在胸部X光（CXR）诊断中取得进展，但学到的表征可能存在人口统计偏差，导致不同交叉群体（年龄、性别、族裔）间的性能差异。现有方法未充分考虑类内变异与交叉群体的公平性问题。

Method: 提出单编码器框架：1）双层去相关（dual-level decorrelation）；2）原型引导的跨群体对比学习（prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning），在减少人口统计依赖的同时考虑类内变异。并提出新指标DRAR（Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction），用于量化疾病表征中人口统计结构的削减程度。在CheXpert的34,809张测试图像、8个交叉群体、4个分类任务上评估。

Result: 相比经验风险最小化（ERM），方法将平均均等几率差距（equalized-odds gap）从15.41%降至10.86%，AUC差距从5.95%降至5.01%。DRAR相对ERM达到59.04%，平均AUC仅轻微下降。

Conclusion: 结果表明表征解耦（representation disentanglement）可减少人口统计偏差并提升交叉群体公平性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Deep learning has advanced chest X-ray (CXR) diagnosis, yet demographic biases in learned representations may contribute to performance disparities across intersectional groups. We propose a single-encoder framework combining dual-level decorrelation with prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning to reduce demographic dependence while accounting for within-class variation. We further propose Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR), a new metric that quantifies the reduction in demographic structure within disease representations. The framework is evaluated on four classification tasks using 34,809 CheXpert test images across eight intersectional groups, defined by age, sex and ethnicity. Compared with empirical risk minimization (ERM), our method reduces the mean equalized-odds gap from 15.41\% to 10.86\% and the AUC gap from 5.95\% to 5.01\%. Our method achieves a DRAR of 59.04\% relative to ERM, with only a slight decrease in mean AUC. These results demonstrate that representation disentanglement can reduce demographic bias and improve intersectional fairness. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging}.

</details>


### [182] [SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06413)
*Rafael Teixeira Sousa,Vinícius Paulo Lopes de Oliveira,Elisa Ayumi Masasi de Oliveira,Luiza Martins de Freitas Cintra,Fernanda Bufon Färber,Igor Dias Aguiar,Julia Yasmim de Almeida Nobre,Arlindo Rodrigues Galvão Filho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialChain数据集与双轴评估协议，揭示思维型VLM的空间推理忠实度问题，并证明SFT可缓解捷径行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维型视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间基准上的准确率不断攀升，但最终答案分数无法判别正确预测究竟源于忠实的空间推理，还是语言捷径。需要一种独立于最终答案的推理过程评估手段。

Method: 构建SpatialChain：28,350条训练样本与899条测试样本，将空间导向的GQA问题与场景图锚定的推理链配对，仅在生成答案与符号真值一致时保留；并设计双轴评估——客观推理链重叠度指标 + 场景图感知的LLM评判器，独立于最终答案分别对忠实度与完整性打分。在9个思维型VLM上应用该协议，并以SFT验证，同时用198条人工标注验证评判器、用另一家供应商的评判器检验稳健性。

Result: (i) 9个模型中4个在VQA准确率≥79%的同时捷径率超过39%（答案正确但推理被判为不忠实）；(ii) 9个模型中7个的推理链质量显著预测答案正确性，两个例外（Claude Sonnet 4.6、InternVL3.5-8B）暴露了简洁输出与冗长装饰性推理两种截然不同的失败模式；(iii) 在SpatialChain上SFT使Qwen3-VL-8B域内提升+6.2个百分点，捷径率降至22%，外部基准上出现风格化专化效应，提示需采用回放增强训练；评判器与人工一致率等同人-人一致率，跨供应商评判器保持模型排序（ρ=0.88）。

Conclusion: 仅凭准确率会掩盖VLM空间推理中的捷径与异质失败模式；SpatialChain的双轴忠实度评估可揭示这些问题，且基于该数据的SFT能有效提升推理忠实度、降低捷径率，数据、生成脚本与评估代码已开源。

Abstract: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.

</details>


### [183] [Local2Mesh: Spatially Localized Contour-to-Mesh for Left Ventricular Reconstruction from Sparse 2D Cardiac MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06052)
*Haoyu Wu,Ling Lin,Pascal Lefèvre,Ruizhe Li,Xiaowu Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Local2Mesh框架，通过几何感知对齐与平面感知局部路由，从稀疏2D轮廓重建3D左心室网格，在M&Ms-2和ACDC上取得更优几何与功能估计并具跨数据集泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏心脏磁共振（CMR）图像重建三维左心室（LV）存在层间错位及层间局部空间信息不足的问题；而全局轮廓特征聚合会掩盖局部轮廓与表面之间的对应关系。同时，方法需在缺乏3D网格标注的条件下工作。

Method: 提出Local2Mesh，一种空间局部化的轮廓到网格（contour-to-mesh）框架：将模板网格变形以从稀疏2D轮廓重建3D LV几何，无需3D网格标注。框架包含：几何感知对齐（geometry-aware alignment）用于校正层间错位；平面感知局部路由器（plane-aware Local Router）依据顶点到平面的距离将轮廓特征路由至模板顶点；随后局部与全局轮廓特征共同引导基于图的模板变形完成3D重建。

Result: 在M&Ms-2与ACDC两个公开数据集上，几何重建与功能估计均优于现有方法；从M&Ms-2到ACDC的零样本迁移展现强跨数据集泛化能力；重建网格相比稀疏轮廓提升了疾病分类性能。

Conclusion: 将几何感知对齐与局部轮廓到顶点建模相结合，可提升从稀疏2D轮廓进行LV重建的效果，并支持下游心脏分析。代码已开源。

Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) left ventricular (LV) reconstruction from sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging remains challenging due to inter-slice misalignment and insufficient local spatial information between slices. Global aggregation of contour features may obscure local contour-to-surface relationships. We propose Local2Mesh, a spatially localized contour-to-mesh framework that deforms a template mesh to reconstruct 3D LV geometry from sparse 2D contours without 3D mesh annotations. The framework introduces geometry-aware alignment to correct inter-slice misalignment and a plane-aware Local Router that routes contour features to template vertices using vertex-to-plane distances. Local and global contour features then jointly guide graph-based template deformation for 3D LV reconstruction. Experiments on two public datasets, M\&Ms-2 and ACDC, demonstrate superior geometric reconstruction and functional estimation over existing methods. Zero-shot transfer from M\&Ms-2 to ACDC demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Reconstructed meshes also improve disease classification over sparse contours, supporting their utility for downstream cardiac analysis. These results demonstrate that combining geometry-aware alignment with local contour-to-vertex modeling improves LV reconstruction from sparse 2D contours and supports downstream cardiac analysis. The code is available at \url{https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh}.

</details>


### [184] [Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06063)
*Yunus Serhat Bıçakçı*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PalmCity街景全景语义分割挑战赛第一名方案：在近似等算力预算下比较9个预训练分割模型，最终以DINOv3编码器+Mask Transformer解码器（Encoder-only Mask Transformer）的3个随机种子等权概率平均、3尺度+水平翻转推理取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景全景语义分割可为城市环境提供细粒度描述，但该任务面临数据集规模小、不同模型训练成本不均的问题，导致模型选择困难。本文旨在在有限且可比的算力条件下系统比较多种现有架构，建立可复现的挑战赛工作流。

Method: 在近似相等的计算预算下对比9个预训练分割系统，包括DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、带线性解码器的DINOv3，以及使用DINOv3的Encoder-only Mask Transformer。对两个领先候选模型分别用3个随机种子和更长预算独立训练。推理阶段对3个Encoder-only Mask Transformer模型进行类别概率等权平均，并在3种图像尺度上结合水平翻转进行测试时增强。

Result: 在84张图像的公开验证集上取得60.95% mIoU和71.16% mean F1；在隐藏测试排行榜上取得57.08% mIoU和67.96% mean F1。在单张NVIDIA RTX 5090上生成全部249个测试掩码耗时251.49秒（含模型初始化与溯源检查），峰值GPU显存占用2.70 GiB。

Conclusion: 该研究完整报告了所有合格模型、全部推理变体、类别级错误、数据来源条件及可复现性检查，证明了在不引入新架构的前提下，通过等算力公平比较、多随机种子集成与多尺度测试时增强，即可在街景全景语义分割挑战赛中取得领先性能，并提供了有据可查的竞赛流程。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer using DINOv3. The two leading candidates are trained independently with three random seeds and longer budgets. Equal averaging of class probabilities from the three Encoder only Mask Transformer models, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, produces 60.95% mean intersection over union and 71.16% mean F1 on the 84 image public validation split. The submitted predictions receive 57.08% mean intersection over union and 67.96% mean F1 on the hidden test leaderboard. Producing all 249 test masks takes 251.49 seconds including model initialization and provenance checks on one NVIDIA RTX 5090. Peak allocated GPU memory is 2.70 GiB. The study reports all eligible models, all inference variants, class level errors, source conditions, and reproducibility checks, providing a documented challenge workflow with existing architectures.

</details>


### [185] [Anatomy-preserving unpaired cone-beam CT refinement for image-guided radiotherapy using pseudo-label guided diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06094)
*Qi Lai,Yutong He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RefineCBCT：一种基于伪标签引导与短步扩散的非配对CBCT图像精修框架，在LUNG与PELVIC TCIA数据上取得优于GAN与扩散方法的去伪影与CT值一致性效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导放疗，但散射、硬化、噪声、截断等伪影限制图像质量与CT值准确性；临床难以获得配对的CBCT-CT数据（受运动、解剖变化与采集不匹配影响），因此需要在非配对条件下实现CBCT精修。

Method: 提出RefineCBCT非配对精修框架，采用伪标签引导与短步扩散（short-step diffusion）策略，在减少伪影的同时保留患者个体化解剖结构。训练与评估使用公开LUNG TCIA与PELVIC TCIA的非配对CBCT及计划CT数据，并与代表性GAN与扩散方法对比。

Result: LUNG TCIA上所有指标最优：MAE 19.411、RMSE 62.758、PSNR 30.845 dB、SSIM 0.931；PELVIC TCIA上MAE、PSNR、SSIM最优，分别为14.905、36.671 dB、0.876。精修图像条纹与阴影伪影减少，解剖边界更清晰，软组织均匀性改善，线剖面与ROI分析与计划CT更接近。

Conclusion: RefineCBCT在临床现实的非配对训练条件下实现了高效有效的CBCT精修，有望支持图像引导放疗流程中更可靠的CBCT应用；代码已在GitHub公开，评估数据集可从The Cancer Imaging Archive获取。

Abstract: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used in image-guided radiotherapy, but scatter, beam hardening, noise, truncation, and other artifacts limit image quality and CT number accuracy. Paired CBCT and CT data are difficult to obtain clinically because of motion, anatomical changes, and acquisition mismatch. We present RefineCBCT, an unpaired CBCT refinement framework that uses pseudo-label guidance and short-step diffusion to reduce artifacts while preserving patient-specific anatomy. RefineCBCT was trained and evaluated on unpaired CBCT and planning CT data from public LUNG TCIA and PELVIC TCIA datasets and compared with representative GAN and diffusion based methods. On LUNG TCIA, it achieved the best results across all metrics, with MAE 19.411, RMSE 62.758, PSNR 30.845 dB, and SSIM 0.931. On PELVIC TCIA, it achieved the best MAE, PSNR, and SSIM, with values of 14.905, 36.671 dB, and 0.876. The refined images showed fewer streaking and shading artifacts, clearer anatomical boundaries, and improved soft tissue uniformity, with line profile and ROI analyses showing closer agreement with planning CT. These results suggest that RefineCBCT provides efficient and effective CBCT refinement under clinically realistic unpaired training conditions and may support more reliable CBCT use in image-guided radiotherapy workflows. Code is publicly available on GitHub, and the evaluated datasets are available from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

</details>


### [186] [Benchmarking CLIP for Zero-Shot Face and Periocular Gender Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06102)
*Fernando Alonso-Fernandez,Kevin Hernandez-Diaz,Jose Maria Buades,Josef Bigun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究CLIP在零样本性别估计中的应用，在全脸图像上达到95.54%准确率，眼周图像因决策边界偏差需阈值对齐，可达85.29%；线性SVM仅带来边际提升，眼周最佳86.17%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究CLIP是否能用于零样本性别估计，尤其考察难度更高的眼周（periocular）图像场景，并与文献中已有结果进行对比。

Method: 评估三种CLIP骨干网络，在Adience数据集11,299张正面图像上，使用male/female文本提示进行图像-文本相似度匹配；针对眼周图像，采用阈值对齐修正决策边界，并训练线性SVM分类器作对比。

Result: 全脸零样本准确率达95.54%，无需任务特定训练；眼周零样本预测偏男性，主要源于决策边界未对齐，阈值对齐后降至偏差并达85.29%；线性SVM仅带来边际提升，眼周最佳86.17%，较文献前人在Adience上的结果高约2.8%。

Conclusion: CLIP可用于零样本性别估计且全脸表现优异；眼周性能与全脸仍存在明显差距，证实眼周性别估计难度更大。

Abstract: We investigate CLIP for zero-shot gender estimation from full-face and periocular images. Three CLIP backbones are evaluated on 11,299 frontal images from Adience using image-text similarity with male/female prompts, achieving 95.54% full-face accuracy without task-specific training. For periocular, zero-shot predictions are strongly biased towards males, primarily due to a misaligned decision boundary. Threshold alignment substantially reduces this bias, reaching 85.29% accuracy. Linear SVMs trained on CLIP features provide only marginal gains, with a best periocular accuracy of 86.17%, approximately 2.8% above previous Adience results in the literature. Nevertheless, the gap with full-face performance confirms the greater difficulty of periocular gender estimation

</details>


### [187] [AnchorGen: Anchored Optimization for Customizable Generative 3D Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06135)
*Hantao Zhang,Oliver Heinimann,Jieke Wu,Yingxuan You,Emilien Seiler,Pascal Fua*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 AnchorGen：在成对形状-草图潜变量的拼接数据上无条件训练整流流模型，将草图约束施加于推理阶段，从而在保风格的前提下完成三维形状优化、显式维度编辑与仅草图生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程设计通常从确定风格与比例的2D草图出发，但后续三维形状优化依赖的生成先验对草图不可知：当把漂移的候选解修正回训练分布时，往往将其拉向高密度区域，从而忽略用户指定的设计意图，导致风格与比例失真。

Method: AnchorGen 采用整流流（rectified flow）框架，在配对数据的形状潜变量与草图潜变量拼接表示上做无条件训练，使学到的流形建模形状-草图联合分布。推理时施加约束：以梯度下降优化形状潜变量以最小化可微的阻力代理目标，同时对草图潜变量施加逐token余弦惩罚，使其贴近目标草图，从而将迭代限制在与目标风格一致的形状子流形上。

Result: 单一模型即可支持三类任务：保持风格的设计优化、显式指定维度的设计编辑，以及仅由草图出发的形状合成。

Conclusion: 通过无条件联合建模并在推理期以草图潜变量约束实现条件化，AnchorGen 避免了先验对草图不敏感、修正偏向高密度区的问题，为设计意图一致的三维形状优化提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Engineering design often starts from a 2D sketch that fixes style and proportions, yet the subsequent 3D shape optimization relies on learned generative priors to keep the geometry valid. However, these priors are agnostic to the sketch: while they admit a valid design by correcting a drifted proposal back to its training distribution, they often correct it towards the high-density region, ignoring the specified design. We introduce \emph{AnchorGen}, a rectified-flow framework trained unconditionally on the concatenated shape and sketch latents of paired data. The learned manifold represents the joint distribution of shape-sketch pairs, so constraining the sketch component restricts the iterate to the sub-manifold of shapes consistent with a target style. Since training employs no conditioning signal, the constraint is imposed at inference: gradient descent optimizes the shape latent to minimize a differentiable drag surrogate, while constraining the sketch latent to remain close to the target sketch via a token-wise cosine penalty. A single model thereby supports design-preserving optimization, dimensionally explicit design edits, and sketch-only synthesis.

</details>


### [188] [Bayesian Optimization in Sequence-to-Architecture Latent Space for Zero-Shot NAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06167)
*Ondrej Tybl,Lukas Neumann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将贝叶斯优化引入零样本神经架构搜索（zero-shot NAS），通过VAE学习架构的潜空间并设计代理标量化方法，在单卡8小时内找到在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三个任务上均达到SOTA的架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本NAS虽免去传统NAS的高昂训练成本，但其搜索过程通常基于进化算法，缺乏对目标的显式建模，往往退化为近似随机的变异搜索。贝叶斯优化通过建模目标并跨迭代聚合信息提供了更优的替代方案，但在现代NAS的高维、离散、图结构空间中扩展性差，仅适用于小规模网络。

Method: 1) 训练一个变分自编码器（VAE）来重建架构的新型前缀编码（prefix encoding），从而学习一个潜空间，将贝叶斯优化扩展到大规模架构；2) 提出一种代理标量化（proxy scalarization）方法，将多个零样本代理指标组合为单一的贝叶斯优化目标。

Result: 仅需10,000次搜索迭代（单张GPU约8小时），在给定的模型参数量约束下，所提方法找到的网络架构在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三个独立任务上均取得state-of-the-art结果。

Conclusion: 将贝叶斯优化与VAE潜空间建模及代理标量化相结合，可有效用于大规模零样本NAS，兼顾搜索效率与跨任务性能，突破了贝叶斯优化在高维离散图结构NAS空间中的扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: Zero-shot Neural Architecture Search removes the prohibitive cost of traditional NAS, but its search process is typically based on the evolutionary algorithm (EA); lacking an explicit model of the objective, it often resorts to a near-random search through mutation. Bayesian Optimization offers a principled alternative by modeling the objective and aggregating information across iterations, but scales poorly to the high-dimensional, discrete, graph-structured spaces of modern NAS, restricting its use to only small networks. In this paper, we bring Bayesian Optimization to zero-shot NAS for large-scale architectures by learning a latent space via a Variational Autoencoder trained to reconstruct a novel prefix encoding of architectures and propose a proxy scalarization that combines several zero-shot proxies into a single Bayesian Optimization objective. After only 10,000 iterations of the proposed search algorithm (8 hours on a single GPU), our method found a network architecture which under the given model parameter count constraints achieves state-of-the-art results on three separate tasks -- image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.

</details>


### [189] [EORestore-Agent: Fidelity-Guided Agentic Restoration of Remote Sensing Images with Composite Degradations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06196)
*Heli Qi,Zeqi Zhou,Jingjun Yi,Kunyi Liu,Ziyang Lihe,Junjue Wang,Osamu Yoshie,Naoto Yokoya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EORestore-Agent，将遥感图像复合退化复原建模为可追踪轨迹，用无参考、可验证的逐步决策替代不可测的全局目标，在合成 Landsat-8 基准上较最强 all-in-one 基线 PSNR 提升 2.3–3.2 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
