TL;DR: 提出 ChronoWorld 框架，通过"观测—状态—反射"范式实现全局一致的自由视角 4D 场景生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有相机可控视频生成模型虽视觉效果好，但难以保持内在的 4D 时空一致性。

Method: 1) 时空对极因果注意力（Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention），在多视角对极约束与时序因果性下生成；2) 重建驱动的几何反射管线，结合 4D 检索策略实现生成结果的动态自评估与校正。

Result: 在时空一致的电影级 4D 场景生成上达到 SOTA，跨多样场景具备强泛化性与高保真几何。

Conclusion: 融合时空因果线索与重建先验的 Observation–State–Reflection 框架可有效提升自由视角 4D 生成的全局一致性。

Abstract: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld, an "Observation--State--Reflection" framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.

</details>


### [224] [GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06688)
*Boaz Keren-Gil,James Gain,Patrick Marais*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 GS-Pool，用两个独立重建的 3DGS 场检测同一空间中的变化物体，在 PASLCD 上 mIoU/F1 达 0.751/0.846，显著超越 GS-Diff 等先前方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工厂、博物馆等场景在不同时间对同一空间分别扫描，需要判定哪些物体发生了变化。但两次访问用 3DGS 重建后无法直接比较：训练具有随机性，未变化空间的两次重建也不会重合，且第二次访问常为照片远少的快速重扫，因此需要专门的变化检测方法。

Method: GS-Pool 输入同一空间两个独立重建的高斯场，输出各自的变化物体及其掩码。将每次访问照片的 SAM2 掩码提升到渲染它们的高斯上，合并为物体池，使每个决策在 3D 中按物体只做一次。提出"摄影载体"：以每次重建对另一次访问照片的 3DGS 训练损失，反向传播到渲染各像素的高斯。将其与 GS-Diff 的几何和颜色项及蒸馏的 DINOv3 特征结合，与两次访问共有物体的证据对比，为每个场景设定变化阈值。

Result: 在 PASLCD 上，GS-Pool 达到 mIoU/F1 为 0.751/0.846，优于最强先前方法 GS-Diff 的 0.644/0.758，提升 17%/12%。其 mIoU 比 O-SCD、PlenoCI 和 MV-3DCD 分别高 36%、40% 和 57%；在 CL-Splats 上达到 0.855 mIoU，比 MV-3DCD 高 33%。每个变化物体以一组高斯形式返回，并附有决策依据证据，供检查者在 3D 中审阅。

Conclusion: GS-Pool 通过物体池、摄影载体损失及多证据融合，有效解决了独立 3DGS 重建难以直接比较的问题，实现了高精度的 3D 变化物体检测，并提供可解释、可审阅的 3D 证据。

Abstract: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.

</details>


### [225] [Extending Dynamic World Surface Water Mapping to Sentinel-1 with AlphaEarth Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06704)
*Rohit Mukherjee,Frederick Policelli,Beth Tellman,TC Chakraborty,Jonathan Giezendanner,Jonathan A. Sullivan,Ning Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出以Dynamic World（DW）水体类别作为弱监督标签，结合Sentinel-1 SAR回波与AlphaEarth Foundations（AEF）年际嵌入，实现全球10 m尺度、每次S1过境均可生成的水体制图模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dynamic World可在10 m分辨率实现全球土地覆盖制图，但依赖Sentinel-2光学影像，仅限无云观测，导致水体在时间与空间上覆盖受限。作者希望借助SAR的全天候成像能力突破云层限制，同时解决SAR水体标注稀缺的问题，利用已有光学产品作为可扩展的训练标签来源。

Method: 将DW水体类别作为弱监督信号训练Sentinel-1 SAR模型；以S1后向散射提供过境时刻观测，以AEF年度嵌入提供空间上下文；在53个全球分布场景上，使用S1过境48小时内获取的3 m PlanetScope影像独立标注进行验证，并与OPERA DSWx-S1产品及S1S2-Water基准对比，评估S1-only与融合模型性能。

Result: S1-only模型在53个场景上的汇总水体IoU达0.77，与OPERA DSWx-S1的0.75相当；加入AEF后提升至0.85。融合模型在44/53场景上优于S1-only模型，在48个场景上超过OPERA；在独立S1S2-Water基准上达到0.94，OPERA为0.87。

Conclusion: 光学土地覆盖产品可为SAR地表水制图提供可扩展的弱监督训练标签；融合SAR观测与空间嵌入的模型能显著提升水体识别精度，并优于现有业务化产品，为全天候全球水体制图提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google's AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.

</details>


### [226] [MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06801)
*Jiarui Chen,Zeqiang Lai,Jiangshan Wang,Ziheng Ouyang,Ye Huang,Xiangyu Yue,Cewu Lu,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架MC-Sparse，通过缓存元数据并跨去噪步复用，在视频与3D生成中实现高保真加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer在长序列生成（视频、高分辨率3D资产）中延迟高。稀疏注意力是主要加速手段，但现有方法在高稀疏度下会损害生成质量与保真度。作者通过受控的oracle对比实验，定位出质量退化的三个来源：token分组带来的约束、交互选择不准确、以及token被丢弃时损失的注意力贡献。

Method: 提出Meta-Cached Sparse Attention（MC-Sparse），一个免训练框架。它选择单个KV token，同时将相似query组织为tile对齐的分组以便GPU高效执行；缓存元数据，包括query分组、基于精确注意力概率选择的KV索引，以及稠密与稀疏注意力输出之间的残差，并在后续去噪步中复用这些元数据。

Result: 在视频与3D生成模型上，MC-Sparse比现有稀疏注意力基线更接近稠密注意力输出，且去噪加速更大，无明显质量下降。相对稠密注意力，在Minimax-H3-Base上实现1.80倍去噪加速，在3D资产生成上实现2.32倍加速，质量损失均可忽略。

Conclusion: MC-Sparse通过精准的KV选择、分组执行与元数据跨步复用，有效缓解了稀疏注意力的质量退化问题，在长序列扩散生成任务中实现了高保真且显著的推理加速。

Abstract: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a $1.80\times$ denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a $2.32\times$ speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.

</details>


### [227] [Less Context, Better Geometry: Masked Geometric Encoder for Robust 3D Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06813)
*Zhimin Shao,Xijun Liu,Zhaoliang Zhang,Yutao Tang,Abhay Yadav,Rama Chellappa,Cheng Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出掩码几何编码器MGE,通过训练时丢弃帧token并蒸馏全上下文教师模型,学习鲁棒的逐帧几何表示,并配合锚点引导的自适应token合并实现高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D基础模型依赖全对全全局注意力,存在二次复杂度、长序列推理受限的问题;同时无约束的跨视图交互会传播来自遮挡视图或视觉相似但几何距离较远的视图的不可靠证据。

Method: MGE在训练时策略性地从全局注意力中丢弃帧token,并从预训练的全上下文教师模型进行蒸馏;推理阶段提出Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging,在保留代表性锚点帧的同时合并其余视图中的冗余token。

Result: 在遮挡视图和相似干扰(doppelganger)视图下性能显著增强,同时标准基准上保持高性能;相比其他高效推理方法,在实现推理加速的同时持续保持更高的重建质量,尤其在有限视图设置下表现更优。

Conclusion: 通过在训练中引入不完全跨视图上下文并结合令牌合并,可同时提升几何表示的鲁棒性与推理效率,为可扩展的3D重建与相机标定提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.

</details>


### [228] [TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06814)
*Xuanyu Lu,Fengqing Jiang,Kaiyuan Zheng,Yichen Feng,Yaorui Ding,Yuetai Li,Zhen Xiang,Bhaskar Ramasubramanian,Basel Alomair,Luyao Niu,Radha Poovendran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 TAPDreamer，一种针对世界动作模型（WAM）的迁移性对抗攻击方法：仅利用公开编码器构造固定局部补丁，无需查询目标策略，即可在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 等基准上使成功率从 97.7%/90.8% 降至 0.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型依赖摄像头输入，其视觉表征被污染会跨任务、跨动作策略地破坏控制性能。已有攻击需针对受害者动作或预测未来进行优化，即需要访问目标模型输出，实用性受限。作者希望构造一种无需目标策略查询、可跨任务与跨动作架构迁移的攻击，以揭示共享视觉编码器的安全脆弱性。

Method: 核心洞察：补丁引起的注意力权重变化与 value 向量相互作用，会把表征偏移广播到远超补丁覆盖范围之处，且该偏移在不同任务观测下保持稳定。基于此，TAPDreamer 使用来自单一源任务的六帧图像，最大化干净与打补丁编码器表征之间的全局 L1 距离，从而生成一个固定的局部扰动补丁。攻击无需查询目标策略，仅依赖公开编码器。

Result: 闭环评估中，每个基准一个冻结补丁，覆盖约 6.5% 输入：FastWAM 在 40 个 LIBERO 任务上成功率由 97.7% 降至 0.0%，在 50 个 RoboTwin 任务上由 90.8% 降至 0.0%；匹配的随机补丁仍保持 81.5% 和 79.2% 成功率。同一补丁使两种 DreamWAM 配置降至 2.1% 与 0.8%，Motus 降至 10.0%，体现出强迁移性。

Conclusion: 结果说明仅保护下游动作生成不足以保障世界动作模型安全：防御必须同时加固共享视觉编码器，抵御持久性局部扰动。TAPDreamer 以极低成本（公开编码器、固定补丁、无目标查询）实现跨任务跨架构的高效攻击，凸显了该威胁的现实性与防御的紧迫性。

Abstract: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.

</details>


### [229] [Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06837)
*Xingyue Zhao,Yanzhou Su,Fang Zhang,Zhanghexuan Ji,Yirui Wang,Dazhou Guo,Sibo Ju,Yuehua Cheng,Yuzhen Chen,Ming Feng,Le Lu,Tsung-Ying Ho,Jian Wang,Dakai Jin,Na Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出解剖感知多模态框架，融合器官级CT上下文与影像报告，实现喉咽癌T分期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 喉咽癌T分期对个体化治疗至关重要，但临床依赖有创活检，CT分期因肿瘤侵犯模式复杂而困难。现有计算机辅助方法存在两大挑战：一是结构关系建模不足，要么处理整体CT缺乏肿瘤相关解剖约束，要么依赖耗时的人工肿瘤分割；二是细粒度跨模态对齐困难，全局特征融合难以将各解剖结构与报告中相应文本描述精确对应。

Method: 框架包含三部分：(1)构建解剖结构化器官图（AOG），刻画原发灶与周围器官间的侵犯模式；(2)器官锚定跨模态对齐（OCA），使每个器官节点聚合影像报告中的文本证据；(3)报告增强图细化（REG），通过注入报告中提取的器官特异性侵犯线索优化图表示，最终形成融合空间与文本证据的多模态器官图。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提框架在喉咽癌T分期任务上取得优越性能。

Conclusion: 该解剖感知多模态框架通过器官图建模与细粒度跨模态对齐，有效整合CT与影像报告，为喉咽癌无创T分期提供了可行且性能优越的方案。

Abstract: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG), yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.

</details>


### [230] [S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06847)
*Jeffrey Hu,Daniel Olmeda Reino,Ayush Tewari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD)，在高噪声阶段采用自回归扩散以协调相互依赖的事件与状态转移，在低噪声阶段切换为并行扩散以联合精修整个视频并提升采样效率。该方法在像素空间扩散Transformer及基于LoRA微调的预训练视频模型上实现，在游戏、物理模拟和真实视频中比双向基线更可靠地遵守规则，时序稳定性与采样效率优于其他串行方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双向视频扩散模型并行地去噪整个视频，但即使在由程序化生成器提供的近乎无限的分布内数据上训练，仍会违反物理定律和简单的符号规则。作者认为其根本原因在于并行去噪缺少协调相互依赖事件、生成有效状态转移所需的串行计算能力。

Method: 提出Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD)：在高噪声阶段执行自回归扩散，提供串行计算以协调相互依赖的事件并产生有效状态转移；在低噪声阶段切换为并行扩散，联合精修整个视频并相对完全串行生成降低采样时间。以两种架构实现：(1) 从零训练的像素空间扩散Transformer；(2) 通过带因果注意力的LoRA微调适配的预训练视频模型。

Result: 在游戏、物理模拟和真实视频三类任务上，S2PD 相比匹配的双向基线更可靠地遵循规则；相比其他串行方法，生成的视频具有更好的时序稳定性和更高的采样效率。

Conclusion: 将自回归（串行）与并行扩散按噪声水平分阶段结合，可兼顾规则一致性、时序稳定性与采样效率，为视频扩散模型的物理与符号规则遵循问题提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.

</details>


### [231] [One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06852)
*Shih-Chen Tseng,Chih-Hsuan Chen,Ryan Yang,Hsi-An Chen,Chun-Wei Tuan Mu,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"宽高比自适应流程图重布局"新任务，用Parse-Style-Layout三阶段智能体流水线（主智能体+批评者，结合确定性约束检查与VLM视觉反馈）生成结构忠实、无幻觉、可编辑的mxGraph XML，在100个流程图×5种宽高比的基准上内容保真度达68.6%，远超先前工作的11.2–41.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML论文中的流程图需要在多种画布间复用（论文栏、16:9幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1社交图、9:16手机预览），同一计算图在不同格式下被强加不同宽高比；任何被静默破坏的连接都会错误表达方法。作者将宽高比自适应流程图重布局形式化为独立任务：给定栅格流程图和目标宽高比，产出结构忠实、无幻觉、可编辑的布局。现有方法各有典型失败模式：图像到图像模型拉伸方块且无法处理极端比例，文本到图像的智能体系统产生幻觉内容，先解析后渲染的系统会错误路由边。

Method: 提出分解为Parse、Style、Layout三阶段的智能体流水线，每个阶段由一个主智能体配一个批评者组成；批评者将确定性约束检查与VLM视觉反馈相结合，从而对连通性进行显式校验，防止连接被静默破坏。输出为可在draw.io中编辑的mxGraph XML。

Result: 在包含100个流程图、5种宽高比的精选基准上，由Gemini 3.1 Pro评测并对照人工判断验证，本方法内容保真度达68.6%，而先前工作仅为11.2–41.4%。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了宽高比自适应流程图重布局这一新任务，并通过带批评者机制的分阶段智能体流水线，在保真度上显著优于现有方法，同时保证输出结构忠实、无幻觉且可编辑。

Abstract: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [232] [Fine-Grained Emotion Classification from Mobile App Reviews: An Empirical Study with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03802)
*Quim Motger,Carlota Catot,Marc Oriol*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用大语言模型对移动应用评论进行细粒度多标签情感分类，并系统比较编码器微调、解码器少样本提示及多种类别不平衡缓解策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度情感分类可支持情感驱动的需求工程活动（如问题优先级排序、面向功能的反馈分析），但应用评论的自动细粒度情感抽取研究不足，且面临严重类别不平衡问题。

Method: 基于既有标注框架与Plutchik分类法的人工标注真值，对比：编码器多标签微调与二元集成微调；开源与专有模型的解码器零样本/少样本提示；以及损失重加权、重采样、生成式数据增强等不平衡缓解策略，其中合成评论生成器与提示策略通过内在增强效用排序选择。

Result: 基线微调编码器远逊于最佳解码器少样本提示（macro-F1 0.642；多标签0.387，二元集成0.450）；最佳多标签编码器结合生成式数据增强与正类加权损失后缩小差距（+0.204），推理延迟低至解码器的千分之一，稀有情感提升最大（从未检出到最高+0.501 F1）。

Conclusion: 大语言模型使应用评论的细粒度多标签情感分类在需求工程流程中可行，macro-F1 中等，最佳方案与缓解策略依赖骨干模型与建模范式；作者公开实验流程、合成语料与微调检查点以供复现和复用。

Abstract: Context: Fine-grained emotion classification of mobile app reviews enables requirements engineering activities that go beyond polarity-based opinion mining, including emotionally informed issue prioritisation and feature-oriented feedback analysis. However, automatic fine-grained emotion extraction from app reviews remains understudied. Objectives: Building on a previously published annotation framework and human-labelled ground truth adapted from Plutchik's taxonomy, this paper investigates how large language models can be leveraged for automatic multi-label emotion classification under severe class imbalance. Methods: We compare encoder-only fine-tuning under multi-label and binary-ensemble formulations, decoder-only zero- and few-shot prompting across open-source and proprietary models, and a catalogue of imbalance mitigation strategies (loss reweighting, resampling, generative data augmentation), with the synthetic-review generator and prompting strategy selected via an intrinsic augmentation-utility ranking. Results: Fine-tuned encoders trail the best decoder-only few-shot prompting (macro-F1 0.642) by a wide margin at baseline (multi-label: 0.387; binary ensemble: 0.450); pairing the best multi-label encoder with generative data augmentation and positive-weighted loss closes most of this gap (+0.204) at up to three orders of magnitude lower inference latency than the decoders, with the largest gains on the rarest emotions, from undetected to gains of up to +0.501 F1. Conclusion: Large language models make fine-grained, multi-label emotion classification of app reviews feasible for requirements engineering pipelines, with modest macro-F1, and the best formulation and mitigation strategy are backbone- and formulation-dependent. We release the experimental pipeline, synthetic corpora, and fine-tuned checkpoints for replication and reuse.

</details>


### [233] [Same Output, Different Gold: Measuring How Reference Choice Moves a Multilingual Benchmark Score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03825)
*Parth Kulshreshtha,Shivali Dalmia,Abhishek Mukherji*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 以同一系统输出固定、替换参考标准的方式，测量基准分数对参考标注的敏感性：分数最高变化4.95个F1点（最差语言7.55），系统间比较也随参考变化而变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准分数的研究注意力几乎全部集中在系统输出一侧，参考标准（reference）本身被当作固定真值。本文指出参考标注的选择同样会显著影响分数与排名，且这种影响此前未被量化或记录。

Method: 利用一个六语言个人身份信息（PII）基准的留存标注记录：包含两位标注者的独立标注、作为gold发布的聚合结果，以及由独立专家对样本重新标注得到的reviewer gold。固定被打分的系统输出，仅替换参考标准，进行多次评分并计算差异与置信区间；同时检验参考×系统的配对交互效应，并做多重检验校正。

Result: 同一输出仅因更换参考，分数变化4.95个F1点（CI [3.23, 6.27]）与2.00个F1点（CI [0.26, 3.37]），最差语言达7.55。系统间比较也发生移动：参考与系统的配对交互为+2.95点（CI [+1.97, +3.87]），通过多重检验校正，并直接改变某一语言的优劣结论。成因是未记录的聚合默认值——当仲裁未触发时通常保留单标注者，使发布的参考成为被打分输出的部分拷贝。

Conclusion: 提出了"参考敏感性带宽"（reference-sensitivity band）这一指标，说明可从任何留存标注记录中计算，并主张该量应与分数并列报告，以暴露参考标注对评测结论的影响。

Abstract: A benchmark score compares a system output against a reference, and methodological attention falls almost entirely on the first term. We measure the second. The retained annotation record of a six-language benchmark for personally identifiable information contains two independent annotator labellings, the aggregate shipped as gold, and a reviewer gold from independent expert re-annotation of a sample. Using it, we hold the scored output fixed and exchange the reference. The score moves by 4.95 F1 points for one output and 2.00 for the other (95% CIs [3.23, 6.27] and [0.26, 3.37]), and by 7.55 in the worst language. The comparison between two outputs moves as well: the paired interaction between reference and system is +2.95 points (CI [+1.97, +3.87]), survives correction for multiple testing, and changes one language's margin outright. The cause is an undocumented aggregation default that usually kept one annotator when adjudication did not fire, making the shipped reference a partial copy of an output being scored. We report the resulting reference-sensitivity band, show how to compute one from any retained annotation record, and argue that the quantity belongs beside the score.

</details>


### [234] [The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03827)
*Saman Rahbar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文质疑相似度分数的可解释性：当被共享结构缺失或测量工具失效时，分数仍可能很高。通过跨语言探针迁移和脑响应匹配两个场景，证明常规证据与分数对"工具-单位-基线"高度敏感，需先检验无对应关系时的分数残值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究者常用一个相似度分数来支持"模型与大脑共享结构"或"跨语言共享结构"的论断，但很少检验：当共享结构不存在、或测量工具本身失效时，该分数还能读出什么。论文旨在揭示这类分数的脆弱性与虚假性。

Method: 设置两个检验场景。场景一：训练探针区分某语言的合语法/不合语法句，观察跨语言迁移性能；并用不同统计单元（272个语言对 vs 17种语言）做显著性检验。场景二：训练语言模型匹配人脑响应，比较真实脑目标与"被破坏的脑目标"的相似度分数，并测试无模型时的基线分数；另做沿语言自身方向操控的干预实验，检验效应是否随语言距离变化。

Result: 场景一中，探针本身沿语言距离变差，17种语言有4种处于随机水平，导致272个语言对中有64个由失效工具评分；剔除这些语言后关系强度减半，但它们恰是最远距离语言，设计无法分离两种效应。统计上，按272对独立计p=0.0006，按17种语言（正确单位）计p=0.155。场景二中，脑相似度从0.10升到0.34（上限0.54），但对"脑对应被破坏"的目标训练仍达0.31，真正特异于大脑的增量仅0.028–0.068；无模型时被破坏目标已达0.204，该下限与目标排名/句数成正比。操控实验显示沿自身方向有效（17种语言中16种比随机方向高6.2），但效应不随语言距离变化。

Conclusion: 相似度分数在缺乏真实共享结构或工具失效时仍可能呈现貌似显著的结果，其数值受工具有效性、统计单元和基线下限的严重影响。论文主张：在断言"对应关系有帮助"之前，应先评估在没有该对应关系时分数能保留多少，即建立无对应基线。

Abstract: Researchers often support the claim that a model shares structure with the brain, or across languages, by reporting a similarity score. We ask what such a score reads when the shared structure is absent, or when the tool that measures it does not work. We check two settings, and in both the score is not what it appears. First, a probe trained to tell grammatical from ungrammatical sentences in one language transfers worse to more distant languages, the usual evidence for shared structure. But the probe itself gets worse along the same axis: in four of seventeen languages it performs at chance, so 64 of 272 language pairs are scored with a tool that does not work. Dropping those languages halves the strength of the relationship, but they are also the most distant, and this design cannot separate the two effects. Counting matters too: the same data give p = 0.0006 when the 272 pairs are treated as independent and p = 0.155 when the seventeen languages are, which is the correct unit. Second, training a language model to match human brain responses raises its similarity score from 0.10 to 0.34, against a ceiling of 0.54. A model trained on a target whose correspondence to the brain was destroyed still scores 0.31, so only 0.028 to 0.068 of the rise is specific to the brain. With no model at all, a destroyed target already sits at 0.204 from the real one, a floor that tracks the target's rank divided by the number of sentences. Finally, steering a language along its own direction works (+6.2 over a random direction in sixteen of seventeen languages) yet shows no effect that varies with language distance. Before asking whether a correspondence helps, ask how much of the score would survive without it.

</details>


### [235] [OncoNoteBERT: A Foundation Representation Model for Natural Language Processing of Real-World Outpatient Oncology Notes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03829)
*Wuraola Oyewusi,Eliana Vasquez Osorio,Goran Nenadic,Gareth Price*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究基于英国门诊肿瘤学语料（21,564名肺癌和头颈癌患者的290,026份病历），开发并评估了肿瘤学专用BERT编码器，发现继续预训练与定制分词器提供互补优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界肿瘤门诊病历包含专业术语、肿瘤分期表达、治疗方案、毒性描述和机构特有的去标识化标记，通用生物医学或邻近临床语言模型难以高效表征这些内容，因此需要开发肿瘤学专用的编码器。

Method: 使用受治理的英国门诊肿瘤学语料（290,026份病历，21,564名肺癌和头颈癌患者），将RadBERT和PathologyBERT与两种本地策略对比：OncoNote-RadBERT（继续掩码语言模型预训练）和OncoNoteBERT（使用肿瘤学WordPiece分词器从头训练）。评估采用验证集上的掩码语言建模损失与困惑度、分词器碎片化指标、临床术语分词、掩码标记探测及探索性表征分析。

Result: 两个外部编码器在零样本评估中对肿瘤学语料拟合较差（RadBERT困惑度113.04；PathologyBERT 2035.03），继续预训练拟合最佳（OncoNote-RadBERT 2.10）。OncoNoteBERT困惑度为2.83，但分词效率最高，具有更低的子词生育率和更短归一化序列长度；在13个掩码标记探测中有12个给出临床可接受预测，而OncoNote-RadBERT为7个。语料级拟合与掩码标记表现的分歧部分归因于分词器碎片化而非仅学习语义。两个本地模型均将机构占位符表示为单一可学习标记。

Conclusion: 继续适应与定制分词提供互补收益；在将邻近领域编码器应用于肿瘤学NLP之前，表征层设计至关重要。

Abstract: Real-world outpatient oncology notes contain specialised terminology, tumour staging expressions, treatment names, toxicity descriptions, and institution-specific de-identification markers that may not be represented efficiently by general biomedical or adjacent clinical language models. We developed and evaluated oncology-specific BERT-style encoders using a governed UK outpatient oncology corpus comprising 290,026 notes from 21,564 patients treated for lung and head-and-neck cancer. We compared RadBERT and PathologyBERT with two local strategies: OncoNote-RadBERT, produced by continued masked language model pretraining, and OncoNoteBERT, trained from scratch with an oncology WordPiece tokenizer. Models were evaluated using masked language modelling loss and perplexity on the validation set, tokenizer fragmentation metrics, clinical term tokenisation, masked-token probes, and exploratory representation analysis. Both external encoders fit the oncology corpus poorly in zero-shot evaluation (perplexity 113.04 for RadBERT; 2035.03 for PathologyBERT), while continued pretraining produced the strongest fit (2.10 for OncoNote-RadBERT). OncoNoteBERT achieved perplexity 2.83 but produced the most efficient tokenisation, with lower subword fertility and shorter normalised sequence length. It also returned a clinically acceptable prediction for 12 of 13 masked-token probes, compared with 7 of 13 for OncoNote-RadBERT. This divergence between corpus-level fit and masked-token performance was partly attributable to tokenizer fragmentation rather than learned semantics alone. Both locally developed models represented the institutional placeholder as a single learnable token. These findings show that continued adaptation and bespoke tokenisation provide complementary benefits, and that representation-layer design matters before adjacent-domain encoders are applied to oncology NLP.

</details>


### [236] [SYNLAT: Syntax-Aligned Text-Latent Compression for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03839)
*Yifeng Zhao,Hongjun Yu,Shibo Wang,Yunjiao Zhou,Zixiao Zhu,Zhipeng Ning,Kezhi Mao,Junlang Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SynLat：基于句法对齐单元（SAU）的文本-隐空间CoT压缩框架，将压缩边界对齐句法结构，由答案条件教师生成渐进式KEEP/LATENT目标，训练单一压缩条件学生模型，推理时仅凭问题与压缩级别生成混合推理，在12组任务聚合中11组领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链思维（Long-CoT）轨迹带来高昂的输出token成本，预算受限下压缩须保留答案关键信息，因此压缩边界位置至关重要。token级与定长边界会割裂短语、公式、局部推导等连贯片段，step级边界又会捆绑需要不同压缩动作的内容。

Method: 提出SynLat文本-隐空间CoT框架，通过不重叠的句法对齐单元（Syntax-Aligned Units, SAUs）使压缩边界与句法结构对齐；由答案条件教师（answer-conditioned Teacher）为单一压缩条件学生模型构建渐进式KEEP/LATENT目标；推理时学生模型仅需问题和请求的压缩级别即可生成混合推理。

Result: 在两个Qwen3学生规模、Standard-CoT与Long-CoT组及三个压缩级别下，SynLat在全部12个任务组聚合中达到或超过最强基线，在报告达成压缩率（achieved-CR）选择协议下于11组严格领先。整体增益：MEDIUM级别Qwen3-8B/14B分别+3.6/+2.6分，HIGH级别+7.0/+5.5分，且压缩更强时优势更大，尤其体现在Long-CoT组。

Conclusion: 以句法结构对齐压缩边界的SynLat在多种学生规模与压缩级别下均优于现有基线，且在强压缩与长链推理场景中优势更为显著，验证了边界放置对CoT压缩的关键作用。

Abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces impose substantial output-token costs. Under constrained budgets, compression must preserve answer-critical information, making boundary placement central. Token-level and fixed-length boundaries can fragment coherent spans such as phrases, formulas, and local derivations, whereas step-level boundaries can bind content requiring different compression actions. We introduce SynLat, a text-latent CoT framework that aligns compression boundaries with syntactic structure through non-overlapping Syntax-Aligned Units (SAUs). An answer-conditioned Teacher constructs progressive KEEP/LATENT targets for a single compression-conditioned Student, which generates mixed reasoning from only the question and requested compression level at inference. Across two Qwen3 Student scales, Standard-CoT and Long-CoT groups, and three compression levels, SynLat matches or exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in all 12 task-group aggregates and strictly leads in 11 under the reported achieved-CR selection protocol. Overall gains reach 3.6/2.6 points at MEDIUM and 7.0/5.5 points at HIGH for Qwen3-8B/14B, with larger advantages under stronger compression, particularly on Long-CoT groups.

</details>


### [237] [When Evidence Changes: Evaluating Memory Repair and Re-reading in Language-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03902)
*Wenhui Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"证据修订"评测，在ICU用药与问题列表任务上比较记忆修复与重新阅读证据的成本与效果，发现记忆流水线在短记录上成本高于完整重读，仅在长记录多次使用后才低于重读，且替代研究无显著结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当支持智能体推导事实的文档被撤销或替换时，应修复记忆还是重新阅读当前证据尚不明确；需要评估记忆在证据修订后的真实成本，并将其与源过滤重读在全流水线上进行对比。

Method: 在公开ICU记录的用药与问题列表任务上设计证据修订评测；在撤销、替换和控制事件下，对两个7B模型比较完整重读、源过滤重读与缓存、重建、图局部修复等方法；记忆以全量供给无需检索；成本计入摄入、修订及每次使用。

Result: 短记录上局部修复的修订token比重建少5-10倍，但任何记忆流水线在留出条件下的成本至少是完整重读的两倍；在约10,000 token的记录上，记忆的平均累积成本在2-14次使用后低于完整重读，部分源于截断抽取，而源过滤重读始终最便宜；替代研究中四项主要验证性检验均未达统计显著。

Conclusion: 证据修订后智能体记忆的成本必须在全流水线上与源过滤重读进行对比评估。

Abstract: When documents supporting an agent's derived facts are revoked or replaced, should it repair memory or re-read current evidence? We introduce an evidence-revision evaluation on medication- and problem-list tasks from public ICU records. Under revocation, replacement and control events, we compare full and source-filtered re-reading with caching, rebuilding and graph-local repair across two 7B models. Memory is supplied in full without retrieval, and costs include ingest, revision and every use. On short records, local repair uses 5-10$\times$ fewer revision tokens than rebuilding, yet every memory pipeline costs at least twice full re-reading in held-out conditions. In a small pre-specified development sweep, adding task-ineligible documents extended records to about 10,000 tokens; at that length, memory's mean cumulative cost fell below full re-reading's after 2-14 uses, partly through truncated extraction, while source-filtered re-reading remained cheapest. In the replacement study, none of the four primary confirmatory tests reached statistical significance. These results show why the cost of agent memory after evidence revision must be assessed against source-filtered re-reading over the full pipeline.

</details>


### [238] [General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03935)
*Feiyu Duan,Jiayu Lin,Jia Wang,Jun Xiang,Jialiang Wu,Xinnong Zhang,Hanqi Yan,Siyuan Wang,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出双语基准JEVal（11,257实例、36数据集、10领域），评测25个模型配置，系统分析通用决策模型的能力边界与组合失效问题，并提出InnerJev-4B/27B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用决策模型（如Jev）被视为LLM在结构化判断与选择任务上的高效替代方案，但其可靠决策范围、以及个体决策组合成更大系统后的行为变化尚不明确，缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 构建JEVal双语基准（11,257实例，覆盖36个数据集、10个应用领域），评测25个模型配置（通用决策模型与生成式LLM）；在τ-bench上考察长时程多步交互，在大规模社会模拟中考察个体响应预测与用户画像；提出Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation，将开放权重LLM的推理内化为单次前向的首token决策，得到InnerJev-4B与InnerJev-27B。

Result: 通用决策模型在证据充分时可解时最具竞争力，但在需要专业知识或忠实不确定性估计时表现下降，常能识别最可能结果却大幅高估其概率；在长时程多步系统中，快速局部决策虽降低τ-bench的中位回合耗时，却因误差累积降低任务成功率；在社会模拟中，其个体响应预测接近强生成式LLM且推理成本显著更低，但用户画像较弱、聚合估计误差更大并存在系统性偏差；InnerJev-27B在JEVal上与Jev相当，典型查询耗时约0.1秒。

Conclusion: 通用决策模型适用于证据可直接支撑的局部决策，但在专业推理、不确定性校准与系统级、聚合级任务中可靠性不足；通过推理自蒸馏可将LLM推理能力压缩为高效单次决策，实现接近Jev的精度与约0.1秒级延迟。

Abstract: General decision models, such as Jev, have recently emerged as efficient alternatives to LLMs for structured judgment and selection. But what kinds of decisions can these models reliably make, and how does their behavior change when individual decisions are composed into larger systems? To study this, we introduce JEVal, a bilingual benchmark comprising 11,257 instances from 36 datasets across 10 application domains, and evaluate 25 model configurations spanning general decision models and generative LLMs. Our results show that (1) general decision models are most competitive when decisions can be resolved from available evidence, but weaken when they require specialist knowledge or faithful uncertainty estimation: they can often identify the most likely outcome while substantially overstating its probability. (2) In more dynamic and realistic systems involving long-horizon, multi-step interactions, the advantages of fast local decision making are offset by reliability failures at the system level. on $τ$-bench, faster local decisions reduce median episode time but lower task success as decision errors accumulate over long trajectories. (3) In large-scale social simulation, decision models approach strong generative LLMs on individual response prediction at substantially lower inference cost, yet remain weaker in user profiling and exhibit larger aggregate estimation errors and systematic bias. Finally, we propose InnerJev-4B and InnerJev-27B, which internalize an open-weight LLM's own reasoning into a single-pass first-token decision through Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation, with InnerJev-27B performing on par with Jev on JEVal while answering a typical query in about 0.1 s.

</details>


### [239] [A Step Towards Forgetting: Optimiser History and the Loss of Answer Mass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03940)
*Valeria Ruscio,Seth Nabarro,Keiran Thompson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究揭示优化器（Adam）动量中的历史梯度是语言模型微调中灾难性遗忘的重要来源：旧任务答案概率（answer mass）下降主要由历史梯度驱动，当前梯度反而倾向保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调时即使当前梯度试图保持已学答案的概率，模型仍会降低这些答案的概率；作者想弄清优化器的动量记忆（历史梯度）如何导致遗忘。

Method: 将旧任务损失分解为“答案间混淆”与“概率泄漏到答案集之外”；在三个语言模型家族上观察；分解Adam更新为历史累积贡献与当前梯度贡献；按梯度年龄解析历史来源；进行动量重置并匹配初始更新范数的干预实验；沿有限更新做积分以考察局部投影与沿历史的曲率。

Result: 答案质量一致下降而旧答案间判别力通常提升；历史累积促进泄漏、当前梯度反对泄漏；有害贡献主要来自新任务的较老梯度，近期梯度倾向保护旧答案；历史效应变化由其对旧任务梯度的方向主导；动量重置实验表明存储历史影响保持，具状态依赖的即时效应，较长Adam持续训练下最终旧任务损失更低、主要靠恢复答案质量；多数大幅损失上升可由局部投影捕获，曲率放大部分事件。

Conclusion: 优化器的记忆会侵蚀已学行为，即使当前梯度在保护它；遗忘是优化动力学（动量历史）的产物，而不仅是数据分布偏移。

Abstract: During fine-tuning, a language model can assign less probability to previously learned answers even when the current gradient acts to preserve that probability. With momentum, each update also carries gradients computed at earlier model states, and these stored contributions can push the model in the opposite direction. We investigate how this optimiser memory contributes to forgetting by separating old-task loss into confusion among its answers and leakage of probability outside the answer set. Across three language-model families, answer mass consistently declines while discrimination among old answers usually improves: the model becomes less likely to produce answers that it can still distinguish correctly. Decomposing Adam updates reveals opposing contributions to this loss of answer mass. Over training, accumulated history favours leakage, while the current gradient opposes it. Resolving history by age shows that the harmful contributions come mainly from older gradients of the new task, whereas recent gradients tend to protect the old answers. Changes in history's effect are dominated by its orientation relative to the old-task gradient. Interventions that reset momentum while matching the initial update norm establish that stored history affects retention, with state-dependent immediate effects and lower final old-task loss over longer Adam continuations, mainly through recovered answer mass. Finally, integration along finite updates shows that most sampled large loss increases are captured by local projections, while curvature along history amplifies some events. Together, these findings reveal how an optimiser's memory can erode learned behaviour even as its current gradient acts to preserve it.

</details>


### [240] [BAIBAICHUCHU at the NTCIR-19 FinArg-3 Task: When Is Maximum Possible Profit Predictable from Investor Text?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03962)
*Zong-Han Bai,Po-Yen Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文报告BBCH团队参加NTCIR-19 FinArg-3社交媒体子任务（按最大可能收益MPP对中文投资者帖子排序）的结果：三路集成在开发集达0.734，但官方最佳仅0.517，全部12个提交运行介于0.4598–0.5402。事后审计发现LLM评判器对看跌帖误用long-only规则；分解表明波动率×horizon项对后期MPP代理有预测力，而迁移文本几乎无相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FinArg-3社交媒体子任务要求按Maximum Possible Profit（MPP）对中文投资者帖子排序，但MPP同时依赖文本立场、市场波动与时间horizon，现有做法多仅依赖文本语义。作者希望厘清：开发集与官方评测间的巨大性能落差（0.734 vs 0.517）来自何处，以及排序能力究竟由文本、市场regime、波动率、horizon还是配对组成驱动。

Method: 采用三路集成：词汇特征、FinArg-2预微调的MacBERT排序器、LLM评判器。使用post-grouped开发评测与官方提交运行对比。事后审计检查评判器的long-only规则对看跌帖的误用。将排序任务分解为方向性文本、波动率与horizon、成对margin三部分，构建running-extremum模型预测σ√T缩放，并用预发布波动率σ_pre,20√N_i刻画后期截断horizon的MPP代理。

Result: 三路集成开发集0.734，官方最佳运行0.517，12个运行范围0.4598–0.5402，26个三路一致对为0.500。修正long-only规则改变87条官方预测中的28条，准确率不变，但开发准确率从0.680降至0.622。running-extremum模型预测的σ√T缩放在2026年7月独立采集的502个价格对齐帖中事后观测到。σ_pre,20√N_i与后期MPP代理Spearman ρ=0.320（ticker聚类95% CI [0.133,0.466]），正确排序61.4%的不等结果对；迁移文本与7月结果几乎不相关（ρ=0.055），在给定该分数与立场后增量极小。开发可靠性随标注MPP差距增大从约0.60升至0.93。早期ERAI结果0.6207排除普遍不可预测性的简单解释。

Conclusion: 评测应联合考虑文本、市场regime、历史波动率、horizon和配对组成，而非仅依赖文本语义；开发集上的高拟合可能来自regime特定的语义shortcut，需警惕其对官方评测的迁移失效。

Abstract: The BAIBAICHUCHU team participated in the Social Media Subtask of NTCIR-19 FinArg-3, ranking Chinese investor posts by Maximum Possible Profit (MPP). A three-track ensemble of lexical features, a FinArg-2-pre-finetuned MacBERT ranker, and an LLM judge reaches 0.734 in post-grouped development evaluation, but our best official run scores 0.517. All twelve submitted runs lie between 0.4598 and 0.5402, and our 26 unanimous three-track pairs score 0.500.
  A post-hoc audit finds that the submitted judge applied a long-only rule to bearish posts although MPP is stance-aware. Correcting it changes 28 of 87 official predictions without changing accuracy, yet lowers development accuracy from 0.680 to 0.622: a regime-specific semantic shortcut improved validation fit.
  We decompose ranking into directional text, volatility and horizon, and pairwise margin. A running-extremum model predicts $σ\sqrt{T}$ scaling, observed ex post in 502 price-aligned posts from a separate July 2026 collection. Pre-posting volatility scaled by the post-specific observation horizon, $σ_{\mathrm{pre},20}\sqrt{N_i}$, is associated with a later truncated-horizon MPP proxy (Spearman $ρ=0.320$; ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]) and correctly orders 61.4% of unequal-outcome pairs. Transferred text is nearly uncorrelated with the July outcome ($ρ=0.055$) and adds little conditional on this score and stance. Development reliability rises from about 0.60 to 0.93 as the labeled MPP gap widens. An earlier ERAI result of 0.6207 rules out universal unpredictability as a simple explanation. Evaluation should jointly consider text, market regime, historical volatility, horizon, and pair composition.

</details>


### [241] [Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04002)
*A. Bochkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究检验语言模型是否需要可训练的词元输入嵌入表：用固定16位词元ID码与GF(2)可逆编码替代可学习嵌入，模型仍获得显著能力，但性能未达对照组水平，说明固定身份接口可行而非等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可训练输入嵌入表为每个词表项分配独立可调向量，本文追问这种词元专属参数化是否是获得大语言建模能力的必要条件，还是共享Transformer可以仅凭固定词元身份学习。

Method: 对比三个从零训练的decoder-only语言模型，三者共享同一分词器、上下文骨干、解绑输出头架构与训练配方，目标预算为每模型1000亿预测词元。输入接口分别为：可学习嵌入表、规范16位词元ID码、GF(2)上一种固定可逆重编码；固定码按模型宽度重复且不添加可训练输入投影。

Result: 两种固定码模型均获得显著能力：规范码达52.40% HellaSwag归一化准确率、70.51% PIQA准确率、42.75% LAMBADA准确率。可学习输入对照组在包括HellaSwag与LAMBADA在内的多项评测上更优。固定接口移除1.007亿可训练参数，模型规模为17.11亿参数。

Conclusion: 这些单次运行实验区分了架构必要性与经验效用：独立可训练的词元专属输入向量并非所观测能力的必要条件，但结果仅证明可行性而非性能持平；固定身份接口也为研究不可变输入下游的表示学习提供了受控设置，但不确定具体能力的位置。

Abstract: A trainable input embedding table assigns each vocabulary item an independently adjustable vector. We investigate whether this token-specific parameterization is required for substantial language-modeling capability, or whether a shared Transformer can learn from fixed token identities. We compare three decoder-only language models trained from scratch with the same tokenizer, contextual backbone, untied output-head architecture, and training recipe, with a target budget of 100 billion prediction tokens per model. Their input interfaces are a learned table, canonical 16-bit token-ID codes, and one fixed invertible recoding over GF(2). The fixed codes are repeated to model width without an additional trainable input projection. Both fixed-code models acquire substantial capabilities: canonical codes achieve 52.40\% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.51\% PIQA accuracy, and 42.75\% LAMBADA accuracy. The learned-input control performs better on several evaluations, including HellaSwag and LAMBADA, so these results establish viability rather than performance parity. The fixed interfaces remove 100.7 million trainable parameters, yielding 1.711B-parameter models, but parameter reduction is not the central result. These single-run experiments distinguish architectural necessity from empirical utility: independently trainable token-specific input vectors are not required for the observed capabilities. A fixed identity interface also provides a controlled setting for studying representation learning downstream of an immutable input, without establishing where particular capabilities are localized.

</details>


### [242] [Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04047)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Anas Obayd,Raed Rashid,Abdulrahman Alghamdi,Abdulrahman Mousa,Abdallah Ahmed,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Periscope是一种免训练推理方法，将长文本的N个块排成K×K网格，用冻结模型对局部跨度和跨步跨度提问，以log-odds实现证据定位，使有限集合决策的读取可在$s^{1.5}$代价下完成，替代长文本单次二次读取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型单次前向读取长文本时复杂度为二次，受限于上下文窗口，且在达到窗口前准确率随长度下降。作者希望验证：当决策针对有限集合（如哪篇文档相关、哪个选项被支持、哪段是证据）时，长读取是否可以被分解。

Method: Periscope将文本的$N$个块排列在$K{\times}K$网格上（$K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$），向冻结模型就$K$个连续块局部跨度与$K$个采样全文的跨步跨度提出同一问题，读取每个答案在单个token处的log-odds。每个答案取其最佳局部与跨步得分；对每个块用其两个跨度打分，额外零成本生成证据图，其峰值即答案背后的块。

Result: 在LongBench v2上，仅读取证据图排名最高的$K$个块（9k tokens）即可匹配同一模型在32k至1M窗口的最佳读取；在InfiniteBench（中位上下文150k tokens）上比最佳窗口读取领先5分。同一证据图在BRIGHT长文档语料上取得六种方法中最佳NDCG@10。每次调用仅缓存一个probe，27B模型可在单个80GB GPU上读取4.5M-token上下文，而单次完整前向需296GB缓存。

Conclusion: 长文本读取无需以文本长度决定显存需求。Periscope通过因子化读取与证据图定位，使长读取只需能容纳模型的GPU，而不再需要能容纳文本的GPU。

Abstract: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the $N$ chunks of a text on a $K{\times}K$ grid with $K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$ and asks a frozen model the same question about $K$ local spans of consecutive chunks and $K$ strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about $\sqrt{sc}$ tokens for a text of $s$ tokens and chunk size $c$, so a window of $W$ tokens reaches $W^{2}/c$ tokens at $s^{1.5}$ cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the $K$ chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.

</details>


### [243] [IdeaScientist: Orchestrating Agents for Grounded Scientific Ideation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04074)
*Jiarui Liu,Renjie Tao,Yiwei Liao,Chuanyang Jin,Kai Sun,Xiao Yang,Xinyuan Zhang,Xilun Chen,Zhuangqun Huang,Lechen Zhang,Yongjin Yang,Yinghui He,Weihao Xuan,Rakesh Wanga,Anuj Kumar,Mona T. Diab,Wen-tau Yih,Xin Luna Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出IdeaScientist，将科研选题拆解为缺口发现、创新、报告撰写三个角色并用强化学习分别训练，配合2.77M规模的想法语料库Svalbard Idea Vault，在时间受控评测下显著超越开源与闭源基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管科研自动化进展迅速，但生成有前景且论证充分的研究方案仍是核心难题。作者的核心直觉是：某一领域的挑战往往可被解决过类似问题的其他领域的机制所攻克，因此跨领域类比是提升选题质量的关键。

Method: 将研究选题（research ideation）独立为单独任务，构建IdeaScientist系统，把选题分解为缺口发现、创新、报告撰写三个角色，并分别用强化学习训练。各角色负责识别相关工作局限、从类比问题设定中提取解决直觉，并发展为完整研究提案。为支持跨领域洞见检索，构建Svalbard Idea Vault语料库，包含2.77M条分解后的研究想法，用于检索、训练与时间受控评测。

Result: 评测限制只使用截止日期前的文献，并以人类研究者后续发表的15K篇论文衡量所提方向与真实探索方向的一致程度。在Qwen3.6-27B上，IdeaScientist比最强开源自动科研基线高出14.0%，提升主要来自新颖性。在该27B开源骨干上，甚至超过使用Claude-4.8-Opus的Claude Code SDK与使用GPT-5.4的Codex SDK，最高领先5.9%。

Conclusion: 跨领域类比驱动的角色化分解与强化学习训练，可在中等规模开源模型上实现优于大型闭源系统的研究选题能力，验证了分解式框架与大规模想法语料库结合的有效性，并为时间可控、可复现的选题评测提供了范式。

Abstract: Despite rapid progress in automating scientific research, generating promising and well grounded research solutions remains a central challenge. We isolate research ideation as a standalone task and build our solution on the intuition that a challenge in one field can often be addressed by a mechanism that solved an analogous challenge in another. Accordingly, we introduce IdeaScientist, which decomposes ideation into gap finding, innovation, and report writing, and trains each role with reinforcement learning. These roles identify limitations in related work, draw solution intuitions from analogous problem settings, and develop those intuitions into complete research proposals. To facilitate discovery of insights across domains, we construct the Svalbard Idea Vault, a corpus of 2.77M decomposed research ideas for retrieval, training, and temporally controlled evaluation. Our evaluation restricts access to literature available before a cutoff date and assesses how closely proposed directions align with those later explored in 15K papers authored by human researchers. On Qwen3.6-27B, IdeaScientist outperforms the strongest open-source autoresearch baseline by 14.0%, driven mainly by gains in novelty. On this 27B open backbone, IdeaScientist even outperforms Claude Code SDK with Claude-4.8-Opus and Codex SDK with GPT-5.4, by up to 5.9%.

</details>


### [244] [Representation-Aligned Auxiliary Supervision for Language Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04098)
*Kyuyoung Kim,Peiyao Sheng,Ashwin Hebbar,Peiyang Xu,Yunfei Xie,Kevin Wang,Rui Xin,Chen Wei,Zhangyang Wang,Jinwoo Shin,Pramod Viswanath,Sewoong Oh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"表征兼容性"概念，通过国际象棋测试平台发现模型对语义等价但表征不同的输入处理差异显著，并提出"表征对齐辅助监督"方法，利用环境衍生的、以兼容表征表达的任务来提升结构化领域适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型虽具强推理能力，但在结构化领域（如国际象棋）的适应仍具挑战且结果不稳定。作者旨在找出导致适应不一致的关键因素，即模型对任务表征的有效处理程度（表征兼容性），并探索如何利用这一因素改善适应。

Method: 以国际象棋为受控测试平台（具备精确语义、可计算最优动作、多种状态表征：符号编码FEN与空间格式ASCII）。基于观察到模型对语义等价输入处理差异显著，提出"表征对齐辅助监督"（representation-aligned auxiliary supervision）：使用环境衍生的任务，以与模型兼容的表征表达，作为辅助监督信号，并结合目标数据训练。

Result: 在各模型与表征下，辅助监督相比仅用目标数据训练，能持续提升最优走法预测性能。揭示环境动态的任务比表面级或静态监督带来更大且更稳定的增益，并可媲美大幅增加目标数据量。此外，ASCII训练的模型向FEN迁移优于反向迁移，在FEN评测上甚至超过仅用FEN目标数据的基线。增益还延伸至开放式、事实依据的棋局解说生成任务。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在模型兼容表征中进行辅助监督，可有效促进结构化领域的模型适应；表征兼容性是结构化领域适应的关键因素，环境动态类辅助任务尤为有效。

Abstract: Language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet adapting them to structured domains remains challenging and can yield inconsistent outcomes. We identify representation compatibility, the extent to which a model effectively processes a representation for a structured task, as a key factor in adaptation. We study this in chess, which provides a controlled testbed with precise semantics, computable optimal actions, and multiple state representations, including a symbolic encoding (FEN) and a spatial format (ASCII). We find that models often process semantically equivalent inputs substantially differently, affecting both learning and generalization. Building on this observation, we propose representation-aligned auxiliary supervision, which uses environment-derived tasks expressed in compatible representations to improve adaptation to structured domains. Across models and representations, auxiliary supervision consistently improves optimal-move prediction relative to target-only training under identical target data. Tasks that expose environment dynamics provide larger and most consistent gains than surface-level or static supervision, while remaining competitive with substantially increasing the amount of target-task data. Moreover, ASCII-trained models transfer more effectively to FEN than FEN-trained models do to ASCII, even surpassing the FEN target-only baseline on FEN evaluation. The gains also extend beyond optimal-move prediction to open-ended, factually grounded commentary generation. Overall, our results show that auxiliary supervision in model-compatible representations can enable effective adaptation in structured domains.

</details>


### [245] [LongSocialBench: Do Long-Context LLMs Understand Online Discussion Threads?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04118)
*Xinyi Liu,Rinat Khaziev,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Tarek F. Abdelzaher*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 LongSocialBench，一个面向长上下文 LLM 的结构感知社会推理基准，包含 1,462 道来自 94 个完整在线讨论帖（中位长度约 73K token）的多选题。评估 18 个模型、29 种设置后发现，最佳单模型（Claude-Opus-4.7）仅 63.0%，低于人类 72.4%，说明瓶颈在于对结构化回复树的社会理解，而非上下文获取或提示方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文 LLM 已能读入整段在线讨论，但理解其社会话语需要追踪父子回复关系、转折点、局部子树、跨分支对比和参与者轨迹等结构信息。现有评测缺乏对这类"结构感知社会推理"能力的检验，因此作者构建 LongSocialBench 以填补空白。

Method: 构建 LongSocialBench 基准，从 94 个完整的 Hacker News、Stack Exchange 和 Reddit r/ChangeMyView 讨论帖中提取 1,462 道经人工验证的多选题，中位长度约 73K token。每道题包含一段完整序列化的讨论与回复结构文本及四选一问题，要求模型恢复结构化的社会证据。题目经过可答性、选项唯一性和证据落地性验证。在 18 个模型、29 种评测设置下进行测试，包括全上下文 Baseline、消除错误选项提示、以及提供 gold evidence scope 等条件。

Result: 当前长上下文工作流远低于人类水平。最佳单模型结果为 Claude-Opus-4.7 在"先排除错误选项再作答"提示下达到 63.0%，而独立人类读者为 72.4%。18 个模型平均的全上下文 Baseline 仅 43.9%；即使提供 gold evidence scope，也仅提升至 55.0%，表明在定位到相关讨论区域后仍存在大量错误。

Conclusion: LongSocialBench 表明，所缺失的能力并非上下文访问或提示技巧，而是对结构化回复树的社会理解。即使给定相关证据范围，模型表现仍显著落后于人类，凸显结构感知社会推理是长上下文 LLM 的关键短板。

Abstract: Long-context LLMs can now ingest entire online discussion threads, but understanding their social discourse requires more than reading a long document: models must track parent-reply relations, turning points, scoped subtrees, cross-branch contrasts, and participant trajectories. To test this structure-aware social reasoning, we introduce LongSocialBench, a benchmark of 1,462 verified human-authored multiple-choice items drawn from 94 complete Hacker News, Stack Exchange, and Reddit r/ChangeMyView episodes, with a median length of approximately 73K tokens. Each item pairs a complete serialized discussion and reply structure with a four-option question, requiring models to recover structured social evidence. Released items are verified for answerability, option uniqueness, and evidence grounding. Across 18 models and 29 evaluation settings, current long-context workflows remain far below human performance. The best individual result comes from Claude-Opus-4.7, which reaches 63.0% when prompted to eliminate incorrect options before answering, compared with 72.4% for independent human readers. Averaged across all 18 models, the full-context Baseline scores 43.9%. Supplying the gold evidence scope raises this to 55.0%, showing that substantial errors remain even after the relevant thread region is identified. LongSocialBench shows that the missing capability is not context access or prompting alone, but social understanding over structured reply trees.

</details>


### [246] [Copying Before Suppression: What Drives a Below-Chance Dip During Language Model Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04119)
*Tejas Dahiya,Cole Blondin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究训练过程中机械可解释性的动态变化：在间接宾语识别任务上，Pythia等模型出现偏好重复名字的临时窗口，源于两个计算之间的暂时失衡，成熟电路会掩盖早期塑造行为的瞬态因果配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械可解释性通常只研究完全训练好的模型，但驱动某一行为的计算在模型学习任务过程中可能发生变化。作者希望揭示训练早期存在的异常行为窗口及其背后的因果机制，理解成熟电路是如何在后期形成并掩盖早期瞬态配置的。

Method: 在间接宾语识别（IOI）任务上观察Pythia模型的训练动态；定位一组写出重复名字的注意力头，在独立提示上选择并固定该集合，用非重复名字提示上的平均输出替换每个头在最终token上的输出；对160M、410M、1B模型进行因果干预与激活替换；并将成熟模型中相应头的参数移植到早期检查点，测量正确减重复logit差的恢复程度；同时在两个独立训练的GPT-2和OLMo中验证类似现象。

Result: Pythia模型在早期训练窗口内偏好重复名字，准确率低于0.5，而固定文本样本的语言建模损失同期持续下降。替换注意力头输出可提升正确减重复logit差；160M成熟模型中降低重复名字的头在早期几乎不关注重复提及（注意力不足1%），对降低该名字logit几乎无直接贡献，这些性质在行为恢复期间逐渐增强。移植成熟头参数可恢复35%至68%的正确减重复logit差总提升。类似的早期到后期反转在其他Pythia规模、两个GPT-2和OLMo中亦出现。

Conclusion: 训练早期存在由两个计算暂时失衡导致的瞬态因果配置，它会塑造当时的行为；成熟的电路会掩盖这一早期配置。这表明仅研究完全训练模型可能遗漏塑造行为的关键动态机制，机械可解释性需要纳入训练过程视角。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability usually studies fully trained models, yet the computations that drive a behaviour can change while the model is still learning the task. On the Indirect Object Identification task, a model should continue with the name mentioned once rather than the name mentioned twice. Pythia models pass through an early training window in which they prefer the repeated name, so accuracy in a choice between the two names falls below one half while language-model loss on a fixed text sample keeps decreasing across the same window. The window reflects a temporary imbalance between two computations. We identify one cause of the wrong preference by selecting a set of attention heads that write the repeated name, on prompts separate from those used for causal evaluation, keeping that selection fixed, and then replacing each head's final-token output with its average output on a separate set of non-repeated-name prompts. This improves the correct-minus-repeated logit difference in a separately trained 160M model and in the official 160M, 410M, and 1B models. At 160M, the head that lowers the repeated name in the mature model shows little of its mature behaviour at this point. It directs less than one percent of its attention to the repeated mention, and its output makes almost no direct contribution to lowering that name's logit. Both properties grow over the interval in which behaviour recovers. Across the 160M, 410M, and 1B models, transplanting the corresponding head's mature parameters into the early checkpoint recovers 35 to 68 percent of the total improvement in the correct-minus-repeated logit difference seen by the end of training. Related early-to-late reversals appear at further Pythia scales, in two independently trained GPT-2 models, and in OLMo. A mature circuit can therefore conceal a transient causal configuration that shaped behaviour earlier in training.

</details>


### [247] [Representational Control over Self-Report & Behavior Coherence in LLM Risk-Taking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04125)
*Rafal Kocielnik,Peiyang Song,Pengrui Han,Myrl G. Marmarelis,Ramit Debnath,Dean Mobbs,R. Michael Alvarez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用激活引导（activation steering）在同一内部干预下同步测量LLM的风险偏好自陈与行为，发现二者由近似正交的内部方向驱动，自陈-行为一致性并非提示假象，而是表征层面的事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自陈（self-report）是探测LLM倾向的低成本手段，但已有研究仅在黑箱提示层面发现其与行为只有选择性一致，无法判断这种差距是提示方法的假象，还是底层构念在内部表征上的真实结构。作者希望在表征层面检验这一问题。

Method: 选取风险承担（risk-taking）这一智能体决策维度，用激活引导在同一内部干预下同时测量自陈与行为。系统考察9种引导向量提取方法，涵盖任务特定指令、模型自身任务行为、以及两种粒度的倾向性描述；在4个开放权重LLM上、用2个行为任务与2个心理测量量表进行评估；并通过去除表面混杂因素（诊断）与组合/翻转方向进行因果检验。

Result: (1) 共享干预不等于共享响应：由特质描述构建的方向改变自陈但使行为停留在随机水平，由模型自身任务选择构建的方向相反，仅任务特定指令能（微弱地）同时影响两者。(2) 诊断消解该例外：去除表面混杂后，指令仅保留其行为效应的32%；两个通道由近乎正交的方向引导，且每个通道可由多种独立构造触达。(3) 将"促行为"与"促自陈"方向复合可同时驱动两者，翻转一个符号即令二者对立——在所有模型上，69%–89%的翻转组合中自陈风险与实施风险指向相反方向。

Conclusion: 自陈-行为关系从黑箱观测转变为可检视、可控制的表征事实：二者由不同且近乎正交的内部方向支撑，提示层面的"一致"掩盖了表征层面的分离。作者据此主张在行为评测之外应并行开展表征检验（representational checks）。

Abstract: Self-report is an appealing low-cost probe of an LLM's dispositions, but recent work finds only selective agreement between what models report and how they behave. Prior accounts establish these patterns by prompting black-box LLMs, leaving open whether the gap is a prompting artefact or a fact about how the underlying constructs are represented internally. We investigate risk-taking, a consequential dimension of agentic decision-making, using activation steering to measure self-report and behavior under the same internal intervention. We survey nine steering-vector extraction methods spanning task-specific directives, the model's own task behavior, and dispositional descriptions at two granularities, evaluated on two behavioral tasks and two psychometric instruments across four open-weight LLMs. We find that (1) a shared internal intervention does not ensure shared responsiveness: directions built from trait descriptions move self-report but leave behavior at chance, directions built from the model's own task choices do the reverse, and only task-specific directives reach both, weakly. (2) Diagnosis dissolves that exception: removing surface confounders leaves the directives only 32% of their behavioral effect. The two channels are otherwise steered by near-orthogonal directions, each channel reachable by several independent constructions. (3) An intervention composing one behavior-moving and one self-report-moving direction moves both together; flipping one sign sets them in opposition, with reported and enacted risk pointing in opposite directions on 69-89% of flipped compositions in all models. These findings move the self-report-behavior relationship from a black-box observation to a representational one that can be inspected and controlled, motivating representational checks alongside behavioral evaluation.

</details>


### [248] [PB-GRPO: Learning Socially Adaptive LLM Agents from Persona-Driven Simulation with Preference-Batched GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04132)
*Jingquan Wang,Jun Yin,Xu Han,Yongsheng Mei,Jie Hao,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出偏好分批 GRPO（PB-GRPO）后训练算法，借助人格驱动的社交模拟环境，从对话级反馈中学习具备社交适应性的LLM策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 让大模型"社交得体"而非仅"回答正确"，需要推断用户未明说的目标、尊重偏好并随对话动态调整；这类行为本质上是多轮、社交性的，且真实交互数据稀缺、用户偏好潜隐不可直接观测，因此难以优化。

Method: 构建人格驱动的社交模拟环境（含人格库、基于LLM的用户模拟器、取值区间为[0,1]的用户满意度打分系统），并在此基础上提出偏好分批GRPO（PB-GRPO）：与原始GRPO不同，其优势函数采用在偏好相似的某一批用户上估计的归一化项，从而在多样化社交人群中稳定训练。

Result: 实证结果表明，在模拟环境中，PB-GRPO相较强强化学习基线能提升模型的社交行为表现。

Conclusion: 利用人格驱动的社交模拟与偏好分组的优势归一化，可在缺乏真实交互数据与显式偏好标注的条件下，有效后训练出更具社交适应性的LLM策略。

Abstract: Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires more than producing locally helpful responses. A socially competent agent must infer users' unstated goals, respect their preferences, and adapt as the conversation unfolds. These behaviors are inherently multi-turn and social, making them hard to optimize: real interaction data is scarce, and user preferences are typically latent rather than directly observable. To address these challenges, we build on a persona-driven social simulation environment (consisting of a persona library, LLM-based user simulators, and a user-satisfaction scoring system ranging from [0, 1]), to introduce preference-batched GRPO (PB-GRPO), a post-training algorithm that learns socially adaptive policies from conversation-level feedback. Compared to vanilla GRPO, PB-GRPO computes advantages using a normalization estimated across a bucket of users with similar preferences, stabilizing training across a diverse social population. Empirical evidence shows that PB-GRPO improves models' social behavior over strong reinforcement learning baselines in our simulated environment.

</details>


### [249] [Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04156)
*Mincheol Daniel Song,Joshua Ward,Jake Jung,Guang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Sentinel：一种基于轨迹衍生的分类器置信层，可在运行前、运行中、交付前三处停止LLM代理的不可靠行为，在EHRSQL基准上同时提升可靠性评分并削减计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床文本到SQL的LLM代理能自主多步推理，但无法判断自身推理或输出是否可信；在医疗等高风险场景中，错误代价高昂，且错误轨迹还会浪费计算预算，因此需要可靠的停止与弃答机制。

Method: 提出Sentinel，一个从轨迹衍生的、基于分类器的置信层，分析代理的推理、代码与数据库输出，在三个节点决定是否停止：运行前拒答不可回答问题、运行中终止注定失败的轨迹、交付时扣留不可信答案；并利用Chow规则在EHRSQL共享任务的可靠性评分下优化决策。

Result: 在EHRSQL基准上，当错误效用权重较低时，Sentinel将可靠性评分从+0.08提升至+0.24，远高于全部拒答的+0.03；交付答案准确率由54%升至69%，覆盖率由84%降至55%。在更高风险场景下，代理很少能可靠交付，Sentinel能自行检测并弃答至+0.03，而未监控代理得分为-3.02。低风险下仍作答时，Sentinel在几乎不损失可靠性的情况下减少13-28%的代理步骤。

Conclusion: Sentinel通过轨迹级置信估计实现三阶段停止决策，在提升临床文本到SQL代理可靠性的同时降低计算消耗，尤其在高风险情形下能自主弃答以避免严重负收益。

Abstract: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.

</details>


### [250] [Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04210)
*Sugam Panthi,Muhaiminul Yeamin,Rabab Abdelfattah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出SEAM基准，研究LLM的"吸收"现象：模型将粘贴文本后的用户评论误当作粘贴内容的一部分进行处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM将用户消息统一视为纯文本，即使其中混合了不同来源的文本。当用户粘贴一段文本并在其下方继续输入评论时，模型可能无法区分二者。现有指令-数据分离基准会明确告知模型哪些是指令、哪些是数据，再测试其是否遵守分离，因此无法检验未标记粘贴文本之后的无害用户话语是否被正确分离。

Method: 提出SEAM受控基准，包含300个编辑示例。每个示例在六种匹配条件下测试，这些条件改变粘贴文本与后续用户话语之间边界的表达方式（如裸换行、空行、边界标记等）。在20个模型上进行评测。

Result: 裸换行条件下的吸收率为7.7%至66.7%。添加空行在任何模型中均未显著降低吸收率；边界标记在20个模型中的19个中降低了吸收率。与粘贴文本风格契合的评论（如代码后输入的代码注释）在20个模型中的17个里被显著更频繁地吸收。

Conclusion: 模型常常无法将粘贴材料与后续用户话语分离，显式边界可减少但无法消除这种失败。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it. We study absorption: a phenomenon where the model treats a trailing user comment as part of the pasted text, returning it inside the edited text. This happens even though the user did not intend the comment to become part of that text. Existing instruction-data separation benchmarks tell the model which text is instruction and which is data, then test whether it obeys that separation. They do not test harmless user speech following an unmarked paste. We introduce SEAM, a controlled benchmark of 300 editing examples. Each example is tested under six matched conditions that vary how the boundary between pasted text and later user speech is expressed. Across 20 models, absorption at a bare newline ranges from 7.7% to 66.7%. Adding a blank line does not significantly reduce absorption in any model, while boundary markers reduce it in 19 of 20 models. Comments that fit the pasted text, such as a code comment typed after code, are absorbed significantly more often in 17 of 20 models. Models often fail to separate pasted material from later user speech, and explicit boundaries reduce but do not remove this failure.

</details>


### [251] [Conformal Prediction with Paraphrase-Aware Scoring for LLM Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04239)
*Jiayi Xin,Evan Qiang,Zihan Zhu,Xiang Li,Weijie J. Su,Qi Long*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种对语义改写鲁棒的同义改写感知UQ框架，用轻量代理模型聚合改写预测构造非一致性分数，在保留共形覆盖保证的同时显著提升改写场景下的稳定性与紧凑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的不确定性量化（UQ）旨在提供可靠的预测置信度，但现有方法在保义扰动下往往不稳定：语义等价改写会导致预测置信度出现显著波动，即使对共形预测等具有形式化保证的方法也难以避免。因此需要一种对语义改写鲁棒的UQ框架。

Method: 在LLM隐藏状态上训练一个轻量代理模型，并在多个改写版本上聚合其预测，构造逐标签（label-wise）的非一致性分数。在分数可交换性假设下，共形校准可保持边际覆盖；在仅测试时改写的情形下，若改写流程满足额外的分布对齐条件，该保证仍然成立。实验设置三种场景：正常（数据集均不改写）、全改写（校准集与测试集均改写）、半改写（仅测试集改写）。

Result: 在七个多项选择问答基准和多个模型家族上，该方法生成紧凑的预测集，经验覆盖率通常接近名义目标，即使在半改写场景下也是如此。消融实验表明，学得的代理模型贡献了集合规模缩减的大部分；改写增强训练与推理时聚合则提升了改写下的稳定性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，结合代理模型预测聚合与改写增强训练/推理，可在保持共形覆盖保证的同时，有效缓解语义改写引起的UQ不稳定问题，兼顾覆盖有效性与预测集紧凑性。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) for large language models (LLMs) aims to provide reliable measures of predictive confidence, yet current methods are often unstable under meaning-preserving perturbations. Semantically equivalent paraphrases can induce substantial variability in predictive confidence, even for methods with formal guarantees, such as conformal prediction. To address this issue, we propose a paraphrase-aware UQ framework robust to semantic rewordings. Our approach trains a lightweight proxy model on LLM hidden states and aggregates its predictions across paraphrases to construct label-wise nonconformity scores. Under score exchangeability, conformal calibration retains marginal coverage. This guarantee can also hold under test-only rewording, provided that the paraphrase pipeline satisfies an additional distributional alignment condition. We evaluate three settings (normal, fully reworded, and semi-reworded) which apply rewording to neither dataset, both calibration and test datasets, or only the test dataset, respectively. Across seven multiple-choice QA benchmarks and multiple model families, our method produces compact prediction sets with empirical coverage generally near the nominal target, even in the semi-reworded setting. Ablation studies show that the learned proxy accounts for most of the reduction in set size, while paraphrase-augmented training and inference-time aggregation improve stability under rewording. Code is available at https://github.com/Raina-Xin/PA_Score.

</details>


### [252] [Playing social deduction games with reinforcement fine-tuned large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04261)
*Lingzhe Zhang,Yunpeng Zhai,Tong Jia,Kening Zheng,Chiming Duan,Minghua He,Zhaoyang Liu,Bolin Ding,Philip S. Yu,Ying Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究以隐藏身份社交推理游戏为实验平台，考察强化微调（RFT）如何改变大语言模型的社会行为，发现终局胜负信号稀疏且噪声大，难以直接习得社交推理能力，而针对社交读心、社会影响等具体行为的奖励与多智能体社会认知奖励微调更为有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFT正被越来越多地用于LLM与人类及其他智能体交互的场景，但学界对RFT如何改变LLM社会行为尚缺乏系统认识。作者希望借助隐藏身份社交推理游戏这一可控环境，探究RFT能否以及如何塑造机器的社会智能，并尝试为机器社会智能建立行为学习理论。

Method: 以隐藏身份社交推理游戏为任务环境，要求智能体进行隐藏状态推断、社会解读与投票引导。对比经过RFT的智能体与基座智能体，并设置不同奖励设计（终局胜负奖励 vs. 行为特异性奖励）与交互结构；进一步提出多智能体社会认知强化微调，在同一阵营的多智能体训练中结合社会解读与社会影响两类信号。

Result: 直接优化终局胜负结果无法使LLM智能体稳定获得社交推理能力，说明终局结果对社交互动学习而言是稀疏且含噪的信号；RFT在社会解读方面效果尤为显著，包括从公开讨论推断隐藏身份、随时间更新信念、预测他人未来决策；RFT也能提升社会影响能力，如引导投票、团队审批与集体决策，但更依赖行为特异性奖励和结构化交互设置；多智能体社会认知RFT可进一步提升游戏表现，且所习得行为在战略能力、说服力与社会有用性上获得更优的人类评价。

Conclusion: RFT对社会行为的影响具有分化性：终局结果奖励不适合作为社交互动学习的主要信号，而分解到社会解读与社会影响等具体行为的奖励，配合多智能体社会认知训练，能更有效地塑造LLM的社会智能并获得人类认可，为机器社会智能的行为学习理论提供了初步基础。

Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. Here we use social deduction games to study how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour. We let fine-tuned and base LLM agents play hidden-role games that require hidden-state inference, social reading and vote steering. Our results show that LLM agents do not reliably acquire social-deduction ability by directly optimizing terminal win--loss outcomes, suggesting that final game results provide a sparse and noisy signal for socially interactive learning. However, RFT is particularly effective at improving social reading, including tasks that require agents to infer hidden roles from public discussion, update beliefs over time and predict other agents' future decisions. We further show that RFT can also improve social influence, including tasks that require agents to steer votes, team approvals and collective decisions, although these gains depend more strongly on behaviourally specific rewards and structured interaction settings. Finally, we show that LLMs' ability to play social deduction games can be further improved through multi-agent social-cognitive reinforcement fine-tuning, which combines social-reading and social-influence signals during same-side multi-agent training. These learned behaviours also receive more favourable human evaluations of strategic competence, persuasiveness and social usefulness. Together, these results enrich our understanding of how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour and provide a step toward a behavioural learning theory for machine social intelligence.

</details>


### [253] [AI-Enabled Quality Assurance for Multiple-Choice Assessment Items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04267)
*Steven Moore,Nicholas Diana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对自动题目缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛查及NLP基准审计进行叙述性综述，纳入14篇全文报告，构建19项标准评估框架，指出高标签准确率伴随弱阳性案例检出、标准不一、修订证据混杂等问题，并提出将质量保证视为独立验证决策序列的评估范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动生成多项选择题的规模不断扩大，但其评估质量难以确立。现有研究在缺陷检测、修订及质量筛查方面证据分散，缺乏对检测方法与报告证据的系统梳理，因此需要明确区分表层检查与内容敏感判断，并厘清质量保证各环节的证据强度。

Method: 采用聚焦式叙述性综述方法，通过数据库检索、引文追溯及提名来源获取文献，最终纳入14篇研究全文进行评审。将19项标准评分表映射到相应的检测方法与报告证据，并区分表层检查与内容敏感判断，对自动题目编写缺陷检测、修订、心理测量筛查及NLP基准审计四类研究进行归类分析。

Result: 高标签级准确率常常与弱阳性案例检出并存；评分表定义与参照标准存在差异；修订相关证据结果混杂，既往研究报道的关联性并不能确立修复的实际效果。总体表明现有质量保证证据在检出效度、标准一致性及修订效果方面均存在明显不足。

Conclusion: 提出将质量保证评估为一组独立验证决策的序列，主张采用标准特异性报告、经校准的人工复核以及基于结果的修订评估。该框架强调质量保证各环节需分别验证，而非以单一指标概括整体质量。

Abstract: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We present a focused narrative review of automated item-writing flaw detection, revision, psychometric screening, and NLP benchmark auditing. Database searches, citation retrieval, and nominated sources yield fourteen research reports reviewed in full text. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary. Revision evidence is mixed, and the associations reported in prior work do not establish the effects of repair. We propose evaluating quality assurance as a sequence of independently validated decisions, with criterion-specific reporting, calibrated human review, and outcome-based assessment of revisions.

</details>


### [254] [Evaluating Modeling Approaches for Experience-Level Classification in Job Description](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04304)
*Celia Liang,Eddie Wu,Shiqi Wang,Yonah You*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文面向招聘文本中的岗位经验等级预测任务，提出结构感知的Section-Aware BERT方法，并对比大语言模型（few-shot/微调），验证显式利用文本结构可提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 招聘文本具有显式内部结构，不同段落对经验线索的贡献不均，传统文本分类未利用此结构特征。同时需厘清大语言模型与传统建模范式在能力边界上的差异。

Method: 提出Section-Aware BERT，对标题、职责、要求等关键段落进行分段与编码并以结构感知方式融合建模；以规则系统和TF-IDF为基线；在同一数据集上评估大语言模型在few-shot与微调两种设置下的表现。

Result: 显式利用文本结构显著提升经验等级预测性能，在岗位标题含糊的场景下提升尤为明显；大语言模型对比提供不同建模范式能力边界参考。

Conclusion: 该工作为结构化招聘文本提供了有效的建模方法与分析框架；错误分析揭示任务系统性挑战，包括Entry与Senior混淆、Mid-level边界模糊。

Abstract: This paper investigates the task of predicting job experience levels in recruitment texts, aiming to automatically identify the qualifications required for positions. Unlike traditional text classification, recruitment texts typically possess explicit internal structures, with different paragraphs playing disproportionate roles in conveying experience clues. To address this, we propose a structure-aware Section-Aware BERT approach that segments and encodes key paragraphs (titles, responsibilities, requirements) for integrated modeling, building upon rule-based systems and classical baselines TF-IDF. Simultaneously, we evaluate large language models under both few-shot and fine-tuning settings on the same dataset to compare the capability boundaries of different modeling paradigms. Experimental results demonstrate that explicitly leveraging text structure significantly improves experience level prediction performance, particularly in scenarios with ambiguous job titles. Further error analysis reveals systemic challenges in this task, including confusion between Entry and Senior levels and the blurred boundaries of Mid-level positions. This research provides an effective modeling approach and analytical framework for understanding structured recruitment texts.

</details>


### [255] [Evidence and Intervention: A Coupled Active-Inference Extension of Rational Speech Act Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04347)
*Yonghyeon Gwon,Elliot Murphy,Chun Kee Chung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将对话建模为耦合主动推断过程，把说话人策略分布嵌入听者似然，区分了RSA通常合并的四种更新（语用状态推断、伙伴参数学习、澄清/修复的前瞻评估、习惯与时间代价塑造的策略先验），并证明标准RSA是一步精确推断限制下的单轮特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相同话语选择可能源于不同交际成因，相同解读也可能给听者留下不同学习痕迹；标准单步RSA只把解读视为对说话人意义的推断，无法从本质上区分这些因果更新目标。

Method: 构建对话的耦合主动推断模型：听者对某话语的似然即归因于说话人的策略分布，将说话人的期望自由能置于听者的变分自由能中，使每句话既是关于伙伴的证据，也是对伙伴的干预；模型显式分离四类更新：伙伴当前语用状态推断、伙伴特异性参数学习、澄清或修复的前瞻评估、受习惯和情境敏感时间代价影响的策略先验。

Result: 在一步、精确推断限制下，模型可还原RSA说话人与听者，RSA成为耦合过程的受限单轮极限；在限制之外，各更新遵循不同规则和时间尺度，可预测哪些适应会持续、保持伙伴特异或发生迁移。示例显示：澄清后受众设计发生反转、双方自由能均低却对指称不一致的自证式误解、以及不确定性未解决前的理性收尾。

Conclusion: 与反对将自然语言等同于交际的批评一致，该模型把交际视为语言结构的下游用途，并将产出与理解重构为耦合推断：说话既是对伙伴的干预，也是一种采样伙伴模型证据的认知行动。

Abstract: Identical utterance choices can arise from different communicative causes, and identical interpretations can leave different traces in what a listener learns. Rational Speech Act (RSA) models treat interpretation as inference over speaker meaning, but standard one-shot RSA does not intrinsically distinguish these causal update targets. We develop a coupled active-inference model of dialogue in which a listener's likelihood for an utterance is the policy distribution attributed to the speaker, placing the speaker's expected free energy within the listener's variational free energy. Each utterance is therefore both evidence about and an intervention on a partner. The model separates four updates that RSA approaches typically collapse: inference about the partner's current pragmatic state; learning of partner-specific parameters; prospective evaluation of clarification or repair; and a policy prior shaped by habit and a context-sensitive price of time. Under one-step, exact-inference restrictions, the model recovers the RSA speaker and listener, with RSA as the restricted single-turn limit of the coupled process. Outside these restrictions, the updates obey distinct rules and timescales, predicting which adaptations persist, remain partner-specific, or transfer.
